title: Do Text Edits Generalize to Visual Generation? Benchmarking Cross-Modal Knowledge Editing in UMMs
comment: Published at ICML 2026; Code and data available at https://github.com/gxx27/UniKE
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose multimodal intelligence. As they are deployed in real-world applications, effectively updating internal knowledge becomes critical. While knowledge editing has matured for text-only models, it remains unclear whether edits that successfully modify textual outputs also transfer to image generation in UMMs. To study this question, we introduce UniKE, the first benchmark for cross-modality knowledge editing in UMMs, comprising 2,971 edit subjects spanning attribute and relation edits. Using VQA-based visual verification, we reveal a striking modality gap: text-side efficacy can reach approximately 92%, whereas the best overall VQA accuracy under direct image generation is only 18.5%. We further propose Reasoning-augmented Parameter Editing, which explicitly activates edited knowledge before generation and improves overall VQA accuracy for all evaluated model-editor pairs, with gains up to 18.6 percentage points. Mechanistic analysis shows that this gap is associated with partial alignment between edited textual representations and the conditioning pathways for visual generation, where edits sufficient for text outputs may remain too weak or misaligned to steer image synthesis. These findings show that textual knowledge edits do not guarantee reliable cross-modality transfer and motivate modality-aware editing methods. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/gxx27/UniKE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniKE基准，首次系统研究跨模态（文本→图像）知识编辑在统一多模态模型中的效果，发现文本侧编辑成功率高达92%，但图像生成侧仅18.5%，表明文本知识编辑无法可靠迁移至视觉生成。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在实际部署中需要高效更新内部知识，但现有知识编辑方法仅针对纯文本模型，不清楚修改文本输出是否能同步影响图像生成。
AI.method: 构建UniKE基准（2,971个编辑主题，涵盖属性和关系编辑），采用VQA视觉验证评估跨模态知识编辑效果，并提出推理增强参数编辑（Reasoning-augmented Parameter Editing）方法。
AI.result: 文本侧编辑准确率达92%，但直接图像生成的最佳VQA准确率仅18.5%；推理增强方法可提升最多18.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 文本知识编辑无法保证跨模态可靠迁移，需开发模态感知的编辑方法。

title: Threshold-Based Exclusive Batching for LLM Inference
summary: Mixed batching (MB)--interleaving prefill and decode in a single batch--has become the standard scheduling strategy for large language model (LLM) inference due to its efficiency in maximizing compute and memory utilization. However, through controlled experiments, we find that prefill-decode interference inflates MB's per-step marginal cost above that of pure decode. On the high-bandwidth H200 (4.8 TB/s), this occurs only when decode tokens exceed 80% of the batch; however, on the bandwidth-constrained RTX PRO 6000 (1.792 TB/s), this threshold plummets to just 20%. Consequently, the optimal choice between MB and exclusive batching (EB) fundamentally depends on GPU memory bandwidth, model size, and workload composition. We derive a closed-form condition for this EB-MB performance crossover, along with asymptotically optimal phase-switching thresholds and memory-safe batch sizing for EB. Optimized EB achieves up to 41.9% higher throughput on bandwidth-constrained GPUs, while MB retains its advantage on high-bandwidth hardware with larger models. Our hybrid scheduler EB+ applies this condition online to dynamically switch between EB and MB without manual intervention. Under non-stationary traffic with distribution or concurrency shifts, EB+ attains the highest or near-highest throughput in every setting, outperforming MB by up to 36.4%.

AI.tldr: 本文发现混合批处理（MB）中prefill和decode存在干扰，导致边际成本升高。在带宽受限的GPU上，独占批处理（EB）可提升高达41.9%的吞吐量；本文提出的混合调度器EB+能动态切换EB和MB，在非平稳流量下性能最高提升36.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有混合批处理（MB）虽已成为LLM推理的标准调度策略，但prefill和decode之间的干扰尚未被充分研究，导致在带宽受限的GPU上性能并非最优。本文旨在量化这种干扰，并探索何时应使用独占批处理（EB）而非MB。
AI.method: 通过控制实验发现prefill-decode干扰对边际成本的影响；推导出EB与MB性能交叉的闭式条件、渐进最优的相位切换阈值以及EB的内存安全批大小；提出混合调度器EB+，在线动态切换EB和MB。
AI.result: 在带宽受限的RTX PRO 6000上，优化EB吞吐量最高提升41.9%；高带宽H200上MB仍保持优势。EB+在非平稳流量下性能最高提升36.4%。
AI.conclusion: GPU内存带宽是决定EB和MB优劣的关键因素，最优调度策略应随硬件和负载动态调整，EB+能自动适应非平稳流量场景。

title: Acting with AI: An Interaction-Based Framework for Agentic Tort Liability
summary: Agentic AI systems can plan over multiple steps, use tools, and execute tasks over time. When such systems cause harm, tort law struggles to allocate responsibility because the harmful path may be neither fully chosen by the user nor specifically foreseen by the developer. This paper proposes an interaction-based framework for agentic torts, drawing on Michael Bratman's planning theory and on the common law's treatment of human-human concerted action. We distinguish three interaction types: autonomous drift, pure tool use, and collaborative planning. Pure tool cases remain governed by ordinary product-defect and warning doctrines; collaborative planning cases map onto the independent contractor control test, professional malpractice, and negligent misrepresentation; autonomous drift maps onto frolic and detour under respondeat superior and strict product liability. The framework treats the stateful interaction log as the primary evidentiary trace, allowing courts to infer where the human-AI trajectory departed from the authorized undertaking and where liability should attach. We resolve four incident-anchored cases, situate the account alongside strict-liability and insurance-based proposals, note its relationship to regulatory oversight, and propose a ``Reasonable Agent'' standard built around constraint verification, epistemic transparency, runtime grounding, and forensic logging.

AI.tldr: 本文针对智能体AI系统造成损害时的责任分配问题，提出了一个基于交互类型的法律分析框架，将人机交互分为自主漂移、纯工具使用和协作规划三类，并分别对应不同的侵权责任规则。
AI.motivation: 侵权法在智能体AI系统造成损害时面临责任分配困境——损害路径既非用户完全选择，也非开发者具体预见，现有法律框架难以适用。
AI.method: 基于Bratman的规划理论和普通法中人类共同行动的处理方式，提出三种交互类型：自主漂移、纯工具使用和协作规划，并分别映射到相应的侵权责任规则，以状态交互日志作为主要证据线索。
AI.result: 纯工具使用适用产品缺陷和警告规则；协作规划适用独立承包商控制测试、专业过失和过失虚假陈述；自主漂移适用雇主责任中的"逸出行程"原则和严格产品责任。提出了"合理智能体"标准，包含约束验证、认知透明性、运行时基线和取证日志。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过解析四个案例，阐述了与严格责任和基于保险的方案的关系，以及监管监督的意义，为智能体侵权提供了可操作的法律分析路径。

title: Score-Control for Hallucination Reduction in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as the backbone of modern generative AI, powering advances in vision, language, audio and other modalities. Despite their success, they suffer from hallucinations, implausible samples that lie outside the support of true data distribution, which degrade reliability and trust. In this work, we first empirically confirm previously proposed hypothesis that score smoothness causes hallucinations in Image Generation diffusion models and provide a density-based perspective. We further formalize this notion by linking the hallucinations probability mass to lipschitz constant of the learned score function. Motivated by this, we introduce a Variance-Guided Score Modulation (VSM) strategy that controls the score Jacobian, in turn reducing score smoothness and better approximating the ground truth score that decreases hallucinations. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach reduces hallucinations (up to ~25%) while maintaining high fidelity and diversity, providing a principled step toward more reliable diffusion-based image generation. We also propose two benchmark datasets with extreme semantic variation for systematic hallucination evaluation. Code and Datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/bhosalems/VSM.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩散模型的幻觉问题源于分数平滑性，提出方差引导分数调制（VSM）策略来控制分数雅可比矩阵，减少分数平滑性，从而降低幻觉（最高约25%），同时保持高保真度和多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在生成图像时存在幻觉问题（生成真实数据分布之外的样本），影响可靠性和可信度。已有假设认为分数平滑性导致幻觉，但缺乏严格证明和有效缓解方法。
AI.method: 1）经验验证分数平滑性导致幻觉的假设，并建立密度视角；2）形式化地将幻觉概率与学习到的分数函数的Lipschitz常数联系起来；3）提出方差引导分数调制（VSM）策略，通过控制分数雅可比矩阵来降低分数平滑性，更好逼近真实分数函数。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上，VSM方法将幻觉减少约25%，同时保持高保真度和多样性。此外还构建了两个具有极端语义变化的标准数据集用于系统评估。
AI.conclusion: VSM为构建更可靠的扩散图像生成模型提供了原则性步骤，代码和数据集已公开。

title: Skill or Skip? Learning Selective Skill Invocation in Agentic Tasks via Dual-Granularity Preference Learning
summary: Agent skills are callable procedural modules that provide reusable knowledge and execution policies for complex agentic tasks. However, existing methods mainly focus on selecting relevant skills or improving the skills themselves, while overlooking whether a relevant skill should actually be invoked at the current decision point. Unhelpful invocations may introduce irrelevant context and disrupt an otherwise correct execution process. To address this issue, we propose SelSkill, a dual-granularity preference-learning framework for selective skill invocation. SelSkill formulates skill use as a skill-or-skip decision, uses predictive uncertainty to prioritize candidate decision points, and constructs controlled invoke-skip preference pairs from shared trajectory prefixes. It further combines episode-level outcome preferences with step-level invocation preferences to capture both overall trajectory quality and the local effectiveness of skill invocation. On ALFWorld with Qwen3-8B, SelSkill improves task success by 10.9 percentage points and execution precision by 29.1 percentage points. On BFCL, it improves task success by 5.7 percentage points and execution precision by 29.5 percentage points. Zero-shot results on Tau-bench and PopQA further suggest that the learned invocation policy transfers to new domains with previously unseen skills.

AI.tldr: 提出SelSkill框架，通过双粒度偏好学习实现选择性技能调用，在多个基准测试中显著提升任务成功率和执行精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法关注选择相关技能或改进技能本身，但忽略了在当前决策点是否应该真正调用该技能。不合理的调用会引入无关上下文，破坏执行过程。
AI.method: 提出SelSkill双粒度偏好学习框架，将技能使用建模为调用/跳过决策，利用预测不确定性优先排序候选决策点，构建受控调用-跳过偏好对，结合回合级结果偏好和步骤级调用偏好。
AI.result: ALFWorld上任务成功率提升10.9%，执行精度提升29.1%；BFCL上任务成功率提升5.7%，执行精度提升29.5%；零样本迁移到新领域和未见技能也有效。
AI.conclusion: SelSkill有效解决技能不当调用问题，具备良好的跨域迁移能力。

title: KACE: Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Context engineering can improve large language models without updating their weights, but mathematical reasoning exposes a key limitation: feedback accumulated in one growing prompt causes context bloat and limits the amount of learned guidance that can be used. Existing methods often conflate storage, what is learned across runs, with usage, what is included for a particular problem, and therefore inherit this prompt-size ceiling. We introduce Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering (KACE), which separates storage from usage through difficulty- and domain-based organization. Offline, a self-reflective learning loop distills training traces into an epistemic tree: a knowledge base of typed cards stratified by problem difficulty and epistemic domain. Each card is assigned to the difficulty-domain node corresponding to the failure from which it originated. At evaluation time, tiered self-consistency with per-tier agreement gates dynamically classifies each problem as easy, medium, or hard. Easy problems exit without retrieved cards, while harder problems retrieve only the matching branch of the tree. This tiered scheme matches or exceeds Best-of-N while using comparable compute, and it classifies problem difficulty with 78 percent pairwise concordance. The main empirical contribution is the construction and use of a difficulty- and domain-stratified knowledge base enabled by tiered self-consistency. On AIME 2025, KACE achieves 62.2 percent accuracy, a 10.4-point absolute gain over fixed Best-of-5 self-consistency at a comparable solver-call budget and a 5.6-point gain over the strongest learned-context baseline, Tiered + GEPA. We also observe consistent gains on MATH-HARD and the verifiable subset of OlymMATH.

AI.tldr: KACE通过分离存储与使用、基于难度和领域组织知识库，结合分层自一致性机制，在数学推理任务上显著超越现有方法，AIME 2025准确率达62.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在数学推理中面临上下文集结（context bloat）问题，且将存储（跨运行学到的内容）与使用（特定问题包含的内容）混为一谈，受到提示长度上限的制约。
AI.method: 提出知识自适应上下文工程（KACE），离线通过自反思学习循环将训练轨迹蒸馏为按难度和领域分层的认知树（epistemic tree）；在线通过分层自一致性（tiered self-consistency）动态分类问题难度，仅对困难问题检索对应分支的知识卡片。
AI.result: 在AIME 2025上达62.2%准确率，比固定Best-of-5自一致性高10.4个点，比最强基线Tiered+GEPA高5.6个点；在MATH-HARD和OlymMATH上也获得一致提升；问题难度分类的 pairwise 一致性达78%。
AI.conclusion: 分离存储与使用、按难度和领域组织知识库是提升大模型数学推理能力的有效范式，KACE在保持计算开销相当的同时显著超越现有方法。

title: Non-Learning Low-Light Stereo Vision
comment: Accepted to ICIP 2026. Code and data available at https://github.com/guo-research-group/nonlearning-lowlight-stereo
summary: We present a non-learning stereo framework for disparity estimation from severely noisy images. Using the Field of Junctions (FoJ), it retains coarse visual features stable under severe noise for cost volume construction while discarding fine textures inseparable from photon noise. The resulting structural information guides boundary-aware Semi-Global Matching (SGM) that dynamically adapts smoothness penalties to preserve true disparity discontinuities. The output is a sparse disparity map more accurate than those of recent stereo algorithms over unmasked pixels on widely-used benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种非学习的立体匹配框架，利用FoJ提取噪声鲁棒的粗粒度视觉特征构建代价体积，并结合边界感知SGM方法处理严重噪声图像，在基准数据集上获得了比近期算法更准确的稀疏视差图。
AI.motivation: 现有立体匹配方法在严重噪声图像上表现不佳，因为噪声会破坏精细纹理影响视差估计。本文旨在设计一种不依赖学习的框架，能在强噪声下仍保持结构信息的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 使用Field of Junctions (FoJ)从严重噪声图像中提取稳定的粗粒度视觉特征，丢弃与光子噪声不可分的精细纹理；2) 利用这些结构信息构建代价体积；3) 采用边界感知的半全局匹配(SGM)方法，动态调整平滑惩罚项以保持真实的视差不连续性。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的基准数据集上，所提出的非学习方法在遮挡像素上的稀疏视差图准确度超过了近期的一些立体匹配算法。
AI.conclusion: 非学习框架结合FoJ与边界感知SGM能有效应对严重噪声场景下的立体匹配问题，在结构保持和噪声鲁棒性方面具有优势。

title: Probe Before You Edit: Probing-Guided Molecular Optimization for LLM Agents in Structure-Based Drug Design
summary: Structure-based drug design increasingly employs LLM agents to iteratively refine ligands against a target pocket, yet a viable ligand must satisfy two often-conflicting objectives -- binding affinity and druggability -- which single optimization steps rarely improve together. To quantify this difficulty, we introduce two diagnostic metrics: the first measures how often a single edit improves both objectives, and the second measures how often a gain on one objective comes with a loss on the other. Applying these diagnostics to current LLM-agent pipelines exposes a consistent failure mode: the agent performs molecular editing without knowing how the pocket-ligand complex responds to local modifications, thus rarely achieving joint improvement. Inspired by medicinal chemists, who probe the pocket-ligand complex with controlled analog edits before choosing an optimization direction, we propose \textbf{PROBE}, an optimization framework built around edit-response probing. PROBE first decomposes the ligand into editable sites and builds a pocket-specific \textbf{site map} that flags where joint gains are plausible, where the two objectives are likely in tension, and where liability substructures should be changed; it then performs controlled probe edits whose responses are distilled into an \textbf{EditManual}. Guided by the site map and EditManual, PROBE runs an iterative multi-agent loop in which an affinity agent, a druggability agent, and a co-optimization agent jointly produce edits. On the CrossDocked2020 benchmark, PROBE achieves state-of-the-art performance and substantially mitigates the failure modes exposed by our diagnostics metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出PROBE框架，通过位点探测和编辑手册引导多智能体协同优化，解决药物设计中结合亲和力与成药性难以同时提升的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体管线在编辑分子时无法同时改善结合亲和力和成药性，存在两种目标的冲突，需要一种能理解口袋-配体复合物对局部修饰响应的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出PROBE框架：1) 将配体分解为可编辑位点，构建口袋特异性位点图谱；2) 执行受控探针编辑，将响应蒸馏成编辑手册；3) 多智能体循环（亲和力智能体、成药性智能体、协同优化智能体）联合产生编辑。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020基准上达到最先进性能，显著缓解了诊断指标暴露的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过模拟药物化学家的类比编辑策略，PROBE能够有效识别联合改进的可行区域与目标冲突区域，实现更优的分子优化。

title: SUPREME: A Multi-GPU Framework for Reproducible Image Unlearning Method Evaluation
summary: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining it from scratch. Evaluating an unlearning method requires repeating training, unlearning, and evaluation across multiple seeds, which is computationally expensive. To our knowledge, existing image classification unlearning frameworks run on a single GPU, which limits how many seeds can be evaluated in reasonable time. We introduce SUPREME, an open-source framework that distributes these stages across multiple GPUs. SUPREME makes three contributions: a registry-based design for adding new methods, metrics, models, and scenarios; a multi-GPU architecture supporting multiple accelerators and precision modes; and a demonstration on Pins Face Recognition using ResNet18 and ViT under full-class and random-sample unlearning across ten seeds. The framework is available at https://github.com/pedroandreou/supreme-unlearning.

AI.tldr: SUPREME是一个开源的多GPU分布式机器学习反学习框架，支持多种方法、指标、模型和场景，通过注册式设计和多GPU架构显著提升了反学习评估的效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像分类反学习框架仅支持单GPU运行，评估多个种子的反学习效果计算成本极高，亟需一个高效的分布式解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SUPREME框架，包含三个核心贡献：基于注册表的设计便于扩展新方法/指标/模型；多GPU架构支持多种加速器和精度模式；在Pins Face Recognition数据集上使用ResNet18和ViT进行全类和随机样本反学习验证。
AI.result: 在10个种子的全类和随机样本反学习场景下成功运行ResNet18和ViT模型，框架开源可用。
AI.conclusion: SUPREME通过多GPU分布式设计有效加速了反学习方法的评估流程，为反学习研究提供了可扩展、高效的开源工具。

title: Learning to Retrieve: Dual-Level Long-Term Memory for Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: Interactive text-to-SQL agents solve database tasks through multi-turn interactions involving schema exploration, query execution, feedback interpretation, and decision revision. Long-term memory helps agents reuse past experiences, but existing retrieval methods remain limited. Static methods rely on fixed similarity heuristics that do not optimize downstream utility, while dynamic methods often learn from sparse final outcomes and retrieve memories at a single decision horizon. This is insufficient when memory usefulness changes across interaction stages, since memories useful for initial planning may differ from those needed for local, state-conditioned execution. We propose MERIT, a dynamic multi-horizon memory retrieval framework. MERIT maintains episode-level memory for global strategic guidance and turn-level memory for local decision support. Both levels use learned retrieval policies optimized with reinforcement learning. To train turn-level retrieval despite limited intermediate supervision, MERIT uses a lightweight Process Reward Model to provide dense proxy rewards for local memory selection. Experiments on BIRD-Interact show that MERIT outperforms no-memory, static-retrieval, and dynamic-retrieval baselines in success rate while reducing average interaction turns. Transfer results on Spider2-Snow further show positive cross-benchmark transfer without benchmark-specific tuning. These results suggest that multi-horizon retrieval improves experience reuse in interactive text-to-SQL agents.

AI.tldr: MERIT是一个面向交互式Text-to-SQL智能体的多层级记忆检索框架，通过强化学习优化的多时间尺度记忆策略（全局策略级+局部回合级）和过程奖励模型，在BIRD-Interact和Spider2-Snow上显著优于无记忆、静态检索和动态检索基线。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL智能体的长期记忆检索方法存在不足：静态方法依赖固定相似度启发式，无法优化下游效用；动态方法仅从稀疏最终结果学习，且只在单一决策时间尺度检索记忆，忽略了不同交互阶段（如初始规划vs局部执行）对记忆有用性的差异化需求。
AI.method: 提出MERIT框架，包含双层级记忆检索：策略级记忆提供全局策略指导，回合级记忆提供局部决策支持。两个层级均使用强化学习学习的检索策略。为解决回合级中间监督稀疏问题，引入轻量级过程奖励模型（Process Reward Model）为局部记忆选择提供密集代理奖励。
AI.result: 在BIRD-Interact上，MERIT在成功率上超越无记忆、静态检索和动态检索基线，同时减少了平均交互轮次。在Spider2-Snow上的迁移实验表明，无需基准特定调优即可实现正向跨基准迁移。
AI.conclusion: 多时间尺度检索能有效提升交互式Text-to-SQL智能体的经验复用能力，证明了在不同交互阶段区分记忆有用性并分别优化检索策略的有效性。

title: PropLLM: Propagation-Aware Scene Reconstruction for Network Fault Diagnosis
summary: Network faults propagate layer by layer along topology and protocol dependencies, yet operations systems typically observe only symptomatic alerts at the tail end of propagation chains, where distinct root-cause faults may produce highly similar end-point symptoms. Existing approaches, whether rule-based, machine learning (ML)-based, or large language model (LLM)-based, fundamentally map the alert set to a diagnosis in a single pass and are structurally incapable of resolving this end-point ambiguity. This paper proposes PropLLM, which is the first to integrate the hop-by-hop scene reconstruction paradigm with the generative reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Starting from end-point alerts, PropLLM traces back hop-by-hop along the propagation path, retrieving verifiable factual evidence from a dual-layer knowledge graph (KG) at each hop, while the proposed Temporal Causal Propagation Attention (TCPA) mechanism encodes known topological causal priors directly into the attention computation to guide the model along the correct causal direction, ultimately localizing the root cause and determining the fault type through a fully evidenced causal chain. On a real-world Wi-Fi multimodal fault dataset, PropLLM improves fault type diagnosis accuracy by 3.9\% and root cause localization accuracy by 4.7\% over the strongest baseline, while reducing the hallucination rate by 50.8\%. Supplementary experiments on the TeleLogs 5G dataset further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method across different network scenarios.

AI.tldr: PropLLM首次将逐跳场景重建范式与大语言模型生成式推理能力结合，通过双层层级知识图谱和时序因果传播注意力机制，沿着故障传播路径回溯定位根因，在真实Wi-Fi多模态故障数据集上将故障类型诊断准确率提升3.9%、根因定位准确率提升4.7%，幻觉率降低50.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于规则、机器学习或大语言模型的方法均通过单次映射将告警集转化为诊断结果，无法解决网络故障传播中端点告警的歧义性问题（不同根因故障可能产生高度相似的端点症状）。
AI.method: 提出PropLLM，包含三个核心创新：1）逐跳场景重建范式，从端点告警沿传播路径逐跳回溯；2）双层层级知识图谱存储每跳可验证的事实证据；3）时序因果传播注意力机制将拓扑因果先验编码到注意力计算中，引导模型沿正确因果方向推理。
AI.result: 在真实Wi-Fi多模态故障数据集上，故障类型诊断准确率提升3.9%，根因定位准确率提升4.7%，幻觉率降低50.8%；在TeleLogs 5G数据集上的补充实验进一步验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PropLLM通过结构化的逐跳因果推理，有效克服了网络故障诊断中端点症状歧义性问题，显著提升了诊断准确率并大幅降低了LLM的幻觉率。

title: αDepth: Learning Single-Pass Soft Boundary Decomposition for Stereo Conversion
summary: Accurately modeling soft boundaries, e.g., hair and defocus blur, is a fundamental challenge in stereo conversion due to the ambiguous blending of foreground and background. Existing depth models primarily predict single-layer depth, leading to ambiguity in depth correspondence at soft boundaries. While matting techniques can capture opacity for layered modeling, they often struggle in complex scenes with multiple targets and usually require user intervention. This paper introduces αDepth, a layered representation that decomposes soft boundaries for high-fidelity stereo conversion. Specifically, we first resolve mixed color and depth ambiguity by estimating layered color and depth values at soft boundaries. Considering complex multi-target scenes, we design a Circular Alpha Representation (CAR) that shifts the paradigm from global target extraction to local boundary decomposition. Unlike prior matting methods restricted to a single foreground/background, CAR enables efficient scene-level inference without manual guidance. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that αDepth achieves state-of-the-art performance in stereo conversion, eliminating background bleeding and structural distortions at soft boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出αDepth，一种通过圆形Alpha表示（CAR）分解软边界处的混合颜色和深度，实现高质量立体转换的分层表示方法，在软边界处达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 立体转换中软边界（如头发、散焦模糊）因前后景模糊混合导致深度对应不明确，现有深度模型预测单层深度产生歧义，而抠图技术在复杂多目标场景中需人工干预且效果有限。
AI.method: 首先在软边界处估计分层颜色和深度值以解决混合歧义；设计圆形Alpha表示（CAR），将全局目标提取范式转变为局部边界分解，无需人工引导即可实现场景级推理。
AI.result: 在立体转换任务上达到SOTA性能，有效消除了软边界处的背景渗色和结构失真。
AI.conclusion: αDepth通过软边界分层分解表示，显著提升了立体转换在复杂场景下的质量。

title: Revisiting Parameter-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models: Theoretical Limits and Empirical Evidence
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Equal contribution by the first two authors. 9 pages main paper, 10 figures, with appendix
summary: Parameter-based knowledge editing updates the internal knowledge of large language models (LLMs) via localized weight modifications and has attracted significant attention. However, most existing methods overlook fundamental theoretical limitations and are rarely evaluated under realistic, practice-oriented settings. In this paper, we first present a theoretical analysis based on the dimensional Collapse Hypothesis, explaining how localized parameter edits can propagate along fragile directions in the representation space, inducing global interference and ultimately causing reasoning collapse. Building on this insight, we conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation by systematically varying knowledge complexity, number of edits, evaluation dimensions, and baseline methods. Our results show that parameter-based editing methods consistently damage core LLM capabilities. In contrast, a simple retrieval-based baseline achieves consistently stronger performance than all parameter-editing methods across all evaluated conditions. These findings highlight that preserving the fundamental capabilities of LLMs after knowledge editing should be a central concern for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论（维度坍缩假说）和实验上证明，基于参数的LLM知识编辑方法会沿着脆弱方向传播干扰，导致推理崩溃。一个简单的检索式基线在所有条件下均优于参数编辑方法，强调未来研究应关注保持LLM核心能力。
AI.motivation: 现有参数编辑方法忽略了理论基础限制，且缺乏贴近真实场景的评估。作者希望揭示参数编辑的根本缺陷，并推动研究关注LLM核心能力的保持。
AI.method: 1) 基于维度坍缩假说进行理论分析；2) 系统实验：变化知识复杂度、编辑数量、评估维度和基线方法，对比参数编辑方法与检索式基线。
AI.result: 参数编辑方法在所有实验条件下一致损害LLM核心能力；检索式基线在所有条件下均优于所有参数编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: 知识编辑后保持LLM基础能力应是未来研究的核心关注点。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents produce safety evidence across long trajectories, where sparse, delayed, and compositional risk signals often escape local moderation. Existing turn-level or short-context detectors struggle to reliably retain and aggregate such evidence over extended horizons. We reframe long-horizon agent safety detection as trajectory-level evidence compression and propose Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety (TRACE). TRACE uses a Compressor-Reader design: the Compressor encodes the full trajectory into a compact latent evidence state under trajectory-level supervision, and the Reader judges the raw trajectory with this latent evidence state as a safety reference. This design helps aggregate dispersed risk cues and reduce premature evidence loss. Across ASSEBench, Pre-Ex-Bench, and R-Judge, TRACE achieves the best accuracy on all evaluated backbones, improving over strong baselines by up to 12.6 percentage points. On LongSafety, TRACE shows smaller performance degradation as context length grows. Attention visualizations and case studies suggest that the compressed reference helps the Reader focus on risk-critical segments and recover cross-step evidence. Code is available at https://github.com/Peregrine123/TRACE_official.

AI.tldr: TRACE提出了一种轨迹级证据压缩方法（Compressor-Reader设计），用于检测长上下文LLM代理的安全风险，在多个基准上准确率提升高达12.6个百分点，并能更好地处理长序列中的稀疏和延迟风险信号。
AI.motivation: 现有转向级或短上下文检测器难以在长轨迹中可靠地保留和聚合稀疏、延迟且组合性的风险证据，导致局部审核失效。
AI.method: 采用Compressor-Reader双组件设计：Compressor在轨迹级监督下将完整轨迹编码为紧凑的潜在证据状态；Reader以该潜在状态作为安全参考来对原始轨迹进行判断。
AI.result: 在ASSEBench、Pre-Ex-Bench和R-Judge上，TRACE在所有评估骨干上均取得最佳准确率，比强基线提升高达12.6个百分点；在LongSafety上，随着上下文长度增长，性能退化更小。
AI.conclusion: 压缩后的参考表示能帮助Reader聚焦风险关键片段并恢复跨步骤证据，有效缓解长序列下的证据丢失问题。

title: Zamba2-VL Technical Report
summary: We present Zamba2-VL, a suite of vision-language models built on Zamba2, a hybrid language-model architecture combining Mamba2 state-space layers with a small number of shared transformer blocks. Across a broad range of image understanding, reasoning, OCR, grounding, and counting benchmarks, Zamba2-VL is competitive with leading Transformer-based open-weight VLMs of comparable scale, including the Molmo2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3.5 families, and substantially outperforms prior SSM-based and hybrid VLMs such as VL-Mamba, Cobra, and mmMamba. Inheriting the near-linear prefill compute and small, near-constant recurrent state of its Zamba2 backbone, Zamba2-VL delivers roughly an order of magnitude lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) than these Transformer baselines at matched parameter scale, with the efficiency gap most pronounced at the smaller 1.2B and 2.7B scales most relevant to on-device and edge deployment. We release three models -- 1.2B, 2.7B, and 7B -- together with inference code at https://huggingface.co/collections/Zyphra/zamba2-vl.

AI.tldr: Zamba2-VL是基于Zamba2混合架构（Mamba2状态空间层+少量共享Transformer块）的视觉语言模型系列，在多项视觉任务上与主流Transformer VLM性能相当，但推理速度（首Token延迟）提升约一个数量级，尤其适合边缘设备部署。开源1.2B、2.7B、7B三个模型。
AI.motivation: 现有SSM和混合架构VLM（如VL-Mamba、Cobra）性能落后于Transformer VLM，而Transformer VLM推理速度慢（高TTFT），不利于边缘设备部署。作者希望结合Zamba2混合架构的高效推理优势，构建性能与Transformer VLM相当但推理效率大幅提升的VLM。
AI.method: 基于Zamba2混合语言模型架构（Mamba2状态空间层+少量共享Transformer块）构建视觉语言模型Zamba2-VL，延续了Zamba2近乎线性的预填充计算和小的近恒定循环状态。
AI.result: 在图像理解、推理、OCR、定位和计数等基准上，Zamba2-VL性能与Molmo2、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5等Transformer VLM相当，显著优于VL-Mamba、Cobra、mmMamba等先前SSM/混合VLM；首Token延迟比Transformer基线低约一个数量级，在1.2B和2.7B小模型上优势最明显。
AI.conclusion: Zamba2-VL证明了混合架构（Mamba2+Transformer）可以兼顾视觉语言模型的性能与推理效率，特别适合对延迟敏感的边缘和端侧部署场景。

title: Sandboxed Coding Agents are Competitive Omni-modal Task Solvers
summary: As multimodal LLMs increasingly target video and audio, it is often assumed that such tasks require native omnimodal models. We show that this is not always the case: coding agents with only text+image access and a sandboxed tool-use interface can match, and in several settings outperform, SOTA native omnimodal models and predefined multimodal agent scaffolds across multiple audio-video benchmarks. Our trajectory analysis suggests that their strength comes from writing code and orchestrating tools to extract relevant evidence from transcripts, frames, and other modality signals, thereby converting omnimodal tasks into retrieval and information-processing problems rather than ingesting entire media streams. We further characterize their limitations through a failure taxonomy and process-level trace analysis, and show that simple skill injection, including human-written and self-distilled skills, substantially improves performance. To explore open-source elicitation, we introduce Code-X, a training recipe with the OmniCoding trajectory dataset and verifiable reward, and provide baselines on Qwen-3.5-9B and Qwen-3.6-27B. Finally, we argue that the next frontier is many-modality processing, and introduce TerminalBench-O, a process-level benchmark for real-world omnimodal processing tasks. Code will be available at https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/OmniCoding.

AI.tldr: 本文发现仅具备文本+图像访问能力并结合沙盒工具接口的编码智能体，在多项音视频基准测试中能够匹配甚至超越原生全模态模型；通过轨迹分析揭示其优势在于将全模态任务转化为检索与信息处理问题，并提出了训练方法Code-X及基准TerminalBench-O。
AI.motivation: 挑战“全模态任务必须依赖原生全模态模型”这一普遍假设，探索通过编码智能体+工具接口的方式是否能够以更简单的模态输入（文本+图像）实现同等甚至更优的全模态任务性能。
AI.method: 构建仅具备文本+图像访问权限的编码智能体，配备沙盒化工具接口；通过轨迹分析研究其工作机制；提出Code-X训练方案，包含OmniCoding轨迹数据集和可验证奖励机制；引入TerminalBench-O过程级基准。
AI.result: 编码智能体在多个音视频基准上匹配或超越SOTA原生全模态模型及预定义多模态智能体框架；简单技能注入（人工编写与自蒸馏技能）可显著提升性能；基于Qwen-3.5-9B和Qwen-3.6-27B提供了基线结果。
AI.conclusion: 全模态任务并非必须依赖原生全模态模型，编码智能体通过工具编排可将问题转化为检索与信息处理；未来方向是“多模态处理”，TerminalBench-O为此提供了过程级评测基准。

title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models
summary: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for AI planning, yet their performance remains constrained by the training data distribution. One approach is to improve generated solutions during inference by scaling test-time compute. A more efficient alternative is to optimize the inference process itself. In this paper, we show that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure. Our algorithm synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths. Key contributions include novel exploration control mechanisms and integration of learned models within the OCL framework. Across multiple combinatorial planning domains, our approach outperforms both neurosymbolic search baselines and classical solvers in computational efficiency and solution quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的Open-Closed List搜索算法，结合生成模型与启发式模型，在组合规划任务中实现了比神经符号搜索和经典求解器更高的计算效率和解质量。
AI.motivation: 生成模型在AI规划中受限于训练数据分布，现有方法要么通过测试时扩展计算量来改善生成结果，效率较低。作者希望优化推理过程本身，以更高效的方式提升规划性能。
AI.method: 对经典Open-Closed List（OCL）搜索进行改进，融合两个学习组件：生成模型（从中间状态快速rollout）和启发式模型（对候选推理路径排序），并引入新的探索控制机制。
AI.result: 在多个组合规划领域，该方法在计算效率和解质量上均优于神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化推理过程而非增加测试时计算量，可以显著提升生成模型在规划任务中的表现，OCL框架与学习组件的结合是一种有效且高效的方案。

title: Rethinking Amortized Neural Representations for High-Resolution Terrain Elevation Data
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) model a signal as a continuous coordinate-to-value function. For terrain elevation data, this supports analytic derivatives, arbitrary-resolution decoding, and a smooth surface model of the underlying heightfield. However, fitting and storing a separate INR for every tile does not scale to large terrain datasets. Amortized neural representations reduce this cost with a shared network: a new tile is mapped to a compact per-tile payload, and a shared decoder reconstructs the heightfield from it. Most such methods are hypernetworks that predict the payload in a single forward pass, while others recover it through a short per-tile optimization. These methods were developed primarily for natural images, and their suitability for terrain heightfields remains unclear. We introduce a controlled benchmark on a 1 m/pixel terrain dataset and evaluate three representative methods under a unified protocol. Observing a clear cross-domain gap, we propose HUVR+SIREN, a hypernetwork that adapts the strongest benchmarked method (HUVR) by replacing its coordinate decoder with a smooth, analytically differentiable one. It attains the best height and derivative fidelity on the benchmark with no additional per-tile storage and lower decode cost, and tolerates aggressive post-training quantization with negligible quality loss, giving a compact terrain neural format. Ablations and diagnostics further identify which design choices transfer to terrain and show that the per-tile bottleneck is already near its useful limit, leaving the remaining gap in the shared hypernetwork's architectural design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HUVR+SIREN方法，通过替换坐标解码器为平滑可微形式，在1m/像素地形数据集上实现了最佳高程和导数精度，且无需额外存储，支持量化压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经表示（INR）用于地形高程数据虽有优势，但逐瓦片存储开销大；而分摊式神经表示方法主要针对自然图像设计，在地形高程数据上的适用性尚不明确。
AI.method: 在1m/像素地形数据集上建立受控基准，统一评估三种代表性方法；提出HUVR+SIREN，将HUVR的坐标解码器替换为平滑且可解析微分的SIREN，并支持训练后量化压缩。
AI.result: HUVR+SIREN在基准测试中达到了最佳的高程和导数保真度，无需额外逐瓦片存储，解码成本更低，且能容忍激进的训练后量化而质量损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 逐瓦片瓶颈已接近极限，剩余差距在于共享超网络的架构设计；HUVR+SIREN为地形数据提供了一种紧凑的神经表示格式。

title: SPADER: Step-wise Peer Advantage with Diversity-Aware Exploration Rewards for Multi-Answer Question Answering
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents to acquire information beyond parametric knowledge. While recent work has improved long-horizon tool-use reasoning, most approaches focus on tasks with a single correct answer. In contrast, many real-world queries require discovering a comprehensive set of valid answers, a setting known as Multi-Answer QA. This setting raises two challenges: fine-grained credit assignment over long search trajectories and reward alignment for sustained exploration beyond easy high-frequency entities. We propose SPADER, a reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon tool use in Multi-Answer QA. SPADER includes Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA), a critic-free step-level credit assignment mechanism that aligns parallel trajectories by decision step and estimates advantages from peer returns. It also includes a diversity-aware exploration reward that promotes long-tail entity discovery by upweighting rare findings and downweighting redundant ones. Experiments on QAMPARI, Mintaka, WebQSP, and QUEST show that SPADER generally improves recall and overall F1 over prompting-based agents, outcome-supervised RL methods, and recent step-level supervision approaches. Our code and model weights are available at https://github.com/KhanCold/spader.

AI.tldr: SPADER是一个强化学习框架，通过步骤级信用分配（SPA）和多样性探索奖励，提升了大型语言模型在多答案问答任务中的长程工具使用推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强型大模型主要针对单一正确答案的任务，而现实中的多答案问答需要发现全面的有效答案集合，面临长搜索轨迹的细粒度信用分配和持续探索的奖励对齐两大挑战。
AI.method: 提出SPADER框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 步骤级同行优势（SPA）：无评论家的步骤级信用分配机制，通过对齐平行轨迹的决策步骤并计算同行回报的优势估计；2) 多样性感知探索奖励：通过提升稀有发现权重、降低冗余发现权重，促进长尾实体发现。
AI.result: 在QAMPARI、Mintaka、WebQSP和QUEST四个基准上，SPADER在召回率和整体F1分数上普遍优于基于提示的智能体、结果监督强化学习方法以及最近的步骤级监督方法。
AI.conclusion: SPADER有效解决了多答案问答场景下长程工具使用的挑战，验证了步骤级信用分配和多样性奖励在促进全面探索方面的优势。

title: Hidden Thoughts Are Not Secret: Reasoning Trace Exposure in LLMs
summary: Reasoning traces have become a valuable form of learning signals for improving and transferring the capabilities of large language models. In particular, detailed traces can help distill reasoning behavior from stronger teacher models into weaker student models. The value of capability transfer has motivated many deployed systems with reasoning models to hide raw internal traces and expose at most summaries and answers to users. As a result, we ask whether such interface-level trace hiding prevents users from obtaining useful reasoning supervision through prompting. We study this question with Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP), a lightweight in-context elicitation method that uses shadow-model-generated demonstrations wrapped in auxiliary code-like formats to raise user-visible reasoning traces from a victim model. Across the common reasoning dataset, different victim models, and different student model distillation, REP substantially increases similarity between exposed and REP-conditioned internal traces while preserving useful reasoning signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了推理模型隐藏原始内部轨迹后，用户能否通过提示方式获取有用推理信号的问题，并提出了一种轻量级上下文引导方法REP，通过影子模型生成示范并包装成辅助代码格式，有效提升了暴露轨迹与内部轨迹的相似性，保留了有用推理信息。
AI.motivation: 许多部署的推理模型通过隐藏原始内部推理轨迹（仅暴露摘要和答案）来保护能力迁移，但这种接口级别的隐藏是否阻止用户通过提示获取有用的推理监督信号？本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 提出了Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP)，一种轻量级上下文引导方法，利用影子模型生成的示范，包装成辅助代码格式，从受害者模型中引出用户可见的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在常见推理数据集、不同受害者模型和学生模型蒸馏场景下，REP显著提升了暴露轨迹与REP条件化内部轨迹之间的相似性，同时保留了有用的推理信号。
AI.conclusion: 即使模型隐藏了原始推理轨迹，用户仍可通过REP这类提示方法获取有用的推理信号，表明接口级隐藏并不能完全阻止推理能力的迁移。

title: Toward Responsible and Epistemically Grounded Multilingual LLMs for Computational Social Science and Humanities
summary: Large language models have rapidly evolved in multilingual competence and reasoning capacity, enabling their integration into Social Sciences and Humanities research workflows. Yet existing evaluation paradigms remain anchored in task-based NLP benchmarks and fail to address interpretive validity, cultural situatedness, and epistemic mediation. This paper reconceptualizes multilingual reasoning LLMs as hermeneutic instruments that actively structure meaning production across linguistic and cultural contexts. Drawing on hermeneutics, philosophy of technology, science and technology studies, multilingual NLP research, and computational social science methodology, we develop a theoretically grounded framework for evaluating multilingual reasoning in Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH) research. We articulate a rigorous experimental protocol with operationalized metrics for cultural alignment, cross-lingual stability, and reasoning faithfulness, along with transparency requirements tailored to interpretive research tasks. We illustrate the framework through a concrete application scenario involving multilingual political discourse analysis. The paper contributes a conceptual and methodological foundation for responsible integration of multilingual reasoning LLMs into computational social science infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文重新将多语言推理大语言模型概念化为诠释学工具，并提出了一个面向社会科学与人文学科研究的评估框架，包含文化对齐、跨语言稳定性和推理忠实度等操作性指标。
AI.motivation: 现有评估范式局限于任务型NLP基准测试，未能解决解释有效性、文化情境性和 epistemic 中介问题，无法适应SSH研究的需求。
AI.method: 融合诠释学、技术哲学、科学技术研究、多语言NLP研究和计算社会科学方法论，构建理论框架；制定包含文化对齐、跨语言稳定性、推理忠实度等指标的实验协议。
AI.result: 通过多语言政治话语分析的应用场景展示了框架的可行性，建立了将多语言推理LLM负责任地整合到计算社会科学基础设施中的概念与方法基础。
AI.conclusion: 多语言推理LLM应被视为诠释学工具而非简单的任务执行器，需建立超越传统NLP指标、关注文化情境与解释效度的评估体系。

title: ForeSci: Evaluating LLM Agents for Forward-Looking AI Research Judgment
summary: AI research often requires decisions before future evidence exists: which bottleneck to attack, which direction to pursue, or where a project should be positioned. We introduce ForeSci, a temporally controlled benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can make such forward-looking research judgements from historical evidence. ForeSci contains 500 tasks across four fast-moving AI domains and four decision families. Each task is paired with a cutoff-aligned offline knowledge base; post-cutoff papers are hidden during generation and used only for validation. To avoid random future-event prediction, tasks are derived from pre-cutoff taxonomy branches and evidence signals, and answer-generation backbones are selected to precede the task cutoffs. We evaluate native LLMs, Hybrid RAG, and three research-agent adaptations across four backbones. Results show that explicit evidence organization improves traceability and factual support, but gains depend strongly on the decision family. Diagnostics reveal a recurring evidence-decision decoupling: agents may cite relevant evidence while forecasting the wrong research object. ForeSci turns forward-looking AI research judgement into a controlled benchmark for evaluating research agents as decision-making systems.

AI.tldr: ForeSci是一个时间可控的基准测试，用于评估LLM代理能否基于历史证据做出前瞻性研究判断，包含500个任务和4个AI领域。实验表明，显式证据组织提高了可追溯性，但存在证据-决策脱钩问题。
AI.motivation: AI研究常需在缺乏未来证据的情况下做出前瞻性决策（如选择研究瓶颈、方向或定位），但目前缺乏评估LLM代理此类能力的标准化基准。
AI.method: 构建ForeSci基准：包含500个任务，覆盖4个快速发展的AI领域和4种决策类型。每个任务配备截止时间对齐的离线知识库，隐藏截止后论文用于验证。任务源自截止前分类分支和证据信号，答案生成骨干模型选择在截止时间之前。评估了原生LLM、Hybrid RAG和三种研究代理适配方法。
AI.result: 显式证据组织提高了可追溯性和事实支持，但效果高度依赖于决策类型。诊断发现存在"证据-决策脱钩"现象：代理可能引用相关证据却预测错误的研究对象。
AI.conclusion: ForeSci将前瞻性AI研究判断转化为受控基准，用于评估研究代理作为决策系统的能力，揭示了当前方法在面向未来决策中的局限性。

title: AXIOM: A Trust-First Neuro-Symbolic Execution Architecture for Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Preprint. 12 pages, 2 figures. Live interactive demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Squagghy/axiom-solver. Paper artifact and dataset on Zenodo (concept-DOI): 10.5281/zenodo.20440225
summary: We present AXIOM, a trust-first neuro-symbolic execution architecture for natural-language mathematical reasoning. In AXIOM, the language model functions strictly as a canonicalizer: it rewrites informal problem text into a narrow schema consumed by a deterministic Computer-Algebra-System (CAS) pipeline, which derives and verifies the answer or abstains as a first-class output. Routing follows a 1:1:1 alignment between problem-shape regex, schema-specific prompt, and closed-form CAS handler, with 3,100+ such routes shipped and zero LOST_CORRECT regressions across 250+ consecutive ship commits. We report empirical results on 4 MATH categories with a cumulative correctness of 94.36% (2,592/2,747) at 100.00% trust on parseable (zero confident-wrong answers across the full 2,747-record benchmark), all four domains above the per-domain 70/90/70 floor with per-domain trust at 100.0%, and median latency of 1 ms on rule-only handlers (88% of records on the lm-eval arithmetic 20,000-record benchmark). The architecture has served ~30,000 production queries through a public deployment. The contribution we emphasize is not a final accuracy figure but the forward dynamic the architecture establishes: every logged abstain in production is a candidate correct after one ship cycle, since new tasks compose without regressing the registry. The operational discipline behind this property -- math-template bucketing, LOST_CORRECT scan as regression oracle, parseable-first onboarding, and abstain as first-class output -- constitutes a transferable framework for trustworthy neuro-symbolic systems beyond mathematics.

AI.tldr: AXIOM是一种信任优先的神经符号执行架构，将语言模型限制为规范化器，通过确定性CAS管道进行数学推理，达到94.36%的正确率和100%的可信度，无错误回答。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号系统在数学推理中缺乏可信保证，语言模型可能产生错误答案且难以审计。作者旨在构建一个架构，使系统能够保证"不给出错误答案"（abstain as first-class output），同时保持高正确率。
AI.method: 采用1:1:1对齐：问题形状正则表达式 → 特定模式的提示 → 封闭式CAS处理器。LM仅作为规范化器，将非正式问题重写为窄模式，由确定性CAS管道推导并验证答案或弃权。共构建3,100+条路由，无LOST_CORRECT回归。
AI.result: 在4个MATH类别上累计正确率94.36%（2,592/2,747），可解析输入上可信度100.0%（零个错误回答），各领域可信度均为100.0%，规则处理器中位延迟1毫秒（88%记录）。已服务约30,000次生产查询。
AI.conclusion: 架构的核心贡献不是最终准确率，而是建立的动态机制：每次生产弃权在一个发布周期后即可成为正确候选，因为新任务可以不回归已有注册表。该操作规范（模板分桶、LOST_CORRECT扫描、可解析优先、弃权作为一等输出）可迁移至数学之外的信任优先神经符号系统。

title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
summary: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的概率世界模型，通过自回归序列建模训练，能够从原始视频中学习物理结构、发现物体及其部件，并在3D中操控物体，实现如视觉叠叠乐等应用。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能的核心挑战之一是从原始视频中学习场景的物理结构（物体如何形成及其交互规律），而现有架构无法从部分观测中推断世界的分布状态。
AI.method: 提出了一类新的概率世界模型，支持基于任意其他变量估计任何视觉变量（如外观和动态）的概率，并通过自回归序列建模高效训练。
AI.result: 模型能够捕捉物体运动的物理定律，生成多个合理的未来状态；通过分析未来状态的运动相关性，提取出物体和关节子部件；可以在3D中操控发现的物体；能够计算物体间的物理关系，实现视觉叠叠乐应用。
AI.conclusion: 该概率世界模型从原始视频中学习物理结构，具备物体发现、3D操控及物理关系推理能力，为视觉智能中的物理理解提供了新范式。

title: MemPro: Agentic Memory Systems as Evolvable Programs
summary: Long-horizon autonomous agents require memory systems to retain historical information, track evolving states, and reuse relevant knowledge beyond finite context windows. Existing agentic memory systems typically follow a memory construction-retrieval (MCR) pipeline, but often adapt mainly the memory bank while keeping the surrounding pipeline fixed after deployment. This fixed-pipeline design struggles to handle heterogeneous task-specific failure modes and can become misaligned with memory banks that evolve in scale and structure over time. To address these limitations, we propose MemPro, a system-level evolution framework that treats the entire MCR pipeline as an evolvable program rather than adapting only the memory bank or prompt text. MemPro maintains a version tree of runnable memory-system implementations, where an Evolving Agent iteratively selects promising versions, diagnoses recurring failures, and creates improved child versions through failure-mode-guided edit-debug refinement. Experiments on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, HotpotQA, and NarrativeQA show that MemPro consistently outperforms strong static and prompt-level evolving baselines within a few iterations, continues to improve with evolution, and achieves a favorable performance-cost trade-off. Code is available at https://github.com/wanghai673/MemPro.

AI.tldr: MemPro提出了一种系统级演化框架，将整个记忆构建-检索（MCR）管道视为可演化程序，通过版本树和故障模式引导的编辑调试优化，在多个基准测试上优于静态和提示级演化基线。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统通常采用固定的MCR管道，部署后仅适配记忆库，难以处理异构任务特定的故障模式，且与不断演化的记忆库产生失配。
AI.method: 提出MemPro，维护可运行记忆系统实现的版本树，由演化智能体迭代选择有希望的版本、诊断重复故障，并通过故障模式引导的编辑调试优化创建改进的子版本。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval、LoCoMo、HotpotQA和NarrativeQA上，MemPro在几次迭代内持续优于强静态和提示级演化基线，性能随演化持续提升，并实现了有利的性能-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: MemPro通过系统级演化框架有效解决了固定管道设计在长时域自主智能体记忆系统中的局限性。

title: Real-Time Physics Simulation with Dynamic Mesh-Gaussian Reconstructions
summary: Integrating dynamic 3D reconstructions into physics simulation requires fixed mesh topology for efficient collision detection, but state-of-the-art methods like DG-Mesh produce varying topology optimized for geometric quality. We investigate whether topology conversion can enable physics integration while preserving reconstruction fidelity. We propose a dual-representation framework combining fixed-topology meshes for physics with Gaussian splatting for rendering, achieving 4.65$\times$ speedup over varying-topology baselines through runtime vertex buffer updates. We evaluate two conversion strategies, temporal correspondence tracking and template-based projection, against native fixed-topology methods (MaGS) on the DG-Mesh dataset. Our evaluation reveals that both conversion approaches incur 65-80% geometric degradation, producing results inferior to MaGS despite DG-Mesh's superior initial quality. This demonstrates that high-quality reconstruction and physics-compatible topology represent fundamentally distinct objectives that cannot be reconciled through post-processing. Our findings inform future development of physics-aware reconstruction methods and our framework enables real-time simulation with any fixed-topology approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将动态3D重建（如DG-Mesh）与物理仿真集成，提出双表示框架（固定拓扑网格用于物理+高斯泼溅用于渲染），发现拓扑转换会导致65-80%的几何质量下降，证明高质量重建与物理兼容拓扑是根本不同的目标。
AI.motivation: 现有动态3D重建方法（如DG-Mesh）产生的变拓扑网格在几何质量上表现优异，但无法直接用于需要固定拓扑的物理仿真中。作者希望探究拓扑转换是否能在保持重建质量的同时实现物理集成。
AI.method: 提出双表示框架：固定拓扑网格处理物理仿真+高斯泼溅负责渲染，运行时通过顶点缓冲区更新实现4.65倍加速。评估两种转换策略（时间对应追踪和模板投影）与原生固定拓扑方法（MaGS）的性能对比。
AI.result: 两种拓扑转换方法均导致65-80%的几何质量下降，表现不如原生固定拓扑方法MaGS，尽管DG-Mesh的初始质量更高。双表示框架相比变拓扑基线实现4.65倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 高质量重建与物理兼容拓扑是根本不同的目标，无法通过后处理拓扑转换来调和。未来应发展物理感知的重建方法，当前框架可与任何固定拓扑方法实现实时仿真。

title: Robust Reasoning via Dynamic Token Selection for Distribution-Aligned Self-Distillation
summary: Self-distillation improves learning efficiency by rewriting reference answers as training data that better matches the model's own distribution. However, reference answers also introduce strong stylistic biases, causing the generative model to imitate surface forms rather than learn useful reasoning patterns. We observe that the rewriting data contains a large number of high-perplexity (PPL) tokens, coming from two distinct sources: beneficial knowledge-enhancing logical corrections, and harmful stylistic drift induced by reference imitation. Treating all such tokens equally can disrupt the base model's original distribution and degrade performance, especially on difficult reasoning tasks. To address this, we propose Distribution-Aligned Self-Distillation (DASD), which uses an answer-aware reference model to generate candidate tokens and dynamically filters them according to the base model's confidence. DASD preserves tokens that encode useful logical knowledge while suppressing distributionally misaligned style noise. Experiments on math, code, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that DASD consistently outperforms competitive baselines, reduces high-PPL tokens, and improves robustness across tasks of varying difficulty.

AI.tldr: DASD 是一种分布对齐的自蒸馏方法，通过动态过滤高困惑度 token（区分知识增强的风格噪声），在数学、代码和常识推理任务上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏中参考答案会引入风格偏差，导致模型模仿表面形式而非学习有用推理模式，且高困惑度 token 包含逻辑修正（有益）和风格漂移（有害）两种来源，现有方法无法区分。
AI.method: 提出 DASD，使用答案感知的参考模型生成候选 token，并根据基础模型置信度动态过滤：保留编码有用逻辑知识的 token，抑制分布对齐不良的风格噪声。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和常识推理基准上，DASD 持续优于竞争基线，减少了高困惑度 token，并在不同难度任务上提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DASD 通过分布对齐的动态过滤机制有效解决了自蒸馏中的风格偏差问题，提升了模型推理能力与泛化鲁棒性。

title: Regularized Offline Policy Optimization with Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to optimize policies from pre-collected datasets. A bottleneck of this paradigm is managing epistemic uncertainty, which arises from limited data coverage (sample-level) and the ambiguity in identifying transition dynamics from finite data (model-level). To provide a unified quantification of these uncertainties, Bayesian RL has been proposed by treating the dynamics model as a random variable and maintaining a corresponding belief. Despite its theoretical appeal, policy optimization in Bayesian RL remains computationally challenging as it requires solving composite objectives with expectations. Prior methods either employ search-based techniques with poor computational scalability or impose restrictive posterior assumptions that sacrifice the adaptability of Bayesian RL. To address these limitations, we propose Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief (PhyB), which reformulates the expectation as a convex combination over a subset of dynamics models. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the objective discrepancy induced by this approximation remains bounded. Based on PhyB, we develop an iterative regularized policy optimization algorithm that provides metric-agnostic guarantees for monotonic improvement until convergence. Empirical results demonstrate that PhyB achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PhyB的新方法，通过将期望重新表述为动态模型子集上的凸组合，实现了计算高效的贝叶斯离线强化学习，并提供了单调改进保证和最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习中存在样本级和模型级的认知不确定性，贝叶斯RL虽能统一量化这些不确定性，但其策略优化因需求解含期望的复合目标而计算困难。现有方法要么计算可扩展性差，要么牺牲贝叶斯RL的适应性。
AI.method: 提出后验混合贝叶斯信念（PhyB），将期望重写为动态模型子集的凸组合；在此基础上开发了迭代正则化策略优化算法，提供度量无关的单调改进保证直至收敛。
AI.result: 理论分析表明该近似的目标差异有界；实验证明PhyB在各种基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: PhyB有效解决了贝叶斯离线RL的计算可扩展性与适应性之间的权衡，兼顾理论保证与实证性能。

title: DarkVesselNet: Multi-Modal Remote Sensing and Trajectory Reasoning for Dark Vessel Detection
summary: Dark vessel detection requires fusing what vessels report through AIS with what satellites observe through radar and optical sensors. DarkVesselNet is a multi-modal remote sensing stack that combines Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical imagery, geospatial foundation model backbones, AIS trajectory reasoning, TGARD-style gap detection, and a Pi-DPM-inspired anomaly head. The repository exposes the system as a tested Python package and a public Hugging Face Space. The paper presents the sensor stack, backbone abstraction, fusion path, anomaly head, and current validation. The evidence currently available is software-grounded: tests for SAR speckle filtering, optical band ratios, Haversine distance, TGARD gap emission, sensor coregistration, backbone token shapes, and differentiable anomaly scoring.

AI.tldr: DarkVesselNet是一个多模态遥感系统，融合AIS数据与Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2光学影像等卫星观测数据，用于暗船检测，并提供完整的Python包和Hugging Face Space实现。
AI.motivation: 暗船（未通过AIS报告位置的船只）检测需要融合多源数据，但目前缺乏统一的、可测试的多模态融合框架。
AI.method: 系统整合了Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2光学影像、地理空间基础模型骨干、AIS轨迹推理、TGARD风格间隙检测以及Pi-DPM启发的异常检测头，形成完整的传感器堆栈与融合路径。
AI.result: 目前验证基于软件层面：包括SAR散斑滤波、光学波段比、Haversine距离、TGARD间隙排放、传感器配准、骨干网络token形状和可微异常评分等测试均通过。
AI.conclusion: 论文展示了该系统的传感器堆栈、骨干抽象层、融合路径和异常检测头，并以Python包和Hugging Face Space形式开源，为暗船检测提供了可复现的多模态融合方案。

title: French parsing enhanced with a word clustering method based on a syntactic lexicon
summary: This article evaluates the integration of data extracted from a French syntactic lexicon, the Lexicon-Grammar (Gross, 1994), into a probabilistic parser. We show that by applying clustering methods on verbs of the French Treebank (Abeillé et al., 2003), we obtain accurate performances on French with a parser based on a Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar (Petrov et al., 2006).

AI.tldr: 本文评估了将法语句法词典Lexicon-Grammar中的数据整合到概率解析器中的效果，通过对法语树库中的动词应用聚类方法，基于概率上下文无关语法的解析器在法语上取得了准确性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用已有的法语句法词典资源（Lexicon-Grammar）来提升概率解析器对法语的解析性能。
AI.method: 将法语Lexicon-Grammar词典的数据整合到概率解析器中，对法语树库中的动词应用聚类方法，采用基于概率上下文无关语法（PCFG）的解析器。
AI.result: 基于PCFG的解析器在法语上取得了准确的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 将Lexicon-Grammar词典数据整合到概率解析器中，并结合动词聚类方法，能有效提升法语解析的准确性。

title: MOSAIC: Modular Orchestration for Structured Agentic Intelligence and Composition
summary: Automated data science is a structured model-selection problem. A solution must choose data transformations, feature representations, architecture, training procedure, evaluation protocol, and refinement strategy for a task. AutoML systems automate parts of this process, but typically search within predefined pipeline, model, and hyperparameter spaces. LLM-based agents offer greater flexibility through retrieval, code generation, and execution feedback, yet their modelling decisions are often unstructured, difficult to verify, and hard to reuse. We introduce \textsc{MOSAIC} (Modular Orchestration for Structured Agentic Intelligence and Composition), a structured agentic framework for memory-grounded model selection and workflow construction. Given a task and dataset, \textsc{MOSAIC} builds a semantic task profile, retrieves prior cases and source-code modules, and constructs a blueprint: an intermediate representation specifying selected modelling components, composition, interface constraints, and execution requirements. This blueprint turns model selection into a staged, context-grounded search and grounds LLM-based code generation in retrieved evidence rather than unconstrained synthesis. Candidate models are validated by execution and refined using diagnostic feedback, training traces, task metrics, and a failure-aware reinforcement learning policy. We instantiate \textsc{MOSAIC} on financial time-series forecasting and generation, where models must satisfy predictive accuracy, distributional fidelity, execution reliability, and downstream financial criteria such as risk and tail behaviour. Experiments against AutoML and agentic baselines show that \textsc{MOSAIC} improves task performance, execution success, and decision traceability, demonstrating the value of treating automated data science as structured, reusable, and execution-grounded model selection.

AI.tldr: 提出MOSAIC框架，将自动化数据科学转化为结构化、可复现、基于执行的模型选择过程，在金融时间序列任务中优于AutoML和智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AutoML系统搜索空间受限，LLM智能体虽灵活但决策非结构化、难验证、难复用，缺乏系统性的模型选择方法。
AI.method: 构建语义任务画像，检索历史案例与代码模块，生成蓝图（中间表示），基于执行反馈和强化学习策略进行验证与优化。
AI.result: 在金融时间序列预测与生成任务上，MOSAIC在任务性能、执行成功率和决策可追溯性方面均优于AutoML和智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: 自动化数据科学应被视作结构化、可复用的基于执行的模型选择过程，MOSAIC框架有效验证了这一方向。

title: LLM-Driven Co-Evolutionary Automated Heuristic Design for Bi-Component Coupled Combinatorial Optimization
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in Automated Heuristic Design (AHD), existing methods typically generate and evolve heuristics as a single operator or search strategy, limiting their ability to model strong coupling among multiple decision substructures in problems such as the Traveling Thief Problem (TTP) and the Traveling Purchaser Problem (TPP). In this work, we propose CoEvo-AHD, an LLM-driven dual-population co-evolutionary framework for automated heuristic design in coupled combinatorial optimization. Unlike prior methods that evolve individual heuristics in isolation, CoEvo-AHD leverages LLMs to co-evolve two closely related operator populations. A cooperative evaluation mechanism explicitly captures interactions between route and selection operators, while pairwise scoring and synergistic joint crossover help discover complementary operator logic for joint improvement across coupled decision subspaces. We further design a tool-invocation environment library that encapsulates frequently used core operations, such as local-search delta computation, into callable functions, enabling LLM-generated operators to use standardized interfaces instead of reimplementing inefficient and error-prone problem-specific loops. Experiments on TTP and TPP show that CoEvo-AHD automatically discovers cooperative heuristic combinations and achieves competitive solution quality against traditional heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoEvo-AHD，一种LLM驱动的双种群协同进化框架，用于解决耦合组合优化问题中的自动启发式设计，通过LLM协同进化两个密切相关的算子种群，并设计工具调用环境库提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的自动启发式设计方法通常将启发式作为单一算子或搜索策略进行演化，无法有效建模如旅行盗贼问题(TTP)和旅行采购问题(TPP)等耦合组合优化问题中多个决策子结构之间的强耦合关系。
AI.method: 提出CoEvo-AHD，采用LLM驱动的双种群协同进化框架，包括：1) 两个算子种群（路径算子和选择算子）协同进化；2) 合作评估机制显式捕获路径与选择算子之间的交互；3) 成对评分与协同联合交叉发现互补算子逻辑；4) 工具调用环境库封装常用核心操作（如局部搜索增量计算）为标准接口。
AI.result: 在TTP和TPP上的实验表明，CoEvo-AHD能够自动发现协作启发式组合，并达到与传统启发式方法竞争的解质量。
AI.conclusion: CoEvo-AHD通过LLM驱动的双种群协同进化框架，有效解决了耦合组合优化问题中多个决策子结构的协同优化，证明了利用LLM自动发现协作启发式的可行性。

title: FineVerify: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Fine-Grained Self-Verification for Agentic Search
summary: Agentic search requires language model agents to explore many sources and answer complex information-seeking questions. Scaling test-time compute is a promising way to improve these agents, but current approaches can fail, because correct answers are often sparse and score-based selection depends on model calibration. We propose FineVerify, a fine-grained self-verification framework that decomposes each question into checkable sub-questions, verifies sampled candidates against each sub-question, and selects the candidate with the highest aggregated score. This per-check structure turns selection into simpler local judgments and produces scores under the same explicit criteria. Across four agentic search benchmarks and two models, FineVerify consistently outperforms standard scaling baselines. With only four sampled trajectories, it improves GPT-5-mini by 8.2 accuracy points and Gemini-3-flash by 5.6% on average. With 12 samples, FineVerify enables GPT-5-mini to surpass frontier GPT-5 on BrowseComp-Plus. Beyond accuracy, FineVerify produces interpretable verification traces that help audit benchmark errors, suggesting broader applications for inspecting agentic search systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/XuZhao0/fineverify

title: Latent Reward Steering: An Adaptive Inference-Time Framework that Implicitly Promotes Cognitive Behaviors in Reasoning LLMs
summary: Strong reasoning depends not only on model knowledge but also on how effectively cognitive behaviors are deployed during generation. Existing methods often rely on explicit behavior-level control, making them insufficiently adaptive when failures and required corrections vary across reasoning states, tasks, and models. To this end, we propose Latent Reward Steering (LRS), an adaptive inference-time framework that promotes cognitive behaviors by optimizing the sparse-autoencoder (SAE) latent states that implicitly carry them. Rather than relying on predefined cognitive behaviors or steering directions derived from them, LRS trains a latent reward model on reasoning traces by final answer correctness to estimate the quality of intermediate latent states. During inference, reward gradients provide state-specific correction directions for fragile latent states, while a reward and confidence gate restricts intervention to states the reward signal flags as fragile. Experiments on multiple reasoning LLM backbones and benchmarks show that \ours consistently improves performance over various baselines, and post-hoc analyses further indicate that \ours implicitly promotes good cognitive behaviors that fix the original reasoning errors. Code is available at: https://github.com/jiakanglee/Latent-Reward-Steering.

AI.tldr: 提出潜在奖励引导（LRS）框架，通过在推理时优化稀疏自编码器（SAE）的潜在状态来隐式促进认知行为，自适应地修正推理错误，提升多模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有推理方法依赖显式的行为级控制，在面对不同推理状态、任务和模型时适应性不足，无法根据失败情况灵活调整。
AI.method: LRS训练一个潜在奖励模型，基于最终答案正确性评估中间潜在状态的质量；推理时利用奖励梯度提供状态特定的修正方向，并通过奖励与置信度门控机制仅对脆弱状态进行干预。
AI.result: 在多个推理LLM骨干和基准上，LRS一致优于各种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LRS能够隐式促进良好的认知行为，修复原始推理错误，且无需预定义行为或显式控制方向。

title: Beyond Static Gaussians: An Empirical Investigation of Architectural Paradigms for Dynamic 3D Scene Reconstruction
comment: Accepted in Journal of Computational Vision and Imaging Systems (JCVIS)
summary: Dynamic scene reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a compelling approach for representing evolving environments, yet understanding trade-offs between methodologies remains crucial. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of dynamic 3DGS methods, categorizing them into two paradigms: structure-guided methods employing auxiliary representations (deformation fields, canonical spaces, grids) to model temporal changes, and gaussian-centric methods encoding dynamics directly into primitives via continuous functions or 4D representations. We evaluate representative methods from both paradigms on the D-NeRF benchmark. Our findings reveal that structure-guided methods achieve superior reconstruction fidelity and compact model sizes, while gaussian-centric approaches demonstrate significantly higher rendering speeds enabling real-time performance, though with greater quality variability and potentially substantial storage overhead. This analysis highlights a fundamental trade-off between reconstruction quality/compactness versus rendering speed, providing insights to guide future research and application development in dynamic scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了动态3DGS方法的两大范式：结构引导方法（利用辅助表征建模时间变化）和高斯中心方法（将动力学直接编码到图元中）。实验表明，结构引导方法在重建质量和模型紧凑性上更优，而高斯中心方法渲染速度更快但质量波动大、存储开销高。
AI.motivation: 理解动态场景重建中不同方法之间的权衡取舍至关重要，现有研究缺乏对动态3DGS方法的系统性对比分析。
AI.method: 将动态3DGS方法分为两类：结构引导方法（基于变形场、规范空间、网格等辅助表征）和高斯中心方法（通过连续函数或4D表征直接编码动力学）。在D-NeRF基准上对两类方法的代表性工作进行评估。
AI.result: 结构引导方法重建保真度高、模型更紧凑；高斯中心方法渲染速度更快（支持实时性能），但质量波动大且存储开销可能很高。
AI.conclusion: 揭示出重建质量/紧凑性与渲染速度之间存在根本性权衡，为动态场景重建的未来研究和应用开发提供了指导。

title: OCC-RAG: Optimal Cognitive Core for Faithful Question Answering
summary: Recent progress in the development of language models has been defined by scale, with each generation absorbing more of the world's knowledge into its weights. However, many practical applications benefit more from robust reasoning than from extensive parametric knowledge. In this setting, task-specialized small language models (SLMs) offer a principled design choice. We introduce Optimal Cognitive Core (OCC), a family of SLMs built around this premise. As a variant of OCC, we present OCC-RAG, optimized for faithful question answering (QA) grounded in the provided context. This task directly aligns with the OCC design approach, requiring multi-hop reasoning over supplied passages while ignoring memorized knowledge. To train OCC-RAG, we implement a novel pipeline for synthesizing multi-context, multi-hop QA data at scale, producing a corpus of over three million examples targeting multi-hop reasoning, strict context faithfulness, and calibrated abstention. We release OCC-RAG-0.6B and OCC-RAG-1.7B, both mid-trained on this corpus. The models produce structured reasoning traces with source citations grounded in literal quotes from the context. Through OCC-RAG, we demonstrate that compact, task-specialized SLMs can match or exceed general-purpose models 2 -- 6x their size across multi-hop reasoning (HotpotQA, MuSiQue, TAT-QA), faithfulness (ConFiQA), and refusal (MuSiQue-Un) benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OCC-RAG，一种面向上下文忠实问答的专用小语言模型，通过合成300万+多跳推理数据训练，在多项基准上超越2-6倍大小的通用模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型依赖参数化知识，但在实际应用中，稳健的推理能力比海量知识更重要。因此需要设计任务专用的小语言模型，实现高效、忠实于上下文的推理。
AI.method: 提出Optimal Cognitive Core (OCC)框架及OCC-RAG变体，设计新型流水线合成超300万条多上下文、多跳问答数据，用于训练0.6B和1.7B参数的专用小模型，并生成带引用溯源的结构化推理轨迹。
AI.result: OCC-RAG在HotpotQA、MuSiQue、TAT-QA等多跳推理基准，以及ConFiQA忠实度基准和MuSiQue-Un拒答基准上，匹配或超越2-6倍大小的通用模型。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的任务专用小语言模型可通过针对性训练，在推理、忠实性和拒答能力上达到甚至超越大模型，验证了"小而专"的设计路线的可行性。

title: EPIC: Efficient and Parallel Inference under CFG Constraints for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Controlling language model outputs is essential for ensuring structural validity, reliability, and downstream usability, and diffusion language models are no exception. Recent advances in diffusion language model decoding have extended output control beyond regular constraints to context-free grammar (CFG) constraints. Existing methods, however, can be up to four times slower than unconstrained decoding. More importantly, they substantially diminish one of the key advantages of diffusion language models over autoregressive models, namely parallel decoding. This slowdown arises because sequential validity checking introduces significant overhead during parallel generation. We propose an efficient CFG-constrained decoding framework, EPIC, that addresses this limitation. Our method improves decoding efficiency by combining lexing memoization, validation using Earley-style parsing instead of deterministic automata, and relaxed compatible subset selection for parallel commit. It reduces repeated lexing and validation overhead while allowing multiple compatible tokens to be committed together. Experiments on three benchmarks using four models show that our method reduces inference time by up to 67.5% and decreases the additional overhead by up to 90.5% compared with existing CFG-constrained decoding methods. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/EPIC-Decoding.git .

AI.tldr: 提出EPIC框架，通过词法记忆化、Earley解析和松弛兼容子集选择，在扩散语言模型中实现高效CFG约束解码，相比现有方法推理时间降低67.5%，额外开销降低90.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有CFG约束解码方法在扩散语言模型上比无约束解码慢四倍，且严重削弱了扩散模型相对于自回归模型的并行解码优势。
AI.method: 结合词法记忆化（lexing memoization）、基于Earley解析的验证（替代确定性自动机）、以及松弛兼容子集选择（relaxed compatible subset selection）实现并行提交。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试、四个模型上，推理时间减少67.5%，额外开销降低90.5%。
AI.conclusion: EPIC框架有效解决了CFG约束下扩散语言模型的解码效率瓶颈，在保持约束满足的同时恢复了并行解码的优势。

title: SHARP: Sleep-based Hierarchical Accelerated Replay for Long Range Non-Stationary Temporal Pattern Recognition
summary: Learning long-range non-stationary temporal patterns remains a core challenge for modern sequence models, particularly in strict streaming settings. In these settings, data arrive sequentially and must be processed in a single pass without simultaneously revisiting past observations. Standard architectures, including recurrent neural networks and transformers, are constrained by either truncated backpropagation through time horizon or explicit input window length for long range credit assignment. To address these limitations, we propose SHARP (Sleep-based Hierarchical Accelerated Replay), a framework that decomposes temporal learning into two complementary components: a memory module that accumulates a structured history of past inputs, and a pattern-recognition module that operates over this memory. This separation enables resource- and compute-efficient adaptation to non-stationary dynamics by eliminating the need for backpropagation through time across many steps for long-range credit assignment. Inspired by the accelerated replay observed in rodents during slow-wave sleep, SHARP incorporates offline (sleep) phases in which temporally structured memory traces are replayed in an accelerated form and integrated into higher-level memory representations, improving long-range context retention. Through controlled simulations and ablation studies, we characterize the key properties of the proposed framework. In benchmark datasets such as text8 and PG-19, we demonstrate that SHARP improves over recurrent baselines by retaining next-token predictive performance on previously seen data while continuing to learn from the current stream and generalizing to future unseen data. These gains are enabled by its hierarchical structure, which yields an exponentially increasing effective temporal context with only linear-time computational cost.

AI.tldr: SHARP是一个受啮齿动物慢波睡眠中加速重播机制启发的框架，通过将记忆模块和模式识别模块分离，并结合离线"睡眠"阶段加速回放记忆痕迹，实现了在严格流式设置下对长程非平稳时序模式的高效学习，在text8和PG-19基准上优于循环基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有序列模型（如RNN和Transformer）在处理严格流式环境中的长程时序依赖时，受限于截断的BPTT时间步长或显式输入窗口长度，难以有效进行长程信用分配。
AI.method: 提出SHARP框架，包含两个互补组件：①记忆模块，积累结构化的历史输入；②模式识别模块，在记忆之上进行操作。通过引入离线"睡眠"阶段，以加速形式回放时序结构的记忆痕迹，并将其整合到更高级别的记忆表征中。
AI.result: 在text8和PG-19基准数据集上，SHARP在保留已有数据预测性能的同时，能够持续从当前流中学习并泛化到未来未见数据，优于循环基线模型。其层次结构实现了指数级增长的有效时序上下文，而计算成本仅为线性时间。
AI.conclusion: SHARP通过分离记忆与模式识别模块，并引入基于生物启发的离线重播机制，有效解决了严格流式设置下的长程非平稳时序学习难题，实现了高效的长程上下文保留与计算成本之间的平衡。

title: WaveFilter: Enhancing the Long-Context Capability of Diffusion LLMs via Wavelet-Guided KV Cache Filtering
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLMs) have demonstrated significant advantages across various tasks. However, constrained by their multi-step iterative inference mechanism, their computational overhead and inference latency in long-context tasks have become core bottlenecks restricting their large-scale deployment. When processing long sequences, existing Key-Value (KV) caching mechanisms often face a dilemma where generation quality degrades drastically, where the core challenge lies in precisely and efficiently filtering critical tokens within ultra-long contexts. Inspired by the human reading process, we propose \textbf{WaveFilter}, a universal and training-free caching framework. This framework innovatively introduces the wavelet transform for decomposition of long sequences to achieve precise identification of key tokens, based on which a sparse KV Cache is constructed to compute the final contextual representation. Experimental results demonstrate that WaveFilter, as a plug-and-play generic framework, significantly enhances the performance of existing mainstream KV Cache methods in complex long-context tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出WaveFilter，一种无训练的通用缓存框架，利用小波变换分解长序列精确识别关键token，构建稀疏KV缓存以提升长上下文任务中生成质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散大模型在多步迭代推理中计算开销大，现有KV缓存机制在处理长序列时生成质量严重下降，核心挑战在于如何精确高效地在超长上下文中筛选关键token。
AI.method: 受人类阅读过程启发，引入小波变换对长序列进行分解，精准识别关键token，并基于此构建稀疏KV缓存来计算最终上下文表示。该方法为即插即用的无训练通用框架。
AI.result: WaveFilter作为通用框架，显著提升了现有主流KV缓存方法在复杂长上下文任务中的性能。
AI.conclusion: WaveFilter通过小波变换实现了长序列中关键token的精确筛选，有效解决了扩散大模型在长上下文任务中计算开销大和生成质量下降的问题。

title: CoMIC: Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Cloud-Edge Systems
summary: Deploying lightweight Large Language Model (LLM) agents on edge servers can reduce latency and move agentic services closer to users, but resource-constrained edge models often struggle with long-horizon tasks that require persistent memory, subgoal tracking, and reflection. Fine-tuning edge models after deployment is costly and difficult to scale across heterogeneous nodes, while purely local memory leaves agents with isolated experience and growing prompt context. We propose \textsc{CoMIC}, a parameter-update-free cloud-edge framework for Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation. \textsc{CoMIC} follows a \textit{Centralized Reflection, Decentralized Execution} design: edge agents execute locally using subgoal-oriented hierarchical memory and selective re-expansion of relevant histories, while a cloud-side LLM critic asynchronously evaluates completed trajectories, filters reusable experience, and aggregates cross-agent guidance keyed by semantic subgoal identifiers. Across five long-horizon agent tasks spanning symbolic planning and text interaction, \textsc{CoMIC} improves progress rate and action grounding for weak edge agents and yields task-dependent success-rate gains without updating model parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出CoMIC框架，通过云侧集中反思、边侧分散执行的方式，让轻量级边缘LLM智能体在无需参数更新的情况下借助云侧批评者共享记忆和经验，提升长周期任务表现。
AI.motivation: 边缘服务器部署轻量LLM智能体能降低延迟，但资源受限的边缘模型难以处理需要持久记忆和子目标跟踪的长周期任务；微调代价高且难以跨异构节点扩展，纯本地记忆导致经验孤立。
AI.method: CoMIC采用"集中反思、分散执行"设计：边缘智能体本地执行并维护子目标导向的分层记忆与选择性历史重扩；云侧LLM批评者异步评估已完成轨迹、过滤可复用经验，按语义子目标标识聚合跨智能体指导。
AI.result: 在五个长周期智能体任务（涵盖符号规划与文本交互）上，CoMIC提升了弱边缘智能体的进度率和动作接地性，在无参数更新的情况下带来了任务相关的成功率增益。
AI.conclusion: CoMIC通过云边协作的记忆与洞察流通机制，在不更新模型参数的前提下有效增强了边缘轻量LLM智能体的长周期任务能力。

title: CodeCytos: AI-assisted spatial molecular imaging analysis via code-augmented agent action space
summary: Conventional tissue image analysis software provides foundational capabilities for cellular analysis, including segmentation, basic morphological feature extraction, and spatial organization analysis. However, these tools often require manual intervention and are not well integrated with code-driven automation, limiting efficiency and scalability for complex spatial tissue studies. In addition, they offer limited flexibility for custom analyses, as they typically support only a fixed set of pre-implemented spatial cellular features. To address these limitations, we propose CodeCytos, a coding-based reasoning agent framework that enables dynamic, programmable interaction with spatial molecular imaging data to improve automation and customization. CodeCytos is designed to streamline the exploration of custom spatial cellular features and adapt to diverse research needs. We demonstrate its utility through case studies on four expert-curated datasets from distinct tissue types: frontal cortex, non-small-cell lung cancer, pancreas, and tonsil. We evaluate CodeCytos under a realistic minimal prompt setting, where bioscientists pose simple questions without task-specific instructions or contextual information about spatial cellular analysis, and benchmark multiple LLM backbones with strong coding capabilities. We further show that incorporating tailored, domain-agnostic few-shot in-context coding-reasoning examples (randomly sampled demonstrations outside the spatial analysis domain) can substantially improve performance without requiring costly, expert-crafted in-domain demonstrations. Overall, CodeCytos outperforms baseline approaches, highlighting the potential of code-action agents to assist with custom feature exploration in spatial molecular imaging and to accelerate biomarker discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出了CodeCytos，一个基于编码的推理代理框架，通过动态可编程的空间分子影像数据分析，提升自动化和定制化能力，在四个不同组织数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统组织图像分析软件依赖手动干预、缺乏代码集成自动化、支持的空间细胞特征固定且有限，难以满足复杂空间组织研究对高效和可扩展性的需求。
AI.method: 构建CodeCytos框架，采用编码推理代理实现空间分子影像数据的动态可编程交互；在四种不同组织类型（额叶皮层、非小细胞肺癌、胰腺、扁桃体）数据集上评估；使用最小提示设置，以强编码能力的大语言模型为骨干，并引入领域无关的少样本上下文编码推理示例优化性能。
AI.result: 在真实最小提示设置下，CodeCytos优于基线方法；引入领域无关的少样本上下文编码推理示例（即使在空间分析领域外随机采样）可显著提升性能，无需昂贵的专家领域内示例。
AI.conclusion: CodeCytos展示了代码行为代理在空间分子影像定制化特征探索和加速生物标志物发现方面的潜力。

title: From Empathy to Personalized Empathy: Adapting Empathetic Strategies to Individual Users
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-term interactions with users, empathy has become an increasingly important capability. However, existing research overlooks the influence of users' personality traits on empathetic strategies during long-term interactions. To address this gap, we introduce the task of personalized empathy, which focuses on adapting empathetic strategies according to users' personalized characteristics derived from history. To study and enhance this capability, we construct PersonaEmp, a personalized empathy dataset built from long-term user-AI interactions, featuring rich user histories, persona information, and empathy-seeking queries. We further propose PereGRM, a reward modeling framework that combines the empathy evaluation structure with dynamic evaluation criteria generation for fine-grained reward modeling. Experimental results across different settings and multiple judge models show that PereGRM consistently achieves the strongest performance improvements, indicating its effectiveness for enhancing personalized empathetic capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化共情任务，构建了PersonaEmp数据集和PereGRM奖励建模框架，通过结合用户个性特征增强LLM在长期交互中的共情能力，实验证明该方法效果显著。
AI.motivation: 现有研究忽视了长期交互中用户个性特征对共情策略的影响，缺乏根据用户个性化特征调整共情策略的能力。
AI.method: 构建PersonaEmp个性化共情数据集（包含用户历史、画像信息和共情查询），提出PereGRM奖励建模框架（结合共情评估结构和动态评估标准生成进行细粒度奖励建模）。
AI.result: 在不同设置和多个评估模型下，PereGRM consistently取得了最强性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PereGRM能有效增强LLM的个性化共情能力，填补了现有研究在长期交互中考虑用户个性特征的空白。

title: FALAT: Tracing Failures in LLM Agent Trajectories via Dependency-Guided Search
summary:
LLM-based agents increasingly solve complex tasks through long trajectories involving reasoning steps, tool calls, and inter-agent communication. However, when these agents fail, it is often unclear which agent caused the failure and which step introduced the decisive error. This attribution problem is challenging because mistakes can propagate across the trajectory: later actions may appear incorrect, but only because they depend on an earlier corrupted state. Therefore, failure attribution cannot be treated as independent step-level classification.
  We propose FALAT, a diagnostic framework for failure attribution in LLM agent trajectories. FALAT frames attribution as a dependency-guided search problem. It first constructs an expectation of how the task should be solved and uses this expectation to identify suspicious regions in the trajectory. It then traces dependencies among decisions, tool outputs, and agent messages to distinguish error-introducing steps from steps that merely inherit or propagate prior mistakes. Finally, FALAT evaluates whether correcting a candidate step would be sufficient to recover the expected outcome, allowing it to identify both the responsible agent and the decisive failure step.
