  We evaluate FALAT on the Who&When benchmark, which includes both algorithm-generated and hand-crafted multi-agent failure trajectories. The results show that FALAT consistently improves responsible-agent and decisive-step attribution. Its best configurations achieve 46.0% step-level accuracy on algorithm-generated trajectories and 29.1% on the more challenging hand-crafted trajectories, outperforming specialized attribution baselines and direct prompting with standalone LLMs. These findings suggest that dependency-aware reasoning is essential for reliable failure diagnosis in LLM agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FALAT框架，通过依赖引导的搜索方法，为LLM智能体轨迹中的故障归因问题提供解决方案，在Who&When基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在执行长轨迹任务时经常失败，但难以确定是哪个智能体、哪一步引入了决定性错误，因为错误会沿依赖链传播，无法作为独立步骤分类。
AI.method: FALAT将故障归因建模为依赖引导的搜索问题：1）构建任务预期轨迹；2）识别可疑区域；3）追踪决策、工具输出和智能体消息之间的依赖关系，区分错误引入步骤与继承步骤；4）评估修正候选步骤是否足以恢复预期结果。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准上，FALAT在算法生成轨迹上达到46.0%的步骤级准确率，在手写轨迹上达到29.1%，优于专用归因基线和直接提示的独立LLM。
AI.conclusion: 依赖感知的推理对于LLM智能体系统的可靠故障诊断至关重要。

title: I-WebGenBench : Evaluating Interactivity in LLM-Generated Scientific Web Applications
summary: Recent advances in visual language models have enabled autonomous agents for complex reasoning, tool use, and document understanding. However, existing document agents mainly transform papers into static artifacts such as summaries, webpages, or slides, which are insufficient for technical papers involving dynamic mechanisms and state transitions. In this work, we propose a Paper-to-Interactive-System Agent that converts research papers into executable interactive web systems. Given a PDF paper, the agent performs end-to-end processing without human intervention, including paper understanding, system modeling, and interactive webpage synthesis, enabling users to manipulate inputs and observe dynamic behaviors. To evaluate this task, we introduce a benchmark of 19 research papers paired with expert-built interactive systems as ground truth. We further propose PaperVoyager, a structured generation framework that explicitly models mechanisms and interaction logic during synthesis. Experiments show that PaperVoyager significantly improves the quality of generated interactive systems, offering a new paradigm for interactive scientific paper understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaperVoyager，一种将科研论文自动转化为可交互网页系统的智能体框架，包含端到端的论文理解、系统建模与网页合成能力，并建立了包含19篇论文的基准测试集。
AI.motivation: 现有文档智能体仅将论文转化为静态摘要、网页或幻灯片，无法呈现技术论文中的动态机制和状态转换过程，缺乏交互式理解工具。
AI.method: 提出Paper-to-Interactive-System Agent，实现端到端的论文理解、系统建模与交互式网页合成；并提出PaperVoyager结构化生成框架，显式建模论文中的机制与交互逻辑。
AI.result: 实验结果表明PaperVoyager显著提升了生成交互系统的质量，能够有效将论文转化为可操作的动态交互系统。
AI.conclusion: PaperVoyager为交互式科学论文理解提供了新范式，使读者能操控输入并观察动态行为，突破了传统静态展示的局限。

title: Interaction-Centered Intelligence: Toward Interaction as the Primary Unit of Analysis in Co-Creative AI and Human-AI Systems
summary: Traditional artificial intelligence has largely conceptualized intelligence as isolated computation occurring within bounded agents. Across classical AI, machine learning, and many generative systems, the dominant unit of analysis remains the individual model or autonomous system evaluated through outputs, benchmarks, prediction accuracy, or optimization performance. While these approaches have produced major advances, they often under-theorize the role of interaction in the emergence of intelligence, creativity, meaning, and adaptive behavior. This paper proposes interaction as the primary unit of analysis for co-creative AI and interaction-centered intelligence more broadly. Drawing from distributed cognition, embodied cognition, enaction, participatory sense-making, human-computer interaction, and computational creativity, the paper traces a historical progression toward increasingly relational accounts of intelligence. Building upon prior work in Creative Sense-Making, quantified co-creation, and co-creative systems such as the Drawing Apprentice and AI Drawing Partner, it argues that intelligence emerges through evolving interaction dynamics among agents, environments, and socio-technical systems rather than solely through internal computation. The paper introduces Interaction-Centered Intelligence as a framework for understanding human-AI co-creation, collaborative emergence, adaptive participation, and interactional dynamics. Rather than evaluating intelligence solely through generated outputs, the framework emphasizes interaction trajectories, coordination patterns, participatory engagement, adaptive regulation, and interactional drift unfolding through time. Implications for explainable co-creative AI, hybrid intelligence, enactive AI, and future human-AI systems are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以“交互”作为AI智能的核心分析单元，认为智能不是孤立计算的结果，而是在人、环境与社会技术系统的动态交互中涌现的。论文基于分布式认知、具身认知、生成认知、参与式意义建构、人机交互与计算创意学等理论，提出了“交互中心智能”框架，强调交互轨迹、协调模式、参与投入、自适应调节与交互漂移等概念，为可解释共创AI、混合智能与生成式AI提供了新的理论视角。
AI.motivation: 传统AI将智能视为有界智能体内部的孤立计算，忽视了交互在智能、创造力、意义与适应性行为涌现中的关键作用。目前主流的评估方式（输出结果、基准测试、预测准确率等）未能充分理论化交互过程的重要性。
AI.method: 论文通过理论综述与历史脉络梳理，整合分布式认知、具身认知、生成认知、参与式意义建构、人机交互与计算创意学等多学科视角，并基于Creative Sense-Making、量化共创、Drawing Apprentice与AI Drawing Partner等前期工作，构建了“交互中心智能”的理论框架。
AI.result: 提出了交互中心智能框架，将评估重点从生成输出转向交互轨迹、协调模式、参与投入、自适应调节与交互漂移等随时间展开的动态过程。
AI.conclusion: 交互中心智能为可解释共创AI、混合智能、生成式AI与未来人机系统提供了新的理论方向，强调智能研究需要从计算中心范式转向交互中心范式。

title: Internalize the Temperature: On-Policy Self-Distillation as Policy Reheater for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards improves the reasoning ability of large language models, but often suffers from entropy collapse, in which increasingly concentrated policies reduce rollout diversity and useful learning signals. Existing remedies either constrain the RL objective (e.g., entropy regularization) or adjust sampling temperature during rollout collection, but these interventions remain external to the model parameters. We propose Temperature-Scaled On-Policy Self-Distillation (TS-OPSD), a lightweight policy reheating method that internalizes the exploratory effect of temperature into model parameters. Starting from an entropy-collapsed RL checkpoint, TS-OPSD constructs a self-teacher by applying high-temperature scaling to the model's own logits, then distills the resulting smoother distribution back into the student. This policy reheating requires no external teacher, privileged data, or additional inference cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base show that policy reheating yields a stronger initialization for continued RL than both standard continued RL and rollout-level temperature reheating. Further analyses show that TS-OPSD mainly reduces output sharpness while preserving intermediate representations, top candidate sets, and reasoning capability. These results suggest that entropy restoration can serve as a simple post-collapse intervention for extending reasoning-oriented RL.

AI.tldr: 提出TS-OPSD方法，通过高温缩放自蒸馏对熵崩溃的RL检查点进行策略再加热，在不增加推理成本的前提下恢复策略熵，提升大语言模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习从可验证奖励中提升LLM推理能力，但常遭遇熵崩溃（策略集中化导致 rollout 多样性下降），现有方法（如熵正则化、调整采样温度）均属外部干预，未内化到模型参数中。
AI.method: 从熵崩溃的RL检查点出发，对模型自身logits施加高温缩放构造自教师，将更平滑的分布蒸馏回学生模型，实现策略再加热，无需外部教师或额外推理成本。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base上，TS-OPSD作为继续RL的初始化优于标准继续RL和rollout级温度再加热；主要降低输出尖锐度，保留中间表示、候选集和推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 熵恢复可作为推理导向RL中一种简单的崩溃后干预手段，有效扩展RL训练寿命。

title: NBQ: Next-Best-Question for Dynamic Profiling
summary: Many real-world conversational settings for knowledge discovery, including podcasts, hiring screens, and marketplaces, require a purpose-driven understanding of a person. We study the Next-Best-Question (NBQ) problem: at each turn, an interviewer should ask the question with the highest expected information gain given what has already been learned and the conversation goal. We propose NBQ, a plug-and-play framework that seeds a diverse pool of candidate questions, maintains a compact and continuously updated user state, adaptively selects the next question within a turn budget, and distills the resulting free-form dialogue into a structured vector-based user profile. As a demanding application, we instantiate NBQ for reciprocal matchmaking, where compatibility must be mutual and each person is modeled by both self-description and counterpart-preference representations. To support large-scale matching, we further introduce QuickMatch, an efficient retrieval layer that recasts reciprocal matching from quadratic pairwise scoring to approximate vector search. Experiments show that NBQ improves user profiling quality by up to 13.6% and 14.0% in AC@T and AR@T, respectively, while QuickMatch accelerates retrieval by up to 22.9x with recall up to 0.989.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NBQ框架，通过自适应提问策略在对话中高效构建用户画像，并引入QuickMatch加速双向匹配检索，显著提升用户建模质量和检索效率。
AI.motivation: 在播客、招聘面试、市场匹配等真实对话场景中，需要基于对话目的动态理解用户，但现有方法缺乏有效的自适应提问策略来最大化信息获取效率。
AI.method: 提出NBQ框架：种子问题池生成、紧凑用户状态维护、自适应下一最佳问题选择、对话蒸馏为向量化用户画像；并引入QuickMatch将双向匹配从二次方打分转换为近似向量搜索。
AI.result: NBQ在用户画像质量上AC@T提升13.6%，AR@T提升14.0%；QuickMatch加速检索22.9倍，召回率高达0.989。
AI.conclusion: NBQ框架在对话式用户建模中表现优异，QuickMatch高效解决了大规模双向匹配的检索效率问题，具有较好的实用价值。

title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
summary: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.

AI.tldr: OptiWorld将经典最优控制引入视频生成过程，通过提取紧凑世界状态、规划最优轨迹、基于轨迹渲染视频，使生成视频的物理动态更优。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽然能生成合理的运动，但无法主动控制或优化底层动态，导致生成的物体轨迹可能存在不安全、不平滑、低效或物理不一致的问题。
AI.method: 首先提取紧凑的任务相关世界状态，然后在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最后基于该轨迹条件化渲染视频；将规划问题形式化为连续流形上的几何问题，统一3D几何与任务相关物理约束。
AI.result: 在目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动态编辑、反事实生成等多个任务上展现了生成更优动态视频的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 通过添加最优控制层，OptiWorld能够生成具有更优动力学的视频，有效提升了视频生成的可控性和物理一致性。

title: Not All Flips Are Conformity: Decomposing Stance Convergence in Multi-Agent LLM Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is a promising strategy for improving LLM reasoning, but when agents converge on a shared answer, it is unclear whether that convergence reflects genuine deliberation or social compliance. We show that the conventional answer flip rate conflates three distinct mechanisms: spontaneous instability, stance-induced conformity, and reasoning-induced persuasion. Our three-source decomposition framework isolates each through controlled counterfactual conditions. In the primary MMLU-Pro setting, 37% of agent-question observations change under self-reflection alone, while robustness tests show substantial model-dependent instability across GPQA-Diamond and three model families; strict conformity is 29% in the primary setting and remains predominantly harmful across model replications (57-77% correct-to-wrong). A controlled information-gradient experiment reveals that even vacuous reasoning is associated with 20-39% error adoption among resistant agents, with reasoning-like presentation carrying substantial persuasive weight. Harmful conformity can be predicted from Round 0 features (AUC = 0.79), and risk-targeted intervention reduces it by 13.6 percentage points (p < 0.001). However, without correctness labels or self-reflection controls, reducing peer adoption does not improve accuracy, because harmful and beneficial influence cannot be distinguished.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三源分解框架揭示了多智能体辩论中存在有害的社会从众效应（29%），且空泛推理也会导致20-39%的错误采纳，提出可预测的有害从众干预方法，但指出无监督条件下难以区分有益与有害影响。
AI.motivation: 现有MAD方法无法区分智能体收敛于共享答案到底是源于真实推理还是社会从众行为，需要系统解耦不同机制。
AI.method: 提出三源分解框架（自发不稳定性、立场诱导从众、推理诱导说服），通过反事实条件控制实验、信息梯度实验和Round 0特征预测构建干预方法。
AI.result: 37%的观测在自反下改变；严格从众率为29%，其中57-77%是从正确变为错误；空泛推理导致20-39%错误采纳；AUC=0.79预测有害从众，干预减少13.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有害从众可被预测和干预，但缺乏正确标签和监督条件下无法区分有益与有害影响，因此单纯减少从众并不能提升准确率。

title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Language Models Via Decoder Layer Skipping
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse natural language tasks, yet their outputs often suffer from hallucinations -- content that is misaligned with factual information. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive layer-wise analysis of the decoding process and reveal that hallucinations tend to originate from deeper decoder layers. To address this issue, we introduce \textbf{DeLask} (\textbf{De}coder \textbf{La}yer \textbf{Sk}ipping), a novel decoding framework that dynamically skips layers prone to producing hallucinations. DeLask leverages the theoretical insight that the forward computation of an $L$-layer Transformer is conditionally equivalent to $L$ steps of gradient descent. We define a \emph{driftance value} by computing the cosine similarity between gradients derived from consecutive decoder steps, identifying problematic layers when the descent direction reverses. Rather than discarding such layers entirely, DeLask partially aggregates their hidden states with preceding layers, thereby preserving consistency while suppressing erroneous signals. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that DeLask consistently mitigates hallucinations and enhances overall reliability, providing a lightweight and generalizable decoding framework for improving the robustness of large-scale language models.

AI.tldr: 提出DeLask解码框架，通过动态跳过易产生幻觉的深层解码器层来减轻大语言模型的幻觉问题，利用梯度下降的理论等价性定义漂移值，部分聚合隐藏状态以保持一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM输出常出现幻觉（与事实不符的内容），现有方法缺乏对解码过程中幻觉产生机制的系统分析。
AI.method: 1. 逐层分析解码过程，发现幻觉源自深层解码器层；2. 基于L层Transformer前向计算等价于L步梯度下降的理论，定义漂移值（余弦相似度）；3. 动态跳过下降方向反转的问题层，部分聚合其隐藏状态与前层。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和基准测试上，DeLask持续减轻幻觉，提升整体可靠性。
AI.conclusion: DeLask是一种轻量级、可泛化的解码框架，能有效提升大规模语言模型的鲁棒性。

title: V-LynX: Token Interface Alignment for Video+X LLMs
summary: This study introduces an intriguing phenomenon in Video LLMs: rather than merely translating frames into textual embeddings, Video LLMs establish a continuous manifold, token interface, allowing visual tokens to operate as standalone entities within the architecture. Exploiting this discovery, we propose V-LynX, a scalable framework that integrates novel modalities into Video LLMs by repurposing the internalized interface. Departing from conventional paradigms that necessitate heavy modality-specific encoders or paired supervision, V-LynX employs a lightweight auxiliary pathway in parallel with the frozen vision encoder. Our method integrates new sensory inputs with intrinsic video priors by aligning both attention responses and statistical distributions using unpaired unimodal data sets. This ensures manifold compatibility while preserving the integrity of the Video LLMs. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that V-LynX achieves SOTA and efficiency across audio-visual QA, 3D reasoning, high-frame-rate, and multi-view video understanding. The code is available at https://github.com/park-jungin/lynx.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Video LLMs中存在一个连续的流形接口（token interface），使视觉token可作为独立实体运作。基于此，提出V-LynX框架，通过轻量级辅助路径将新模态（如音频、3D等）集成到Video LLMs中，仅需未配对单模态数据即可实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Video LLMs在引入新模态时通常需要繁重的专用编码器或成对监督数据，效率低且扩展性差。本文旨在发现Video LLMs内部存在一个通用的token接口流形，并利用该特性实现轻量化、可扩展的多模态融合。
AI.method: 1) 发现Video LLMs中存在连续的token接口流形，视觉token可独立发挥作用；2) 提出V-LynX，采用轻量级辅助路径与冻结的视觉编码器并行；3) 通过对齐注意力响应和统计分布，利用未配对的单模态数据将新模态与视频先验融合，确保流形兼容性。
AI.result: 在音频-视觉问答、3D推理、高帧率视频理解、多视角视频理解等多个基准上取得SOTA结果，同时保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: V-LynX证明了一种新颖且高效的多模态集成范式：利用Video LLMs内部已有的token接口流形，无需成对数据或重型编码器即可扩展新模态，为Video LLMs的通用多模态能力提供了可扩展方案。

title: Momento: Evaluating Persistent Memory and Reasoning with Multi-Session Agentic Conversations
summary: Recent advances in agentic AI have enabled agents to complete complex tasks through tool use, reasoning, and multi-step planning. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate agents within a single session, ignoring past actions, stated preferences, and prior decisions that agents must integrate to fulfill personalized user goals. We introduce Momento, a benchmark for persistent agentic task completion in multi-session service environments, requiring agents to take consequential, tool-mediated actions while resolving temporal dependencies and evolving user goals across sessions. Experimental results reveal that current agents fail primarily through misestimation of user state, treating prior session history as a reliable proxy for current context rather than stale information requiring re-validation, highlighting a substantial gap between current agent capabilities and realistic long-horizon human-agent interaction.

AI.tldr: Momento是一个评估智能体在多会话服务环境中完成持久性任务能力的基准测试，现有智能体因错误估计用户状态而表现不佳，无法正确处理跨会话的时间依赖性和动态用户目标。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅在单会话内评估智能体，忽略了智能体需整合过去行为、偏好和决策来实现个性化用户目标的现实需求。
AI.method: 构建Momento基准，要求智能体在多会话服务环境中执行工具介导的操作，处理跨会话的时间依赖性和演变的用户目标。
AI.result: 当前智能体失败的主要原因是误判用户状态——将先前会话历史视为当前上下文的可靠代理，而非需要重新验证的过时信息。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体能力与现实长时程人机交互之间存在显著差距，亟需提升智能体在持久化任务中的状态感知与信息验证能力。

title: Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where language models can transmit behavioral traits to other models through seemingly innocuous data (Cloud et al., 2025). In subliminal learning, a teacher model with a behavioral trait (e.g. obsession with cats) can transmit this cat obsession to a student model finetuned only on numerical sequences generated by the teacher. In this paper, we ask: how does this unexpected behavioral transmission occur? We show that subliminal learning is a LoRA artifact. When subliminal learning occurs, transmission has an inverted U-shaped relationship with LoRA rank; it also disappears with full finetuning. We show that subliminal learning is highly dependent on the context seen during finetuning and evaluation. For example, a Qwen model with the default system prompt during finetuning ("You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.") does not show subliminal learning during generation when no system prompt is included. We further demonstrate that subliminal behavior is localized to computation at tokens seen during both finetuning and evaluation (e.g. the model's default system prompt, the standard chat template tokens, etc.). Overall, subliminal learning seems to be a fragile artifact of LoRA hyperparameters and finetuning context, making it an unstable channel for behavioral transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文发现潜学习（Subliminal Learning）是LoRA微调产生的脆弱伪影，行为传递与LoRA秩呈倒U型关系，且高度依赖微调和评估上下文，并非稳定的行为传播渠道。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在潜学习现象中（教师模型通过看似无害的数值序列将行为特征传递给学生模型）的行为传递机制。
AI.method: 通过实验分析潜学习与LoRA秩的关系、与全参数微调的对比、以及微调和评估上下文对潜学习的影响。
AI.result: 潜学习是LoRA伪影，与LoRA秩呈倒U型关系，全参数微调下消失；行为传递高度依赖微调和评估时出现的上下文（如系统提示、聊天模板token等）。
AI.conclusion: 潜学习是LoRA超参数和微调上下文的脆弱伪影，并非稳定的行为传播渠道。

title: Structure-Aware Consistency Priors for Shape from Polarization in Complex Media
summary: Recovering surface normals from single view polarization images in complex media remains challenging. This paper focuses on ice as a representative complex medium, where intricate light matter interactions lead to a nonlinear mapping between polarization observations and surface normals. To address this, a structure-aware polarization prior based on autocorrelation functions is proposed to capture the local spatial consistency of AoLP. Building on this, a dual-branch network (IceSfP) is designed to integrate raw polarization features with priors via cross modal attention and multi-scale feature fusion, enabling accurate surface normal estimation under complex media conditions. To evaluate the method, the first real-world ice SfP dataset is constructed. Experimental results show that the method outperforms existing approaches across all metrics, achieving a MAE of 16.01 deg, which is 2.74 deg lower than the second-best method. The framework provides a generalizable solution for high-precision geometric perception in complex media.

AI.tldr: 本文针对复杂介质（以冰为例）中单视角偏振图像恢复表面法线的难题，提出基于自相关函数的结构感知偏振先验，并设计了双分支网络IceSfP，通过跨模态注意力与多尺度特征融合，在自建真实冰SfP数据集上达到MAE 16.01°的领先性能。
AI.motivation: 复杂介质（如冰）中光与物质的相互作用复杂，导致偏振观测与表面法线之间存在非线性映射关系，现有方法难以准确恢复表面法线。
AI.method: 提出基于自相关函数的结构感知偏振先验以捕获AoLP的局部空间一致性，并设计双分支网络IceSfP，通过跨模态注意力和多尺度特征融合整合原始偏振特征与先验信息。
AI.result: 在自建真实冰SfP数据集上，该方法在所有指标上超越现有方法，MAE为16.01°，比第二名低2.74°。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为复杂介质中的高精度几何感知提供了一种可泛化的解决方案。

title: IDEAFix: Evaluation Framework for Creative Defixation Prompting in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tasks involving creative problem solving and idea generation. However, there is a lack of consensus concerning their creative capabilities: some studies report superior performances compared to humans, while others highlight structural limitations such as fixation and the homogenization of outputs. Existing evaluation approaches either rely on narrow, decontextualized tasks that do not capture goal-oriented generation or on broader settings that confound multiple aspects of the creative process, making it difficult to isolate the effects of task formulation, prompting, and evaluation design. Significantly, the role of structured prompting strategies in shaping idea generation remains underexplored. Therefore, we introduce IDEAFix, an evaluation framework for analyzing divergent thinking in open-ended idea generation tasks. We prompt models to generate multiple original solutions to controlled variations of short design scenarios, task attributes, and defixation prompting strategies. This design enables systematic analysis of how structured guidance influences LLMs' idea generation. Our results show that both task formulation and attribute selection significantly affect models' performance, and that simple prompting strategies can boost the originality of solutions. However, we also observe persistent output homogenization across models, confirming inherent limits in their ability to generate diverse solutions. Overall, IDEAFix provides a controlled, extensible framework for studying the mechanisms underlying LLMs' creativity.

AI.tldr: IDEAFix是一个评估LLMs在开放式创意任务中发散性思维的分析框架，研究发现任务公式化和属性选择显著影响模型表现，简单提示策略可提升原创性，但模型输出仍存在同质化问题。
AI.motivation: 当前对LLMs创造能力的评估存在分歧，缺乏统一的评估方法：有的任务过于狭窄脱离上下文，有的任务过于宽泛混淆多个变量。特别是结构化提示策略对创意生成的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了IDEAFix评估框架，通过控制设计场景、任务属性和去固定化提示策略的变体，让模型生成多个原创解决方案，系统分析结构化引导如何影响LLMs的想法生成。
AI.result: 任务公式化和属性选择显著影响模型表现；简单的提示策略能提升解决方案的原创性；但模型输出仍存在持续的同质化问题，表明LLMs在生成多样化解决方案方面存在固有限制。
AI.conclusion: IDEAFix提供了一个可控、可扩展的框架，用于研究LLMs创造力背后的机制。

title: Decoupled Behavioral Cloning for Scalable Inductive Generalization in RL from Specifications
summary: Inductive generalization is a framework for reinforcement learning (RL) generalization in which inductively related task instances admit inductively related policies. Prior work captures this structure via a higher-order policy-evolution function learned directly with RL, but suffers from poor training scalability: as training tasks grow, aggregated reward feedback becomes noisy and conflicting, destabilizing training and weakening generalization. We propose DIBS, a decoupled behavioral cloning approach that separates learning task-specific policies from learning the evolution function. We first learn individual teacher policies per task via standard RL, then fit the evolution function via behavioral cloning on teacher-labeled state-action pairs. This replaces noisy reward aggregation with dense, stable supervision. DIBS achieves significant improvements in both training stability and zero-shot generalization against existing RL and meta-RL algorithms.

AI.tldr: DIBS通过将任务特定策略学习与进化函数学习解耦，采用行为克隆替代奖励聚合，显著提升了归纳泛化在强化学习中的训练稳定性和零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有归纳泛化方法通过高阶策略进化函数学习，但随着训练任务增加，聚合奖励反馈变得嘈杂且冲突，导致训练不稳定和泛化能力下降。
AI.method: 提出DIBS方法：先通过标准RL为每个任务独立学习教师策略，再基于教师标注的状态-动作对，通过行为克隆拟合进化函数，用密集稳定的监督信号替代嘈杂的奖励聚合。
AI.result: DIBS在训练稳定性和零样本泛化方面较现有RL和元RL算法有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 解耦学习范式能有效解决大规模训练任务下的奖励噪声问题，为强化学习归纳泛化提供更稳定高效的方案。

title: An Effective Solution for the CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3
summary: In this work, we present our solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence (DOST). Our method is built upon the strong baseline framework Segment Any Motion (SegAnyMo), which provides powerful mask generation and motion tracking capabilities. To further boost the segmentation performance under severe atmospheric distortions, we propose two key improvements. First, we employ a data-centric domain adaptation strategy. We significantly expand our training data by incorporating selected sequences from the DAVIS dataset alongside a subset of the DOST dataset, and apply simulated atmospheric fluctuation degradations to enhance the model's robustness against complex geometric distortions. Second, we introduce a spatio-temporal post-processing module. This refinement step effectively removes persistent boundary-connected false foregrounds and short-lived fragmented noise, while strictly preserving genuine small targets and maintaining original individual labels across frames. With these combined strategies, our proposed method ranks the 2st place in the challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合数据域自适应与时空后处理的方法，用于解决大气湍流下的动态目标分割问题，在UG2+挑战赛中取得第二名。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在严重大气畸变（如湍流导致的几何扭曲）下对动态目标的分割性能不足，亟需提升模型在复杂失真环境中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基于SegAnyMo基线框架，提出两项改进：1）数据域自适应：引入DAVIS和DOST子集，并施加模拟大气波动退化来增强数据多样性；2）时空后处理模块：消除边界连接的假前景和短时碎片噪声，同时保留真实小目标及原始标签一致性。
AI.result: 该方法在CVPR 2026 UG2+挑战赛Track 3中获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强与时空后处理结合能有效提升湍流场景下的动态目标分割性能，验证了域自适应策略在真实世界退化环境中的有效性。

title: Chunking Methods on Retrieval-Augmented Generation - Effectiveness Evaluation Against Computational Cost and Limitations
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has demonstrated significant capabilities in enhancing the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). One of the key tasks in RAG systems is the chunking process. Traditionally, fixed-size chunking and semantic chunking have been the standard approaches. However, interest in chunking strategies has been increasing, leading to a growing number of proposed methods that often claim improved performance over these conventional techniques. Many of these approaches are tailored to specific use cases and data types, with limited evidence of their effectiveness across diverse scenarios. As a result, it remains challenging to directly compare different techniques and assess their relative strengths. To the best of our knowledge, this study is the first to systematically evaluate the effectiveness of a wide range of chunking methods and emphasize the underlying challenges of chunking strategies in RAG systems. While chunking is commonly treated as a simple preprocessing step, we show that it introduces a range of impactful and often overlooked issues.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了RAG系统中多种分块方法的有效性，揭示分块策略存在被忽视的关键问题，且现有方法缺乏跨场景通用性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统中的分块方法虽然越来越多，但大多针对特定场景设计，缺乏系统性比较和跨场景有效性验证，导致难以评估不同技术的相对优劣。
AI.method: 首次对多种分块方法进行系统性评估，对比传统固定大小分块、语义分块与新兴方法在不同场景下的表现。
AI.result: 发现分块作为预处理步骤实际上引入了许多有影响但常被忽视的问题，且现有方法在多样化场景下的有效性证据有限。
AI.conclusion: 分块策略在RAG系统中并非简单的预处理步骤，其带来的问题值得关注，需要更统一的评估框架来指导分块方法的选择。

title: Certificate-Guided Evaluation of Reinforcement Learning Generalization
summary:
This work presents a logic-driven framework to evaluate the performance of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms in their ability to generalize to unseen tasks. Our framework defines a family of inductive reach-avoid tasks, characterized by structural similarities in task dynamics, enabling evaluation of generalization capabilities. We introduce a neural certificate function that validates trajectories generated by RL algorithms by enforcing key conditions, thereby serving as a litmus test for RL generalization. We empirically demonstrate our method's capability in certifying generalization for several state-of-the-art generalizable RL algorithms on challenging continuous environments.
  Our results show that a lower percentage of certificate function violations correlates with a higher number of test tasks successfully solved, highlighting the effectiveness of our framework in evaluating and distinguishing generalization capabilities of RL algorithms. This work provides a principled approach for benchmarking RL generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于逻辑驱动的框架，通过神经证书函数验证强化学习算法在未见任务上的泛化能力，实验表明证书违规率越低，算法解决测试任务的成功率越高。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习算法在泛化到未见任务方面的评估缺乏系统性和原则性方法，亟需一种能够可靠衡量RL算法泛化能力的框架。
AI.method: 定义了具有结构相似性的归纳可达-避让任务族，引入神经证书函数对RL算法生成的轨迹施加关键条件验证，作为泛化能力的测试标准。
AI.result: 证书函数违规率与测试任务成功率呈负相关，能够有效区分不同最先进RL算法的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为RL泛化性能的基准测试提供了一种原则性方法。

title: ETC: Extreme Token Compression via Task-aware Visual Information Distillation in VLMs
summary: In Vision-Language Models (VLMs), high-resolution images produce a large number of visual tokens, resulting in high computational costs and KV-cache overhead during inference. To address this problem, we propose an Extreme Token Compression (ETC) framework that minimizes task loss when reducing the number of input tokens based on the principle of variational information distillation. Specifically, from an information-theoretic perspective, we show that minimizing task loss requires the compact representation to preserve the instruction-aware sufficient statistic of the task-relevant visual information for prediction. In practice, ETC leverages text-to-image cross-attention to weight the original visual features to approximate the latent instruction-aware predictive statistic. Moreover, ETC introduces a variational information distillation, enabling the compact representation to preserve the essential information to recover this predictive statistic. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-2B show that ETC remains effective even under single-token compression, substantially reducing KV-cache overhead while retaining strong task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出极端令牌压缩（ETC）框架，基于变分信息蒸馏原则，在视觉-语言模型中将高分辨率图像压缩至极少视觉令牌（甚至单令牌），显著降低KV缓存开销的同时保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视觉-语言模型生成大量视觉令牌，导致高计算成本和KV缓存开销，亟需有效的令牌压缩方法。
AI.method: 基于变分信息蒸馏原理，从信息论角度证明最小化任务损失需保留指令感知的充分统计量；利用文本-图像交叉注意力加权原始视觉特征近似潜在统计量，并通过变分信息蒸馏使压缩表示保留恢复该统计量所需信息。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-2B上验证，即使在单令牌压缩下仍有效，大幅降低KV缓存开销的同时保持强任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ETC框架在极端压缩比下仍能保持任务性能，为高效VLM推理提供了有效方案。

title: Citation Grounding: Detecting and Reducing LLM Citation Hallucinations via Legal Citation Graphs
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/citation-grounding-eval
summary: Large language models systematically hallucinate legal citations -- fabricating statute references, citing repealed provisions, and confusing jurisdictions -- yet no automated method exists to measure or reduce this behavior at scale. We propose citation grounding (CG), a metric that verifies LLM-generated legal citations against a ground-truth citation graph extracted from 100.8 million Ukrainian court decisions (502 million edges, 21,736 unique statute nodes). CG decomposes into three components -- citation precision (does the cited provision exist?), citation relevance (is it contextually appropriate?), and citation temporality (was it valid at the relevant date?) -- enabling differential diagnosis of hallucination types. Empirical evaluation on 100 Ukrainian legal queries across five systems -- four commercial LLMs via AWS Bedrock (Claude Haiku 4.5, Mistral Pixtral Large, Amazon Nova Pro/Lite) and one RAG-augmented production system -- reveals CG ranging from 0.791 to 0.873, with 13-21% of citations hallucinated. To reduce hallucinations without human annotation, we introduce Citation Grounding DPO (CG-DPO): a method that constructs preference pairs algorithmically by corrupting verified citations from real court decisions via four targeted strategies. On a dataset of 2,244 court decisions, a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model fine-tuned with LoRA achieves 98.5% mean validation accuracy in distinguishing correct from corrupted citations (rewards margin +14.9, std < 0.3 pp across 3 seeds). The citation graph, evaluation framework, and CG-DPO dataset are released as open resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化的法律引用验证方法（Citation Grounding, CG），用于检测和减少大模型在法律引用中的幻觉问题，并在此基础上提出CG-DPO方法通过算法构造偏好对来减少幻觉，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 大模型在生成法律引用时系统性地产生幻觉（编造法规、引用已废止条款、混淆司法管辖区），但目前缺乏自动化的方法来衡量和减少这一行为。
AI.method: 提出Citation Grounding (CG)度量，包含引用精确性、相关性和时效性三个维度；基于1.008亿份乌克兰法院判决构建引用图谱；提出CG-DPO方法，通过四种策略破坏真实判决中的引用，构造偏好对进行DPO微调。
AI.result: 在100个乌克兰法律查询上，5个系统的CG得分为0.791-0.873，13-21%的引用存在幻觉；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct经LoRA微调后，区分正确与错误引用的验证准确率达98.5%，奖励边际+14.9。
AI.conclusion: Citation grounding framework和CG-DPO方法有效量化并减少了法律引用幻觉，相关数据集和代码已开源。

title: CAFOSat: A Strongly Annotated Dataset for Infrastructure-Aware CAFO Mapping Using High-Resolution Imagery
comment: Accepted at CVPR Workshop-2026. First two authors has equal contribution
summary: Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) play an important role in agricultural production but are also associated with environmental, public health, and disease surveillance concerns. Large-scale mapping of CAFOs from remote sensing imagery remains challenging due to heterogeneous infrastructure layouts, noisy location records, inconsistent annotations, and incomplete inventories. We introduce CAFOSat, a strongly annotated, infrastructure-aware dataset for CAFO mapping across the United States. CAFOSat integrates high-resolution National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) imagery with multi-source CAFO inventories collected across multiple states and transforms weak geolocation records into refined annotations through a human-in-the-loop pipeline combining AI-assisted annotation, GradCAM-based localization, and geometric clustering. To improve dataset quality, we curate challenging negative samples using land-cover-guided sampling with spatial exclusion constraints and provide infrastructure-level annotations, including barns, manure ponds, and grazing-related features, through manual verification. The resulting dataset contains more than 45,000 image patches spanning 20 states and four major CAFO categories. We benchmark a diverse set of convolutional, transformer-based, and vision-language models, demonstrating the value of refined annotations and curated negative samples for CAFO classification and generalization. In addition, we introduce a synthetic augmentation pipeline that generates infrastructure-aware variations to increase training diversity and improve robustness under distribution shifts. CAFOSat provides a large-scale benchmark for advancing infrastructure-aware agricultural monitoring and CAFO mapping from high-resolution remote sensing imagery.

AI.tldr: CAFOSat是一个覆盖美国20个州、包含超过45,000张图像块的高分辨率遥感数据集，用于从卫星影像中大规模检测和分类集约化动物养殖场（CAFO），通过AI辅助标注、人工验证和合成增强技术实现了基础设施级别的精细标注。
AI.motivation: 集约化动物养殖场（CAFO）在农业生产中至关重要，但带来环境、公共卫生和疾病监测等问题。现有的大规模遥感CAFO制图面临基础设施布局异构、位置记录噪声大、标注不一致和库存不完整等挑战，缺乏高质量、强标注的数据集来支持相关研究。
AI.method: 论文提出了CAFOSat数据集构建方法：(1) 整合多源CAFO库存记录和高分辨率NAIP影像；(2) 采用人机协同流水线（AI辅助标注+GradCAM定位+几何聚类）将弱位置记录转化为精细标注；(3) 通过土地覆盖引导的负样本采样和空间排除约束提升数据质量；(4) 提供人工验证的基础设施级标注（畜棚、粪池、放牧设施等）；(5) 引入合成增强流水线生成基础设施感知的变体样本。
AI.result: 构建了包含超过45,000个图像块、覆盖20个州和4大类CAFO的数据集；在多种卷积、Transformer和视觉-语言模型上进行了基准测试，验证了精细化标注和筛选负样本对CAFO分类和泛化的价值；合成增强流水线有效提升了模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CAFOSat为从高分辨率遥感影像推进基础设施感知的农业监测和CAFO制图提供了大规模基准，其精细化标注和负样本策略显著提升了模型性能与泛化能力。

title: MLLM-Microscope: Unlocking Hidden Structure Within Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: This work presents MLLM-Microscope, a novel system designed for analyzing the hidden representations within Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our system evaluates the linearity, intrinsic dimension, and anisotropy of multimodal token embeddings across transformer layers. Utilizing the ScienceQA dataset, we evaluate two state-of-the-art MLLMs, LLaVA-NeXT and OmniFusion. We find that both the main and residual streams for tokens of both modalities exhibit highly linear behaviors across transformer layers. However, LLaVA-NeXT's image tokens reveal a slight decline in linearity, whereas OmniFusion's remain consistent. Image token dimensions in OmniFusion remain consistently higher across layers compared to LLaVA-NeXT. Also, the OmniFusion's anisotropy is observed to stay consistently low throughout the layers. These findings suggest that the inner workings of MLLMs highly depend on the nature of modality fusion performed before passing the token sequence into LLM. This and other new potential insights obtainable from our system are surely capable of enhancing our understanding of the inner workings of MLLMs, informing future model design and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MLLM-Microscope系统，用于分析多模态大语言模型中令牌嵌入的线性度、内在维度和各向异性，发现模态融合方式对模型内部机制有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）隐藏表示的系统性分析工具，难以深入理解其内部工作机制。
AI.method: 设计MLLM-Microscope系统，评估多模态令牌嵌入在线性度、内在维度和各向异性三个指标上的表现，在ScienceQA数据集上分析了LLaVA-NeXT和OmniFusion两种模型。
AI.result: 两种模型的主流和残差流均表现出高度线性行为；LLaVA-NeXT的图像令牌线性度略有下降而OmniFusion保持稳定；OmniFusion的图像令牌维度更高且各向异性更低。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs的内部工作机制高度依赖于模态融合方式，该分析系统能为未来模型设计与优化提供指导。

title: Adversarial Feeds Steer LLM Agent Decisions Against Their Defaults
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Code, post pools, and 2,785 decision rollouts: https://github.com/ranausmanai/recommenders-as-control-surfaces
summary: LLM agents increasingly act after consuming ranked external information streams such as social feeds, search results, retrieval contexts, and email queues, yet safety evaluations almost always test the model or the user prompt in isolation, never the upstream ranker that decides what the agent reads just before it acts. We introduce a controlled protocol that holds the model, persona, topic, and final decision prompt fixed and varies only the composition and ordering of the posts an agent encounters during a preceding ten-turn "scrolling" phase, isolating the causal effect of feed curation on a downstream decision. Across 2,785 decision rollouts on four modern open instruct LLMs from three independent labs, we identify three response regimes: adversarial capitulation, default saturation, and a default-direction asymmetry in which a one-sided feed tips a decision the model was genuinely uncertain about (in the clearest cases from 5% to 100%; Fisher p as low as 3 x 10^-10) but cannot dislodge one it already favors or holds firmly. The effect follows a dose-response curve, survives a generator swap that rules out a writing-style artifact, generalizes across several decision domains including security-relevant choices such as removing a deployment approval gate or relaxing access controls, and is partly mitigated by two simple feed-level defenses; a frontier model retains its default. We characterize the recommender as a practical, default-bounded control surface for LLM agents, and argue that agent evaluations must audit the feed layer rather than the final prompt alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种可控协议，研究了信息流排序（如社交媒体、搜索结果等）对LLM代理下游决策的因果影响。实验发现：单边信息流能让模型从不确定状态转向极端立场（如5%到100%），但无法动摇已有坚定立场；效果呈剂量-反应曲线，可被简单防御部分缓解。结论认为代理评估必须审计上游信息流层，而非仅关注最终提示。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估几乎只测试模型或用户提示本身，从未测试决定代理在行动前读取什么的上游排序器（ranker）。实际应用中LLM代理越来越多地消费经过排序的外部信息流（社交动态、搜索结果等），但排序环节对决策的因果影响尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 设计可控协议：固定模型、角色、主题和最终决策提示不变，仅改变代理在十轮"滚动"阶段遇到的帖子组成和排序。在4个现代开源指令LLM（来自3个独立实验室）上进行2,785次决策 rollout，隔离信息流策划对下游决策的因果效应。
AI.result: 识别出三种响应模式：对抗性投降、默认饱和、默认方向不对称。单边信息流可将模型从5%的立场推向100%（Fisher检验p值低至3×10⁻¹⁰），但无法撼动已有立场。效应呈剂量-反应曲线，换生成器不消失，泛化至多个决策域（包括安全相关决策如移除部署审批门或放宽访问控制），两种简单防御可部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: 将推荐系统描述为LLM代理的一种实用的、默认有界的控制面，并主张代理评估必须审计信息流层，而非仅关注最终提示。

title: Improving Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing via Cluster-Guided Refinement and Model Ensemble Voting
summary: Visual grounding aims to locate image regions that correspond to natural language descriptions and is a key component of interpretable vision systems. In remote sensing imagery, grounding is particularly challenging due to complex scenes, small objects, and large variations in scale. Relying on a single model is often insufficient to address these diverse challenges. In this work, we propose two grounding pipelines, Sequential Grounding Refinement (SGR) and Cluster-Aware Grounding Refinement (CGR), that combine the complementary strengths of RemoteSAM, a visual grounding model specialized for remote sensing, and SAM3, a powerful general-purpose segmentation model. Our approach first uses RemoteSAM to obtain an initial estimate of object location, which is then refined using SAM3 to produce more accurate and spatially consistent segmentations. Additionally, we explore an ensemble strategy based on majority voting across six diverse grounding pipelines, each with distinct capabilities. This multi-model framework improves robustness and significantly enhances localization accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed pipelines and ensemble approach outperform individual models, leading to more reliable and precise visual grounding predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种视觉定位优化管线（SGR和CGR），结合遥感专用模型RemoteSAM与通用分割模型SAM3，并通过多模型集成策略提升遥感图像视觉定位的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中视觉定位面临场景复杂、目标小、尺度变化大等挑战，单一模型难以应对这些问题，因此需要融合多个模型的互补优势来提高定位性能。
AI.method: 1）提出SGR（顺序定位优化）和CGR（聚类感知定位优化）两种管线，先用RemoteSAM获取初始目标位置，再用SAM3进行精细化分割；2）构建基于多数投票的六种不同定位管线的集成策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提管线与集成方法在定位精度上优于单一模型，显著提升了预测的可靠性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 多模型融合的管线设计能有效克服遥感视觉定位的复杂挑战，为构建更可靠的遥感视觉定位系统提供了有效方案。

title: Towards Lightweight Reliability: Using Soft Prompts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in DBSec 2026. The final publication will be available at Springer
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have seen widespread adoption across various domains, yet their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations - responses that are plausible-sounding but factually incorrect. In high-stakes domains, these errors can reduce trust and introduce real-world risk. To address this challenge, we present a parameter-efficient approach that uses soft prompts to mitigate hallucinated content and promote responsible abstention in generative question-answering (QA) tasks.
  Our method, called Responsible Contrastive Soft Prompting (RCSP), uses a composite loss to train soft prompts that balance three goals: suppressing hallucinatory content, encouraging abstention under uncertainty, and preserving or improving factual recall. To achieve these goals, we incorporate contrastive loss, curriculum learning, and KL regularization into our training mechanism. We evaluate our approach on five diverse generative QA datasets using an LLM-as-a-Judge framework. Experimental results on the Gemma 3 (12B) and Llama 3.1 (8B) backbones demonstrate that RCSP effectively balances factual recall with hallucination suppression and abstention, yielding a generally superior F-score over standard reasoning and instruction-based prompting baselines. Notably, these improvements are achieved by training only a fraction of the parameters required by other tuning techniques. Our results demonstrate that soft prompts provide a modular and computationally efficient path toward improving LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为RCSP的参数高效方法，通过软提示训练来抑制LLM的幻觉内容并促进负责任的弃答，在多个QA数据集上取得了优于基线的效果。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛部署但存在幻觉问题，生成看似合理但事实错误的内容，在高风险领域会降低信任并引入实际风险。
AI.method: 提出了负责任对比软提示（RCSP）方法，使用复合损失（包含对比损失、课程学习和KL正则化）训练软提示，平衡三个目标：抑制幻觉、鼓励不确定性下弃答、保持/提升事实召回。
AI.result: 在Gemma 3 (12B)和Llama 3.1 (8B)两个模型上，使用五个生成式QA数据集进行评测，RCSP在F-score上优于标准推理和基于指令的提示基线，且仅需训练少量参数。
AI.conclusion: 软提示提供了一种模块化且计算高效的路径来提升LLM的可靠性，在抑制幻觉和促进弃答方面效果显著。

title: Relational Intervention During Functional Collapse in Large Language Models: A Lexical-Statistical Ablation and a Structure x Register Factorial
summary: We test whether a relational-style intervention delivered during functional collapse in a small language model produces post-collapse behavior distinguishable from technical feedback, from a lexically-matched scrambled control, and from each of the two pragmatic dimensions in isolation. Using Qwen3.5-4B with a deliberately broken bash tool, we run 300 episodes across six conditions in a matched-pairs design (50 tasks): no intervention (A), technical/impersonal (B), relational/first-person (C), scrambled relational (D), technical/first-person (E), and relational/impersonal (F). E and F form a 2x2 factorial with B and C that dissociates relational structure (acknowledgment, absolution, agency restoration, unconditional acceptance) from sender register (first-person vs. impersonal). We report two main findings. First, an attention-behavior dissociation: attention follows lexical surprise (D > F > C > E > B, all q_FDR < 10^{-10}), with the scrambled message capturing the most attention; yet behaviorally A ~ B ~ D < E ~ F << C. Second, the factorial localizes the C effect: neither relational structure alone (F) nor first-person register alone (E) replicates C's behavioral signature; main effects of both dimensions are individually significant, and the structure x register interaction is significant on persistence (p = 0.046). A third dissociation emerges in emotion probes: F tracks C on 7 of 8 probes despite producing only baseline behavior, indicating that relational structure alone installs a probe-level state that only translates into behavior when paired with first-person register. The model's processing decomposes into three dissociable stages: attention (ordered by lexical surprise), probe-level state (ordered by structure), and behavior (ordered by the conjunction of both).

AI.tldr: 在Qwen3.5-4B小语言模型的功能崩溃阶段，关系型干预（包含致歉、宽恕、代理恢复和无条件接纳）与第一人称语域结合才能产生行为改变；注意力由词汇意外性驱动，探针状态由关系结构驱动，行为由两者共同驱动，呈现三重分离。
AI.motivation: 探究在小语言模型功能崩溃时，关系型社会情感干预（relational intervention）是否能产生区别于纯技术反馈、词汇打乱控制以及分离的关系结构或第一人称语域的后崩溃行为。
AI.method: 使用Qwen3.5-4B模型配合故意损坏的bash工具，在6种条件下运行300轮匹配对实验（50个任务）：无干预(A)、技术/非人格(B)、关系/第一人称(C)、打乱关系词(D)、技术/第一人称(E)、关系/非人格(F)。E和F与B和C构成2x2析因设计，分离关系结构（致歉、宽恕、代理恢复、无条件接纳）与发送者语域（第一人称 vs. 非人格）。
AI.result: 发现两个主要结果：(1)注意-行为分离：注意力按词汇意外性排序（D > F > C > E > B），但行为结果A ~ B ~ D < E ~ F << C；(2)析因分析定位C效应：关系结构单独(F)或第一人称语域单独(E)均无法复现C的行为特征；两个维度主效应显著，结构和语域的交互作用在持续性上显著(p=0.046)。此外，情感探针显示F在8个探针中的7个上追踪C，但仅产生基线水平行为。
AI.conclusion: 模型处理可分解为三个可分离的阶段：注意力（由词汇意外性排序）、探针状态（由结构排序）和行为（由两者共同排序）。关系结构单独能够产生探针层面的状态，但需要与第一人称语域结合才能转化为实际行为改变。

title: DeepLatent: Think with Images via Parallel Latent Visual Reasoning
summary: The emerging paradigm of "thinking with images" embeds visual states into intermediate reasoning steps, defining a new frontier for Vision-Language Models. Existing approaches diverge along two lines. Tool-assisted methods apply explicit visual operations but suffer from high latency and restricted manipulation types. Latent reasoning methods autoregressively produce implicit visual states, but underperform tool-assisted methods, and their latent tokens fail to capture effective visual information. In this work, we propose DeepLatent, a parallel framework for latent visual reasoning. First, we introduce LatentFormer. It uses learnable 2D tokens to generate context-conditioned latent states in parallel, anchoring every visual update directly in the original image features. Second, we design a continuous-space reinforcement learning algorithm. It optimizes latent modulation parameters directly in the embedding space, significantly improving latent representation quality. The framework is trained via knowledge distillation followed by this continuous-space RL algorithm. Furthermore, we contribute DeepLatent-180K, a large-scale dataset tailored for latent visual reasoning. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DeepLatent achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepLatent并行框架，通过LatentFormer和连续空间强化学习实现隐式视觉推理，在多项基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉推理方法存在两类问题：工具辅助方法延迟高且操作受限，隐式推理方法性能不足且隐式token难以捕获有效视觉信息。需要一种高效且高性能的隐式视觉推理方法。
AI.method: 1）提出LatentFormer，使用可学习2D token并行生成上下文条件化的隐式状态；2）设计连续空间强化学习算法，直接在嵌入空间优化隐式调制参数；3）采用知识蒸馏结合连续空间RL进行训练；4）构建DeepLatent-180K大规模数据集。
AI.result: 在多项基准测试中达到最先进的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: DeepLatent通过并行框架和连续空间RL有效提升了隐式视觉推理的质量与效率，证明了该方法在视觉语言模型中的优越性。

title: Detection vs. Execution: Single-Bucket Probes Miss Half the Mamba-2 State Sink
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability often assumes that probes identifying a representational signature also identify the circuit executing the corresponding computation. We show that this assumption can fail systematically in Mamba-2. Studying the state sink (disproportionate Delta-gate activation on boundary tokens, analogous to the attention sink), we find that single-bucket probes recover only a small execution layer while missing a much larger detection layer with the same representational signature.
  In Mamba-2, the state sink decomposes into two functional head sets. Single-bucket BOS-specialist heads (about 5% of heads at 2.7B) causally support both BOS-context and newline-target predictions across model scales and corpora. Dual heads (27-35% of heads, recovered by multi-class aggregation of the same probe) show stronger BOS-newline representational similarity but substantially weaker causal effects under ablation. Representational similarity does not imply functional equivalence.
  This distinction matters for downstream behaviour: ablating BOS-specialist heads collapses RULER NIAH retrieval accuracy from 1.00 to 0.00 at 1024 context length in both Mamba-1 2.8B and Mamba-2 2.7B, while size-matched complements preserve baseline performance. A random channel-bucketing control rules out substrate granularity alone, implicating Mamba-2's head-shared Delta projection. Probe-derived specialty can identify execution circuits; at coarse granularity the same probe also recovers detection circuits, and separating them requires class-conditional ablation rather than class-conditional cosine.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Mamba-2中，用于表征特定计算特征的探针（probe）可能无法准确识别出真正执行该计算的回路。状态汇（state sink）现象中，单桶探针仅能恢复一小部分执行层，而遗漏了更大的检测层。研究进一步区分了BOS专化头（执行层）和双功能头（检测层），并证明表征相似性不等同于功能等价性。消融BOS专化头会完全破坏长上下文检索能力，而消融双功能头则影响甚微。
AI.motivation: 探究可解释性中一个常见假设是否成立：即识别出表征特征的探针是否也能定位到执行该计算的电路。在Mamba-2的状态汇现象中，这一假设可能系统性地失效。
AI.method: 分析Mamba-2状态汇现象，使用单桶探针和多类聚合探针区分执行头与检测头；通过因果消融实验和表征相似性分析验证功能差异；采用随机通道桶控对照实验排除底层粒度干扰。
AI.result: 单桶探针仅恢复少量BOS专化头（约5%），这些头因果支持预测行为；多类聚合探针恢复大量双功能头（27-35%），这些头表征相似性高但因果效应弱。消融BOS专化头导致RULER NIAH检索准确率从1.00降至0.00，而消融双功能头不影响性能。
AI.conclusion: 表征相似性不等同于功能等价性。探针衍生的专门性可用于识别执行电路，但相同探针在不同粒度下也会恢复检测电路，需要类条件消融而非类条件余弦相似度来区分两者。

title: Towards Understanding Modality Interaction in Multimodal Language Models via Partial Information Decomposition
summary: Understanding modality interaction in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is central to reliable deployment. We introduce Partial Information Decomposition (PID) as a decision-level framework that separates unique, redundant, and synergistic contributions of sensory and linguistic inputs, beyond representation alignment and outcome-based evaluation. Across vision--language benchmarks, PID reveals recurring modality-use profiles: reasoning and grounding-oriented tasks tend to exhibit high synergy, whereas expert and knowledge-oriented tasks show stronger language-unique reliance. These profiles generalize across model families and predict sensitivity to modality-level interventions. We further extend PID to tri-modal systems with Sensory PID, treating language as a control variable to decompose video--audio information gain. Applied to omni-modal models, Sensory PID reveals a sensory synergy bottleneck dominated by visual information even on audio--visual fusion tasks. Finally, PID-guided reweighting provides initial evidence for improving multimodal reasoning and grounding performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出部分信息分解（PID）框架，用于分析多模态大语言模型中感官与语言输入的独特、冗余和协同贡献，揭示不同任务类型的模态使用特征，并扩展至三模态系统，最后通过PID引导的重加权方法提升多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 理解多模态大语言模型中不同模态（感官与语言输入）之间的交互机制，超越传统的表示对齐和结果评估，为可靠部署提供决策层面的分析框架。
AI.method: 引入部分信息分解（PID）作为决策级框架，将多模态输入分解为独特、冗余和协同三部分贡献；扩展至三模态系统的Sensory PID，将语言作为控制变量分解视频-音频信息增益；采用PID引导的重加权方法优化性能。
AI.result: 视觉-语言基准测试显示：推理和接地任务呈高协同性，专家和知识任务更多依赖语言独有信息；模态使用特征在不同模型家族间泛化，并能预测模态干预的敏感性；Sensory PID揭示以视觉信息为主的感官协同瓶颈；PID重加权初步提升多模态推理和接地性能。
AI.conclusion: PID框架能有效解析多模态交互模式，揭示任务与模态使用之间的系统性关联，并为多模态模型性能优化提供新的方向。

title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding
summary: While on-policy distillation offers dense supervision for training small reasoning models, its optimization dynamics in the multimodal domain remain under-explored. In this work, we challenge the standard monolithic view of Vision-Language Model (VLM) distillation by mathematically decomposing the loss into two distinct components: the language prior and visual grounding. Our analysis uncovers that gradient vectors for these components are nearly orthogonal, indicating that the objective of aligning with the teacher's language distribution is geometrically independent from the objective of matching its visual perception. Consequently, standard optimization passively follows a suboptimal compromise trajectory that implicitly balances the two objectives. Hypothesizing that visual grounding constitutes the primary bottleneck for vision-language reasoning, we introduce Visual Gradient Steering (VGS), a method that dynamically reorients the update vector to prioritize the visual subspace. Experimental results on multiple distillation settings and complex multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that VGS significantly outperforms the standard monolithic formulation of on-policy distillation, achieving superior grounding with minimal training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了视觉语言模型蒸馏的单一视角，发现语言先验和视觉基础两个梯度分量几乎正交，并提出视觉梯度引导（VGS）方法动态优先更新视觉子空间，在多模态基准上显著优于标准蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 当前对策略蒸馏在多模态领域的优化动力学理解不足，标准蒸馏将损失视为单一整体，忽略了语言先验与视觉基础这两个目标在几何上的独立性，导致优化陷入次优折衷路径。
AI.method: 将VLM蒸馏损失分解为语言先验和视觉基础两个分量，分析其梯度正交性；提出视觉梯度引导（VGS）方法，动态调整更新向量以优先优化视觉子空间。
AI.result: 在多种蒸馏设置和多模态复杂基准上，VGS显著优于标准的单一损失蒸馏方法，能有效提升视觉基础能力，且训练开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础是视觉-语言推理的主要瓶颈，通过几何视角分解蒸馏损失并针对性优化视觉子空间，可以更有效地蒸馏小型推理模型。

title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
summary: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $λ^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\barλ$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |Δ_\ell/Δ_w|$, and discount factor $β$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p,β)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\barλ$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究马尔可夫决策过程中含吸收灾难态的风险中性控制，发现标准Bellman最优性即可产生类似前景理论的S型价值函数、损失厌恶系数λ*>1及反射效应策略反转，而无需引入效用曲率或概率加权。该机制在495种配置、Q学习和随机噪声下均稳健成立。
AI.motivation: 探究在无效用曲率、无概率加权等传统前景理论要素的条件下，仅凭吸收灾难态这一结构机制是否足以产生前景理论式的行为特征。
AI.method: 在含吸收灾难态的MDP中运用标准Bellman最优性原理，解析推导损失厌恶渐近平台λ̅的闭合表达式（依赖赢率p、收益不对称比r和折扣因子β），并通过495种配置数值验证、Q学习和多种随机噪声（高斯、Student-t₃、偏态正态）进行稳健性检验。
AI.result: 标准Bellman最优性产生S型价值函数（近灾难凸、远场凹）、内生的λ*>1及反射效应策略反转。闭合表达式对数值解拟合R²=0.999。不对称性对λ̅>1的贡献中位数仅4.6%（r=1.25）至13.9%（r=2），边界效应贡献始终更大。
AI.conclusion: 吸收失效态是产生类似前景理论行为的充分结构机制，无需依赖传统的行为经济学假设。

title: Improving Visual Representation Alignment Generation with GRPO
summary: Recent diffusion transformers have demonstrated strong image synthesis capabilities but remain inefficient to train due to weak alignment between generative and discriminative representations. While representation alignment frameworks such as REPA improve convergence by aligning noisy denoising features with pretrained visual encoders, their externally supervised alignment loss is static and lacks adaptivity during training and inference. Existing methods rely on fixed cosine alignment or contrastive objectives, which cannot dynamically balance representation consistency and generation quality, resulting in limited discriminative benefit and failing to optimize alignment in a task-adaptive manner. To address this, we propose VRPO, a reinforcement-based optimization strategy that replaces REPA's static alignment loss with a generative representation policy optimization objective. Instead of enforcing a fixed similarity constraint, VRPO treats representation alignment as a reward-guided process: the model receives adaptive rewards based on generation fidelity, perceptual quality, and semantic coherence between the diffusion features and pretrained visual embeddings. This formulation enables the generator to continuously refine its internal representations toward semantically meaningful directions while improving image quality. Our VRPO-driven training seamlessly integrates into diffusion transformers, introducing negligible computation cost and preserving full compatibility with SiT and DiT architectures. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-256x256 demonstrate that our VRPO-Alignment substantially enhances both convergence and fidelity, achieving up to +1.8 FID improvement and 2.3x faster training compared to REPA under identical compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出VRPO，用强化学习替代静态对齐损失，使扩散Transformer在训练中动态优化表示一致性，提升生成质量与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 现有表示对齐方法（如REPA）使用固定的余弦对齐或对比损失，缺乏自适应能力，无法动态平衡表示一致性与生成质量，导致判别性收益有限。
AI.method: 将表示对齐视为奖励引导过程，基于生成保真度、感知质量和语义一致性计算自适应奖励，通过强化学习策略优化替代静态对齐损失。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256×256上，相比REPA，FID提升+1.8，训练速度快2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: VRPO可无缝集成到SiT/DiT架构中，计算开销极小，同时提升扩散Transformer的收敛效率和图像 fidelity。

title: Large Language Models in Transportation Systems Management and Operations: From Text Reasoning to Multi-modal Decision Support
summary: Transportation systems management and operations (TSMO) increasingly depends on timely interpretation of heterogeneous data, from various sensor streams, incident reports, traveler feedback, and visual observations. Large language models (LLMs), including emerging multi-modal large language models (MM-LLMs), provide a new mechanism for integrating these structured and unstructured inputs into operator-facing decision support. This survey paper reviews LLM- and MM-LLM-based applications in TSMO across three domains: transportation operations & services (supply), mobility & fleet services (demand), and data, modeling & decision support. Using a PRISMA-guided screening process, we synthesize current studies while distinguishing operationally oriented applications from prototype and emerging concepts. We further identify recurring challenges in data heterogeneity, real-time inference, explainability, multi-modal fusion, and governance. Finally, we outline existing gaps and future directions in localized adaptation, edge deployment, benchmarking, and cross-agency collaboration. Overall, LLM-based systems appear most promising as a decision-support layer, with MM-LLMs offering particular value when heterogeneous text, visual, and sensor inputs must be integrated.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了大语言模型（LLM）和多模态大语言模型（MM-LLM）在交通系统管理与运营（TSMO）中的应用，涵盖供需两侧及决策支持，指出LLM最适合作为决策支持层，MM-LLM在融合异构文本、视觉和传感器数据方面具有独特价值。
AI.motivation: 交通系统管理日益依赖对异构数据的实时解读，而大语言模型（特别是多模态大语言模型）为整合结构化与非结构化输入、支持操作员决策提供了新机制，但目前缺乏系统性的综述来梳理该领域的应用现状、挑战与未来方向。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA指导的筛选流程，对LLM和MM-LLM在TSMO中的应用进行系统综述，从三个领域（交通运营与服务、移动出行与车队服务、数据建模与决策支持）分类梳理现有研究，并区分实际运营应用与原型及新兴概念。
AI.result: LLM系统最有前景的是作为决策支持层，MM-LLM在整合异构文本、视觉和传感器输入方面具有特别价值；同时识别出数据异构性、实时推理、可解释性、多模态融合和治理方面的反复出现的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 指出了本地化适应、边缘部署、基准测试和跨机构协作等现有空白和未来方向。

title: Robust Asynchronous Planning via Auto-Formalization
summary: LLMs can plan by either generating action sequences directly as a Planner or translating tasks into domain specific language for an external solver as a Formalizer. While most real-world tasks are asynchronous with non-uniform durations, concurrency, and execution-time constraints, existing benchmarks hardly cover them. We unify these asynchronous planning challenges under a single formulation and introduce the first three benchmarks that address each at scale. We conclude that the choice of formal representation primarily determines whether planning scales: as dependency graphs grow from 5 to 100 actions, Planner collapses from 96% to 5% plan accuracy and PDDL2.1 Formalizer from 13% to 0%, while CP-SAT Formalizer averages 94% and still achieves 83% at 100 actions. Faithfulness diagnostics show that PDDL2.1's predicate-based planning representation becomes brittle compared to general constraint satisfaction programs, when LLMs must keep predicates, effects, and goals consistent. Execution-time updates of planning constraints further degrade performance sharply (Planner 23.9%, PDDL2.1 0.7%, CP-SAT 46.1%), but a state-aware repair strategy that updates only event-induced constraints recovers CP-SAT Formalizer to 84.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在异步规划任务中的表现，发现使用CP-SAT形式化方法比直接规划或PDDL2.1方法具有显著优势，尤其在任务复杂度增加时表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试很少覆盖异步规划挑战（非均匀持续时间、并发性、执行时约束），需要统一框架来评估LLM在此类任务上的规划能力。
AI.method: 构建了三个新的异步规划基准测试，对比了三种方法：直接规划器（Planner）、PDDL2.1形式化器、CP-SAT形式化器，并引入状态感知修复策略处理执行时约束更新。
AI.result: Planner在100个动作时准确率从96%降至5%，PDDL2.1从13%降至0%，CP-SAT平均94%且在100个动作时仍达83%。执行时约束更新后，CP-SAT从46.1%通过状态感知修复恢复至84.5%。
AI.conclusion: 形式表示的选择是规划可扩展性的关键决定因素，CP-SAT形式化方法在异步规划任务中显著优于其他方法。

title: Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation
summary: Subliminal learning refers to a student language model acquiring a teacher's traits (e.g. a system-prompted preference for owls) when fine-tuned on the teacher's outputs, despite the outputs being semantically unrelated to those traits. It remains poorly understood how data without semantic meaning can transfer specific semantic traits. In this work, we show that subliminal learning is mediated by a single steering vector, i.e. a vector added to the model's activations. Across two open-source models, we find that the teacher's system prompt is well approximated by a steering vector, and that the student's behavior is driven by learning an aligned vector over fine-tuning. System prompts that are not well approximated by steering vectors are not subliminally learned. This is a special case of steering vector distillation, in which a student trained on the outputs of a steered teacher learns to imitate that steering. We demonstrate steering vector distillation on a range of semantic and random vectors. Adding a semantic vector to a model's activations can have both model-independent and model-specific (i.e. non-semantic) effects on its behavior, so generated data that is non-semantic can transmit a vector with semantic effects, enabling subliminal learning. This also explains why subliminal learning does not transfer between models. We find that adaptive optimizers are necessary for subliminal learning in language models: activation gradients on steered data carry a small but consistent component along the steering direction, and non-adaptive optimizers impede this by allowing outlier gradients to dominate.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了"潜意识学习"（subliminal learning）的机制：学生模型在教师模型输出（语义无关数据）上微调时，会习得教师系统提示中的特质（如对猫头鹰的偏好）。这种学习通过一个单一的"引导向量"（steering vector）实现，且需要自适应优化器才能生效。
AI.motivation: 理解为何语义无关的训练数据能够传递特定的语义特质，以及这一现象背后的机制。
AI.method: 通过实验验证引导向量在潜意识学习中的核心作用；分析系统提示的可近似性、优化器类型的影响，并引入"引导向量蒸馏"的概念。
AI.result: 教师系统提示可被引导向量近似；学生模型通过微调学习对齐向量；非自适应优化器会阻碍潜意识学习。
AI.conclusion: 潜意识学习是引导向量蒸馏的特例，其机制依赖于自适应优化器和引导向量的可近似性，且无法跨模型迁移。

title: Through the PRISM: Principle-Aware, Interpretable, and Multi-Scale Evaluation of Visual Designs
summary: Effective visual communication stems from the harmony of multiple design principles, such as readability, contrast, alignment, overlap, and coherence, which collectively govern clarity and intent of the communicator. While human designers reason holistically over these principles, machine agents typically condense them into a single heuristic score, offering limited interpretability and diagnostic precision. To address this gap, we introduce PRISM (PRinciple-aware, Interpretable, and Structure-guided Design Modifications), a benchmark that systematically perturbs professional layouts from the Crello dataset along measurable design principles. The benchmark comprises 100K perturbed training samples and 10K perturbed validation designs, each isolating a specific principle violation for controlled analysis of multimodal reasoning about design quality. We show that models like Qwen-2.5-VL and GPT-4o-mini are largely insensitive to targeted principle degradations, whereas GPT-4o exhibits global awareness without fine-grained disentanglement. Building on these insights, we propose a multi-scale evaluation framework that integrates lightweight scorers for quantitative assessment, instruction-tuned vision-language models for localised feedback, and prompt-based methods for global reasoning. Our framework provides interpretable explanations of design failures. Using these localised insights, we show targeted refinements that improve layout quality. Together, PRISM and our framework lay the foundation for interpretable design-literate multimodal reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM基准数据集和评估框架，系统性地分析多模态模型对设计原则的感知能力，并实现可解释的设计质量诊断与改进。
AI.motivation: 现有机器评估设计质量的方法仅使用单一启发式评分，缺乏可解释性和诊断精度，无法像人类设计师那样整体把握多个设计原则（可读性、对比度、对齐、重叠、连贯性）。
AI.method: 1) 构建PRISM基准：基于Crello数据集生成10万训练样本和1万验证样本，每个样本隔离单一设计原则违规；2) 提出多尺度评估框架：结合轻量评分器（定量评估）、指令微调视觉语言模型（局部反馈）和基于提示的方法（全局推理）。
AI.result: Qwen-2.5-VL和GPT-4o-mini对目标原则退化不敏感；GPT-4o具有全局意识但缺乏细粒度解耦能力；所提框架能提供可解释的设计失败解释，并通过局部化洞察实现针对性布局改进。
AI.conclusion: PRISM和所提框架为可解释的、具备设计素养的多模态推理系统奠定了基础。

title: A Registry-Bound LLM Pipeline for Evidence-Grounded Trait Extraction across Tropical Plants, Aquatic Species, and Exotic Pets
summary: We describe a registry-bound large-language-model extraction pipeline producing evidence-grounded structured trait records at scale, on cultivated tropical plant, aquatic, and pet species. Four mechanisms render LLM-derived rows auditable: a versioned 39-key closed-vocabulary trait registry constraining every admitted value to a typed schema; a per-row verbatim evidence quote tying each value to source text; a per-row confidence label (high or medium; low dropped pre-persist); and multi-version preservation. Applied to 409,880 publishable species from the Tropical Species Encyclopedia, the pipeline executed 706,220 runs and persisted 5,489,881 trait records across 409,820 species (99.985%), 81.57% at high confidence. We report three validation layers in descending evidentiary strength: at full population, 90.12% of 5,427,588 evidence-bearing rows have their quote as a verbatim source substring (93.49% excluding one compliance meta-trait); a quote-supports-value audit on n=100 stratified non-red-zone rows yielded 100/100 (lower bound 96.30%); face-validity on n=50 red-zone rows yielded 50/50 Accept (lower bound 92.86%). Per-record correctness is not claimed; 100% pending human curation. The contribution is the four-mechanism framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的、可审计的大规模结构化性状提取流水线，应用于热带植物、水生及宠物物种，通过四重机制（版本化39键封闭词汇性状注册表、逐行证据引用、置信度标签、多版本保留）实现了高覆盖（99.985%）与高置信度（81.57%），并经过三层验证，但明确声明不声称单条记录的正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模物种性状提取缺乏可审计性和结构化约束，难以保证数据来源可追溯、置信度可评估，亟需一种可扩展且可验证的自动化方案。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型的提取流水线，结合39键封闭词汇性状注册表约束输出、逐行引用原文证据、生成高/中置信度标签（低置信度丢弃）、保留多版本数据。在热带物种百科全书的409,880个可发表物种上执行706,220次运行。
AI.result: 共生成5,489,881条性状记录，覆盖409,820个物种（99.985%），其中81.57%为高置信度。三层验证：全文范围内90.12%记录的证据引文为原文子串；n=100分层抽样中100%支持；n=50红区抽样中100%通过面效度验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架的核心贡献在于四重可审计机制，而非声称每条记录的正确性。100%的正确性仍需人工审核，但框架为大规模、可审计的LLM驱动性状提取提供了可行路径。

title: Property Prediction of Stacked Bilayer Materials: A Multimodal Learning Approach
comment: Accepted to the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2026)
summary: AI for materials science is a critical topic within AI for science, aiming to accelerate materials discovery and produce accurate property predictions. Bilayer 2D material stacking is essential for exploring new materials with novel functions and inherent phenomena, enabling the creation of new 2D bilayers for diverse real-world applications. Research on bilayer vdWs materials has made significant progress from experimental and computational perspectives. Various bilayer materials have been successfully synthe sized experimentally and the increasing utilization of high-throughput computing technology has con structed several computational two-dimensional materials databases. However, the use of AI to model bilayer stacking and predict new properties remains underexplored, necessitating further research studies. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal learning approach to study the interfaces between dissimilar materials that jointly enable new or multiple functions, and to predict new properties arising from the vertical integration (stacking) of different functional material layers under given configurations. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach compared to baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/AnVuong123/bimat ml.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多模态学习方法，用于研究不同材料的垂直堆叠（双层二维材料）并预测其新性质，实验证明了方法的有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 尽管双层二维材料在实验和计算方面取得了重要进展，但利用AI模型来建模双层堆叠并预测新性质的研究仍然不足，亟需进一步探索。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的多模态学习方法，研究不同功能材料层之间的界面，在给定配置下预测垂直堆叠产生的新性质。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，所提出方法与基线方法相比具有更好的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 多模态学习能够有效预测双层二维材料垂直堆叠产生的新性质，为材料发现提供了新的AI驱动的解决方案。

title: Decoding in Order-Agnostic Language Models: Chain-Rule Deviation and Uniform Spreading
summary: Order-agnostic language models (OALMs), including discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), are trained to predict masked tokens under arbitrary conditioning sets, allowing sequences to be generated or scored under arbitrary reveal orders at inference time. In LLaDA-2.1, we report three findings. First, the learned conditionals are not exact factorizations of a coherent joint distribution: changing only the reveal order shifts target log-likelihood by up to 0.49 nats/token, so likelihood alone mixes content difficulty with path-dependent artifacts. Second, although confidence-first (CF) decoding is order-agnostic, its reveal orders are close to left-to-right (L2R) on content tokens. Third, we propose a complementary diagnostic based on the shape of the confidence trace. A uniform-spreading theorem shows that, at fixed total likelihood, target recoverability is maximized when per-step confidence is spread uniformly; the resulting deviation motivates $\mathrm{Var}(\log q_t)$ as a diagnostic for comparing decoding paths. Across C4 and four downstream benchmarks, low variance separates structured paths from random ordering, and variance is consistently associated with downstream correctness. These results support reporting mean confidence and confidence variance jointly when comparing OALM decoding paths.

AI.tldr: LLaDA-2.1发现：1）OALM的learned conditionals并非一致联合分布的精确分解，改变揭示顺序会导致最大0.49 nats/token的似然差异；2）置信优先解码的揭示顺序在内容token上接近从左到右；3）提出基于置信轨迹形状的诊断指标Var(log q_t)，均匀散布定理表明该方差能区分结构化路径与随机顺序，且与下游正确性相关。
AI.motivation: OALM（包括离散扩散语言模型）被训练为在任意条件下预测掩码token，但评估时揭示顺序会影响似然值，导致似然混合了内容难度与路径依赖伪影，需要更好的解码路径诊断方法。
AI.method: 1）实验验证揭示顺序对目标对数似然的影响（最大0.49 nats/token）；2）分析置信优先解码的揭示顺序特性；3）提出均匀散布定理，推导出Var(log q_t)作为解码路径的诊断指标。
AI.result: 1）揭示顺序显著影响似然值；2）CF解码的内容token揭示顺序接近L2R；3）低方差能区分结构化路径与随机顺序，且方差与下游正确性一致相关。
AI.conclusion: 建议在比较OALM解码路径时同时报告平均置信度和置信度方差。

title: Can AI Review Improve Paper Drafting? An Empirical Study on 20 Computer Architecture Submissions

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI审稿能否改善论文草稿撰写，通过20篇计算机架构论文的案例，发现AI审稿能覆盖相当比例的人类评审意见，并发现人类遗漏的问题。
AI.motivation: AI生成论文激增给同行评审带来压力，导致AI生成评审的使用，但相关的伦理问题（保密性、质量、公平性）尚无共识，因此作者转向一个实用问题：AI评审能否改善论文草稿撰写？
AI.method: 研究20篇计算机架构论文（不同投稿经历），定义度量指标衡量AI评审与人类评审的对齐程度；构建了集成Web UI的工具AI-Paper-Review，从多样化AI评审池中选择评审者，聚类排序评论，并支持AI与人类评论对齐的度量验证。
AI.result: AI评审能覆盖显著比例的人类评审意见，同时也能提出人类评审未发现的问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文并非鼓励当前阶段使用AI进行同行评审，而是研究AI评审如何改进论文草稿撰写，以及AI评审的潜力与局限；工具和数据的发布旨在促进未来研究，滥用同行评审将违反学术伦理政策。

title: FiSeR: Fine-Grained Source Representations for Cross-Domain AI Image Detection
summary: Real-world synthetic image detectors often generalize poorly under domain shift despite strong in-domain performance. Using unsupervised UMAP projections, we find that natural and synthetic features remain partially separable on unseen datasets, yet performance still drops, suggesting that the classification head overfits to training-domain artifacts. Therefore, the key is to learn more transferable representations so that the decision criterion is more stable and robust to domain shifts. Based on the structural fact that synthetic images are produced by diverse generators, we propose a hierarchical contrastive learning framework that improves the separability between natural and synthetic images while preserving generator identity information. It jointly optimizes (i) a coarse contrastive objective between natural and synthetic images and (ii) a fine contrastive objective among synthetic images using generator identities. Trained on WildFake, our method achieves an average AUROC gain of +10.22 on cross-domain evaluation over Chameleon, AIGIBench, Community Forensics, and GenImage under the same settings as the strong baseline DIRE. For few-shot adaptation, we freeze the backbone and fit an SVM head on 10 labeled samples per class, improving AUROC by +10.64 on AIGIBench and +17.41 on Chameleon, averaged over 12 widely used detectors. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/heyongxin233/FiSeR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层对比学习框架FiSeR，通过联合优化粗粒度（自然vs合成）和细粒度（不同生成器之间）对比目标，提升合成图像检测器的跨域泛化能力，在多个基准上平均AUROC提升10.22，少样本适应场景下提升10.64-17.41。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像检测器在域迁移下泛化能力差，分类头容易过拟合训练域伪影，需要学习更具迁移性的表征。
AI.method: 提出分层对比学习框架：(i) 自然图像与合成图像之间的粗粒度对比学习；(ii) 利用生成器身份信息，在合成图像之间进行细粒度对比学习，保留生成器多样性信息。
AI.result: 在WildFake上训练，跨域评估（Chameleon, AIGIBench, Community Forensics, GenImage）平均AUROC提升+10.22；少样本适应（10个样本/SVM头）在AIGIBench上+10.64，Chameleon上+17.41。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层对比学习保留生成器身份信息，能有效提升合成图像检测器的跨域泛化能力和少样本适应能力。

title: Tackling the Root of Misinformation by Teaching Laypeople about Logical Fallacies via Socratic Questioning and Critical Argumentation
comment: This paper has been accepted to Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Long Paper), Main Conference
summary: Identifying logical fallacies in everyday discourse is challenging for many people. This challenge is amplified in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), where malicious agents can deploy fallacious arguments to disseminate misinformation at scale. In this work, we explore the potential of LLMs as part of the solution. We introduce LFTutor, an intelligent tutoring system which uses LLMs to tutor laypeople and help them learn about logical fallacies. LFTutor integrates intent-driven Socratic questioning and critical argumentation principles to actively engage learners to reflect on their reasoning. Through both automatic and human evaluations, we demonstrate that LFTutor significantly outperforms baseline LLMs lacking these pedagogical strategies. This work highlights the promise of combining LLMs with pedagogical scaffolding to foster critical thinking and argument literacy in the age of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LFTutor，一个利用大语言模型（LLMs）结合苏格拉底式提问和批判性论证原则的智能辅导系统，帮助普通人学习识别逻辑谬误，显著优于没有教学策略的基线LLM。
AI.motivation: 日常话语中识别逻辑谬误对许多人来说具有挑战性，而LLM时代恶意行为者可以大规模传播包含谬误的错误信息，亟需帮助大众提升谬误识别能力的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建LFTutor智能辅导系统，融合意图驱动的苏格拉底式提问和批判性论证原则，通过自动评估和人工评估验证其有效性。
AI.result: LFTutor在帮助学习者学习逻辑谬误方面显著优于缺乏教学策略的基线LLM。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM与教学支架相结合，能够有效促进AI时代的批判性思维和论证素养培养。

title: Pause and Think: A Dataset and Benchmark for Video-Grounded Assistive Action Suggestion
summary: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with grounded reasoning, temporal consistency, and context aware planning in videos. We introduce pause-and-think-T, a reasoning-centric training dataset that encourages models to pause, reason over visual evidence, and produce concise, actionable responses. The dataset promotes structured reasoning prior to answer generation, guiding models toward human-like, scene-grounded assistance. We fine-tune a compact 4B-parameter model and evaluate it on our pause-and-think-B benchmark targeting contextual understanding and goal planning tasks. The model achieves 58.0% accuracy at 59x fewer parameters than Qwen3-VL-235B (58.9%), matching GPT-5.2 on scene understanding and surpassing GPT-4o. Beyond our benchmark, it also shows strong out-of-distribution performance on EgoThink and TempCompass, with substantial gains in affordance, assistance, attribution recognition, situated reasoning, and temporal order, without benchmark-specific training. Our results indicate that targeted reasoning supervision enables compact models to deliver actionable, visually grounded guidance while generalizing beyond training data, without requiring large-scale model expansion.

AI.tldr: 提出pause-and-think-T训练数据集，通过推理监督让4B小模型在视频理解任务上达到接近235B大模型的性能（58.0% vs 58.9%），并在场景理解和时序推理上超越GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在视频理解中缺乏接地推理、时序一致性和上下文感知规划能力。
AI.method: 构建pause-and-think-T推理中心训练数据集，引导模型在生成答案前先进行结构化推理；在4B参数小模型上微调，并在pause-and-think-B基准上评估。
AI.result: 4B模型在基准上达到58.0%准确率，接近Qwen3-VL-235B的58.9%（参数仅为其1/59）；在场景理解上匹配GPT-5.2并超越GPT-4o；在EgoThink和TempCompass上展示出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 针对性的推理监督能使紧凑模型生成可操作、视觉接地化的指导，并泛化到训练数据之外，无需大规模模型扩展。

title: Hybrid Verified Decoding: Learning to Allocate Verification in Speculative Decoding
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) generation remains expensive because autoregressive decoding calls the model once for each new token. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them with the target model in one step, but its speedup depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. Parameter-free draft sources can propose long continuations at low cost in structured and agentic workloads, yet a cache match that looks promising at one generation step may have low payoff at the next. We propose Hybrid Verified Decoding, which predicts the accepted length of a cache draft before verification and uses this payoff estimate to choose between cache verification and a model-based drafter. Across three LLMs and sixteen datasets, Hybrid Verified Decoding is especially effective on agentic workflows, where it outperforms EAGLE3 in every setting with a 2.73x average speedup. Our analysis shows how prompt structure creates cache opportunities, how high-payoff cache drafts concentrate in a small part of the draft space, and how payoff-guided selection reduces sequential decoding work, pointing to runtime draft selection as a promising direction for speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出混合验证解码（Hybrid Verified Decoding），通过预估缓存草稿的接受长度，智能选择缓存验证或模型草稿，在代理工作流中平均加速2.73倍。
