Our comprehensive experiments span: (1) Three major dataset categories encompassing classic (CIFAR10, CIFAR100, ImageNet-1k), imbalanced (CIFAR10-LT, CIFAR100-LT), and fine-grained (StanfordCars, FGVCAircraft) image classification datasets, each evaluated under 3-5 distinct sampling ratios; (2) Diverse pretrained architectures including Convolutional Neural Network (ConvNeXt), Vision Transformer (ViT), and Vision LSTM (ViL) networks; (3) A systematic investigation of frozen feature augmentation (FroFA) strategies. (4) A comprehensive and rigorous analysis of efficiency and generalizability. The results demonstrate significant improvements with strong generalization and robustness. Notably, under low sampling ratios, our framework achieves remarkable performance gains of over 20% on the ViT model for CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet-1k benchmarks. This systematic approach establishes new state-of-the-art performance while maintaining parameter efficiency, proving particularly effective when labeled data is scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FACT框架，通过三阶段分层微调方法解决主动微调中全量微调导致预训练特征扭曲和过拟合的问题，在多种数据集和架构上取得显著性能提升，尤其在低采样率下表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有主动微调研究过度关注数据选择（active方面），而统一采用全量微调进行模型适应，这会导致分布偏移从而扭曲预训练特征。当模型规模相对微调数据量较大时，过拟合风险加剧，这一问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出FACT（三阶段层次化微调框架），包含三个阶段：(1) 经典、不平衡和细粒度三大类数据集上的实验；(2) 多种预训练架构（ConvNeXt、ViT、ViL）；(3) 冻结特征增强（FroFA）策略的系统研究；(4) 效率和泛化性的全面分析。
AI.result: 在低采样率下，ViT模型在CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet-1k上取得超过20%的性能提升。整体上建立了新的最优性能，同时保持参数效率，在标注数据稀缺时尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: FACT框架在主动微调场景下表现出显著的改进、强泛化性和鲁棒性，系统性地建立了新的最优性能水平，尤其在数据稀缺情况下效果突出。

title: FocusDiT: Masking Queries in Diffusion Transformers for Fine-grained Image Generation
summary: Diffusion transformer (DiT) has been widely adopted in the generative diffusion field, advancing the denoising of query tokens through attention and Feed-Forward (\text{FFN}) layers. FFN actually acts as the key-value vocabulary for decoding visual contents where the value embeds the visual semantical knowledge. We present that focusing on critical query tokens corresponding to more complex details and encouraging the model to improve these tokens is essential for fine-grained visual generation. To this end, we propose FocusDiT, which applies a Masking scheme to focus on critical query tokens that are exclusively fed into FFN. The masked queries can retrieve visual tokens from the FFN vocabularies, and use them to decode their visual details. Extensive text-to-image experiments validate the effectiveness of token masking in enhancing generative performance.

AI.tldr: FocusDiT通过对扩散Transformer中的关键查询令牌进行掩码处理，仅让重要令牌通过FFN层检索视觉语义知识，从而提升细粒度图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有DiT模型中FFN层作为视觉语义知识库，但所有查询令牌都无差别地访问FFN，导致对复杂细节区域（关键令牌）的关注不足，不利于细粒度视觉生成。
AI.method: 提出FocusDiT，设计一种掩码方案，筛选出对应复杂细节的关键查询令牌，仅将这些令牌输入FFN层，使其能够从FFN词汇表中检索视觉令牌并解码视觉细节。
AI.result: 在文本到图像的生成实验中，该令牌掩码方法有效提升了生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 关注关键查询令牌并鼓励模型改进这些令牌，是提升细粒度视觉生成质量的有效策略。

title: Understanding-Enhanced Model Collaboration for Long-Tailed Egocentric Mistake Detection
summary: In this report, we address the problem of determining whether a user performs an action incorrectly from egocentric video data. To this end, we propose an Understanding-Enhanced Model Collaboration Method (UE-MCM) that combines efficient coarse-grained video understanding with accurate fine-grained action reasoning. Specifically, UE-MCM contains a small model branch and a large model branch. The large model branch focuses on whether the fine-grained action itself is executed incorrectly, while the small model branch jointly takes the coarse-grained video and fine-grained segment as input to identify actions that may be locally correct but inconsistent with the overall workflow. The small model branch is built on a CLIP4CLIP video encoder initialized from a CLIP model enhanced by Diffusion Contrastive Reconstruction, and the large model branch uses the Qwen3-VL Embedding model to extract high-capacity representations from fine-grained action segments. The small-branch prediction and the large-branch prediction are then adaptively fused by a lightweight collaboration gate. To handle the long-tailed distribution of mistake instances, we optimize the classifiers with complementary objectives, including reweighted cross-entropy, AUC-oriented learning, and label-aware adjustment. The resulting system balances speed and accuracy, making it effective for detecting subtle, rare, and ambiguous mistakes in egocentric instructional videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种理解增强的模型协作方法（UE-MCM），通过结合小型模型（粗粒度视频理解）和大型模型（细粒度动作推理），并采用自适应融合门和互补优化目标，有效检测自我中心教学视频中的用户操作错误。
AI.motivation: 解决从自我中心视频数据中判断用户操作是否正确的问题，特别是需要同时处理粗粒度视频理解与细粒度动作推理的挑战。
AI.method: 提出UE-MCM方法，包含小型模型分支（基于CLIP4CLIP+扩散对比重建）和大型模型分支（基于Qwen3-VL Embedding），通过轻量级协作门自适应融合两分支预测，并采用重加权交叉熵、AUC导向学习和标签感知调整等互补目标优化分类器。
AI.result: 系统在平衡速度与准确性的同时，能有效检测自我中心教学视频中的细微、罕见和模糊的错误。
AI.conclusion: UE-MCM通过双分支协作与互补优化，实现了对操作错误的精准检测，尤其适用于长尾分布的错误实例场景。

title: Equilibrated Diffusion: Frequency-aware Textual Embedding for Equilibrated Image Customization
summary: Image customization learns target subjects from reference concept images and generates conditioned images per text prompts, mainly modifying styles or backgrounds. Prevailing methods adopt fine-tuning to pack diverse concept attributes into a unified latent embedding, yet entangled attributes hinder elimination of irrelevant disturbances from style and background. To address this issue, we propose Equilibrated Diffusion, a frequency-driven approach that disentangles tangled concept features for balanced customization and consistent text-visual matching. Unlike conventional methods learning full concepts with shared embeddings and unified tuning, our work utilizes the inherent link between image frequency components and semantics: low frequencies represent subject content and high frequencies correspond to styles. We decompose concepts in frequency space and optimize each embedding independently. This separate optimization enables the denoiser to capture style detached from subject identity and generalize better to unseen stylistic prompts. Merging multi-frequency embeddings preserves the model's original spatial customization ability. We further deploy mask-guided diffusion to restrict irrelevant background changes and boost text alignment. Residual Reference Attention (RRA) is inserted into spatial attention to retain subject structure and identity consistency. Experiments prove Equilibrated Diffusion exceeds mainstream baselines on subject fidelity and text adherence, verifying our method's superiority.

AI.tldr: 提出Equilibrated Diffusion，一种基于频率分解的概念解耦方法，通过分离图像的低频（主体内容）和高频（风格）成分，实现对参考图像中主体特征和风格的独立优化，从而提升图像定制化的主体保真度和文本一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像定制化方法通过微调将多样化概念属性打包到统一潜在嵌入中，导致属性纠缠，难以消除风格和背景等无关干扰，影响定制化效果。
AI.method: 1) 在频率空间分解概念，低频对应主体内容，高频对应风格；2) 独立优化各频率嵌入，使去噪器捕获与主体身份解耦的风格；3) 合并多频率嵌入保留空间定制能力；4) 引入掩码引导扩散限制背景变化；5) 插入残差参考注意力（RRA）保持主体结构和身份一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明Equilibrated Diffusion在主体保真度和文本遵循度上超越主流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于频率分解的独立优化策略能有效解耦概念属性，实现更平衡的图像定制化与文本-视觉匹配。

title: Ultra Diffusion Poser: Diffusion-Based Human Motion Tracking From Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ranging-Based Between-Sensor Distances
comment: CVPR 2026 - Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
summary: Methods using inertial measurement units (IMUs) provide a wearable alternative to camera-based motion capture. To mitigate drift from inertial signals, recent sparse inertial pose estimators integrate inter-sensor distances measured by ultra-wideband (UWB) ranging. So far, UWB distances have only been used as an additional input feature, ignoring the physical constraints they impose on sensor positions. However, these distances can also be used to reconstruct the underlying 3D sensor layout, which in turn provides more informative input for pose reconstruction. We propose Ultra Diffusion Poser, a diffusion model that explicitly models these geometric constraints. It includes a Spatial Layout Module that analytically reconstructs the 3D sensor positions from UWB measurements. These sensor positions are used alongside IMU signals and UWB distances as a conditioning signal during diffusion. Still, network predictions can violate inter-sensor distance measurements. To address this, we introduce UWB-Diffusion Guidance, which encourages alignment between predicted poses and measured distances during diffusion sampling. Together, these contributions enable our model to achieve state-of-the-art performance, reducing joint position error by up to 22% over prior work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ultra Diffusion Poser，一种利用UWB测距和IMU信号的扩散模型，通过显式建模传感器几何约束和扩散引导，在稀疏惯性姿态估计中实现最先进性能，关节位置误差降低高达22%。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏惯性姿态估计方法仅将UWB距离作为额外输入特征，忽略了其对传感器位置施加的物理约束，导致信息利用不充分。
AI.method: 提出Ultra Diffusion Poser扩散模型，包含Spatial Layout Module从UWB测量中解析重建3D传感器位置，以及UWB-Diffusion Guidance在扩散采样过程中约束预测姿态与实测距离的一致性。
AI.result: 与先前工作相比，关节位置误差降低高达22%，达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模UWB距离的几何约束并引入扩散引导，能有效提升稀疏惯性姿态估计的精度。

title: Disentanglement-Based Equivariant Learning for Compositional VQA
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary: Compositional visual question answering (VQA) represents a challenging yet fundamental task that requires models to comprehend novel combinations of previously learned concepts. The current methods often overlook the disentanglement of underlying concepts and are restricted in terms of their ability to effectively capture the compositional variation mechanism. Moreover, the state-of-the-art techniques depend on additional clues for training, which is not feasible in real-world VQA scenarios. To address these issues, in this paper, we introduce a novel Disentanglement-based EquivAriant Learning (DEAL) framework for compositional VQA, which is guided exclusively by ground-truth answers. In DEAL, we employ causality-inspired interventions to disentangle concepts derived from visual and textual inputs within a re-encoding framework. Based on the principle of equivariance, we subsequently perform a compositional transformation on the inference input and impose the equivariant constraint on the output to augment the compositional reasoning capacity of the model. Comprehensive experiments conducted on the benchmark CLEVR-CoGenT and GQA-SGL datasets validate the superiority of our proposed DEAL approach over the existing state-of-the-art methods for compositional VQA tasks in both visual and linguistic generalization settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEAL框架，通过因果干预解耦视觉和语言概念，并利用等变学习增强组合推理能力，在仅使用真实答案监督的情况下，在CLEVR-CoGenT和GQA-SGL基准测试上取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有组合VQA方法存在三个问题：1）忽视底层概念的解耦；2）难以有效捕捉组合变化机制；3）依赖额外线索进行训练，不适用于真实场景。因此，本文旨在提出一种仅依赖真实答案监督的框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出DEAL框架，包含两个核心模块：1）基于因果启发的干预机制，在重编码框架内解耦视觉和文本输入中的概念；2）基于等变原理，对推理输入进行组合变换，并对输出施加等变约束，以增强模型的组合推理能力。整个训练仅使用真实答案作为监督信号。
AI.result: 在CLEVR-CoGenT和GQA-SGL基准上，DEAL在视觉泛化和语言泛化两种设置下均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DEAL框架通过概念解耦与等变学习的结合，有效提升了组合VQA的泛化能力，且无需额外线索，更贴近真实应用场景。

title: InsightVQA: High-Dimensional Emotion-Cognitive Visual Question Answering Benchmark
summary: Visual emotion understanding requires models not only to recognize emotional states, but also to why they arise and perform higher-level cognitive reasoning. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on emotion recognition, offering limited support for grounded understanding and response-oriented analysis. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{InsightVQA}, a large-scale dataset for hierarchical visual question answering on emotion understanding and cognitive reasoning. Building from 351K images collected from six public sources, we apply a rigorous multi-stage filtering pipeline to curate 138K high-confidence images. Each image is annotated at three hierarchical levels: perception QA for emotion and valence recognition, grounded understanding QA constructed from visual trigger extraction through constraint-guided generation, and cognition QA centered on response intent prediction and sequential insight reasoning. In total, InsightVQA contains 725K QA pairs. We further present \textbf{InsightVQA-Bench}, a high-quality evaluation benchmark comprising 30K samples for fine-grained evaluation. To support evaluation, we introduce \textbf{InsightNet}, an emotion-tuned baseline for MLLMs. Results demonstrate that InsightVQA poses significant challenges for grounded emotion understanding and reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InsightVQA——一个大规模分层视觉问答数据集，用于细粒度情感理解和认知推理，包含725K QA对和138K图像，并配套了InsightVQA-Bench基准和InsightNet基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有情感理解基准主要关注情感识别，缺乏对情感产生原因（ grounded understanding）和高层认知推理（response-oriented analysis）的支持，因此需要更全面的数据集来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 从6个公开来源收集351K图像，经多阶段过滤得到138K高置信度图像；构建三层级标注：感知QA（情感/效价识别）、接地理解QA（触发因子提取+约束生成）、认知QA（反应意图预测+序列推理）；共计725K QA对；并开发了情感调优的基线模型InsightNet。
AI.result: InsightVQA对现有的多模态大模型在接地情感理解和推理任务上构成了显著挑战，现有模型表现有限。
AI.conclusion: InsightVQA有效填补了情感理解领域从识别到推理的空白，为未来研究提供了高质量的数据资源和评估基准。

title: Order within Chaos: Capturing Intrinsic Energy Anomalies for AI-Manipulated Image Forgery Localization
summary: Recent advancements in generative AI have led to image editing models capable of producing realistic forgeries that evade traditional image forgery localization methods, as these approaches depend on physical noise absent in synthetic data. To address this challenge, we theoretically demonstrate that the diffusion process inherently suppresses local high-frequency variance, creating a statistical energy gap that is distinguishable from the natural entropy of optical imaging. Guided by this insight, we propose FLAME, a unified framework that utilizes a LAD map to capture these intrinsic anomalies, coupled with a parameter-efficient adapter for SAM to achieve precise, pixel-level forgery localization. Furthermore, to bridge the lag between forensic benchmarks and evolving generative models, we introduce EditStream, an automated pipeline for continuous, instruction-based training data synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAME establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming previous methods on AI-generated forgery datasets while effectively generalizing to unseen generative architectures. Our code is available at https://github.com/phoenixnir/FLAME.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLAME框架，利用扩散过程抑制局部高频方差的统计能量差来检测AI生成图像伪造，并配合EditStream自动合成训练数据，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像伪造定位方法依赖物理噪声特征，无法应对生成式AI产生的逼真伪造图像，亟需针对生成式伪造的新检测方法。
AI.method: 理论证明扩散过程抑制局部高频方差产生统计能量差；提出FLAME框架，包含LAD图捕获内在异常 + SAM参数高效适配器实现像素级定位；设计EditStream自动化流水线合成指令式训练数据。
AI.result: 在AI生成伪造数据集上显著优于之前方法，有效泛化到未见过的生成架构，达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: FLAME基于扩散过程的统计特征差异实现了对AI生成伪造图像的鲁棒定位，EditStream解决了法医基准滞后于生成模型发展的问题。

title: Symmetry-Aware 9D Pose Estimation with Sim(3)-Consistent Feature and Spherical Inception Convolution
summary: Object pose estimation is a fundamental problem for an agent system to perceive or manipulate objects in images or videos. However, current instance-level methods struggle with generalization to unseen objects. Category-level methods seek to address this, but remain constrained by the complexities of learning in the non-linear Sim(3) space and intra-class variations. To address these challenges, We propose an effective method for category-level object pose estimation with two key innovations: (1) A translation/size estimator, featuring a semantic-guided symmetry-aware module that leverages robust generalization capabilities of a large vision model (LVM) to infer symmetry points, resulting in accurate translation and size without shape priors. This result serves as a precomputed cue for rotation estimation, thereby reducing the difficulty of learning in the non-linear Sim(3) space and laying a robust foundation for tackling the inherently more challenging rotation estimation. (2) A feature fusion module, based on our proposed spherical large-kernel inception convolution, fuses semantic features from the LVM with systematically computed geometric features to extract essential pose features from intra-class variations by modeling long-range dependencies without excessive computational cost. Built on these innovations, we achieve SOTA on benchmarks and real-world scenes, while developing a robust robotic picking system capable of handling diverse objects. Our code will be available at the project page: {\hypersetup{urlcolor=blue}https://panfei-cheng.github.io/SSH-Pose}.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大视觉模型语义引导的类别级物体位姿估计方法SSH-Pose，通过对称点推断实现无先验的平移/尺寸估计，并设计球形大核初始卷积融合模块处理旋转估计和类内变化，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有实例级位姿估计方法难以泛化到未见物体，而类别级方法受限于非线性Sim(3)空间的学习难度以及类内变化带来的复杂性。
AI.method: (1) 平移/尺寸估计器：利用大视觉模型（LVM）的强泛化能力进行语义引导的对称点推断，无需形状先验即可精确估计平移和尺寸，为旋转估计提供预计算线索；(2) 特征融合模块：提出球形大核初始卷积（Spherical Large-Kernel Inception Convolution），融合LVM语义特征与几何特征，以较低计算成本建模长程依赖，提取类内不变的关键位姿特征。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和真实场景中达到SOTA性能，并成功开发了能处理多样化物体的鲁棒机器人抓取系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义引导的对称点推断降低Sim(3)空间学习难度，并利用球形大核卷积有效融合语义与几何特征，解决了类别级物体位姿估计中的泛化性和类内变化问题。

title: CORE-MTL: Rethinking Gradient Balancing via Causal Orthogonal Representations
summary: Multi-task learning (MTL) aims to construct a joint model for multiple tasks by sharing a common representation across domains. To achieve this goal, existing optimization-centric methods either balance task gradients or modify the shared architecture. However, as these approaches remain agnostic to the content of the shared representation, they fail to disentangle task-relevant structure from spurious context, leading to negative transfer and poor generalization. To overcome this limitation, we propose Causal Orthogonal Representations for Multi-Task Learning (CORE-MTL), a causally motivated representation-centric framework that encourages a structured semantic-residual factorization of the shared representation, concentrating task-relevant structure in the semantic stream while relegating nuisance variation to the residual stream. We instantiate this framework in the visual domain by leveraging physical priors for structured scenes and statistical constraints for attributes. Theoretically, our method enjoys a tighter out-of-distribution generalization bound than optimization-centric methods and reduces task gradient interference without explicit gradient projection or reweighting. Empirically, CORE-MTL consistently outperforms existing methods on visual multi-task benchmarks in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Hope-Rita/CORE-MTL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORE-MTL，一种因果启发的多任务学习框架，通过对共享表示进行语义-残差分解，将任务相关结构与无关变异分离，从而在分布内外场景均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有优化导向的多任务学习方法（如梯度平衡或架构修改）忽略共享表示的内容，无法解耦任务相关结构与虚假上下文，导致负迁移和泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出因果正交表示框架CORE-MTL，将共享表示分解为语义流（保留任务相关结构）和残差流（容纳干扰变异），在视觉领域结合物理先验和统计约束实现分解。
AI.result: 理论上有更紧的分布外泛化上界，减少了任务梯度干扰；在视觉多任务基准测试中，分布内外设置均一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CORE-MTL通过因果驱动的表示分解有效缓解了负迁移，提升了多任务学习的泛化能力。

title: Chroma Clues: Leveraging Color Statistics to Detect Synthetic Images
summary:
The evolution and dissemination of AI-synthesized images is occurring at an unprecedented rate. Image generators are making rapid progress in their goal of perfectly imitating natural images, which also challenges image forensics.
  In this work, we exploit an underexplored cue in current generative models, namely their weakness to imitate color statistics of natural images. We first show that the LPIPS loss used for training image generators is less sensitive to chrominance than to luminance, which may lead to statistical discrepancies in the colors of synthetic images. Building on this observation, we then introduce six hand-crafted color transformations and a method to learn a task-optimized color transform to statistically expose generated images. These transformations can be used in various ways. First, we define color-sensitive features at pixel-level or patch-level. A simple, interpretable classifier achieves with these features an average generalization accuracy of 93.27% and strong robustness against six types of post-processing. Second, we demonstrate that the transformations exhibit characteristic visual noise patterns in natural and synthetic image areas, which enables an intuitive visual image evaluation. Third, we demonstrate that the transforms can enhance color patterns in generated images for improved multiclass attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文利用生成模型在颜色统计上的弱点（LPIPS损失对色度不敏感），提出六种手工颜色变换和学习任务优化颜色变换的方法，用于检测AI合成图像。该方法在像素级和补丁级特征上达到93.27%的平均泛化准确率，对六种后处理具有强鲁棒性，并可进行可视化评估和多分类溯源。
AI.motivation: 当前AI生成图像传播迅速且质量日益逼真，给图像取证带来挑战。现有方法对颜色统计线索利用不足，作者观察到LPIPS损失对色度不敏感导致合成图像存在颜色统计差异，因此希望利用这一线索提升检测能力。
AI.method: 1) 分析LPIPS损失对色度与亮度的敏感性差异；2) 设计六种手工颜色变换；3) 提出学习任务优化颜色变换的方法；4) 在像素级和补丁级提取颜色敏感特征；5) 基于特征训练可解释分类器进行检测。
AI.result: 平均泛化准确率93.27%；对六种后处理操作具有强鲁棒性；可实现直观的可视化评估；能增强生成图像的颜色模式以改进多分类溯源。
AI.conclusion: 利用颜色统计线索是检测AI合成图像的有效途径，所提方法在泛化性、鲁棒性和可解释性方面均表现优异，并可扩展至多分类溯源任务。

title: Towards Resolving Optimization Conflicts Between Image- and Text-Based Person Re-Identification
summary: The joint optimization of image-based (I2I) and text-based (T2I) person re-identification (ReID) is hindered by modality discrepancies and conflicting training objectives, leading to suboptimal shared representations. While I2I ReID focuses on identity-level invariance across images of the same person, T2I ReID is driven by instance-specific textual descriptions tied to unique visual traits. This paper explores the fundamental difference between two ReID tasks and their optimization processes for effective training. Since I2I and T2I ReID are often studied separately, the loss functions optimized for one retrieval setting may negatively affect the representation quality required by the other. Motivated by these findings, we propose a decoupled two-stage training pipeline for learning a shared representation across image and text modalities. The pipeline is based on a single vision encoder that supports both I2I and T2I retrieval while avoiding cross-task interference during training. We provide extensive experiments across multiple configurations, varying domain mixing procedures, learning strategies, and task objectives. We observed that I2I ReID pre-training positively impacts the generalization ability to T2I data. Besides, we find that incorporating textual supervision during the vision encoder training stage enhances both I2I and T2I performance. We believe our insights provide a meaningful step toward unified ReID systems and cross-modal retrieval overall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解耦的两阶段训练流程，通过共享视觉编码器同时支持图像-图像（I2I）和文本-图像（T2I）行人重识别，避免了跨任务干扰，实验表明I2I预训练和文本监督能提升两种任务的性能。
AI.motivation: I2I和T2I行人重识别任务之间存在模态差异和冲突的训练目标，导致共享表示学习效果不佳，且这两个任务通常被独立研究，彼此的损失函数会相互干扰。
AI.method: 提出解耦的两阶段训练流程：第一阶段使用I2I任务预训练视觉编码器，第二阶段引入文本监督信号，使单一视觉编码器同时支持I2I和T2I检索，避免跨任务干扰。
AI.result: I2I ReID预训练能正向提升T2I数据的泛化能力；在视觉编码器训练阶段加入文本监督可同时提升I2I和T2I性能。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦训练方法为统一的跨模态行人重识别系统提供了有效思路，有助于推动跨模态检索的整体发展。

title: Ego-METAS: Egocentric online Multimodal Energy-efficient Temporal Action Segmentation benchmark
summary: To operate in the physical world, embodied agents must perceive their environment in an "always-on" fashion, selectively accessing the most informative sensors to balance energy constraints and task accuracy. Despite its importance for resource-constrained devices, energy-aware perception remains under-explored, with most prior work assuming unlimited compute. To address this, we introduce Ego-METAS: the first Egocentric online Multimodal Energy-efficient Temporal Action Segmentation benchmark. Ego-METAS provides a unified testbed of more than 100 hours of untrimmed egocentric video from EgoExo4D, CMU-MMAC, and CaptainCook4D, spanning 5 modalities (RGB, audio, gaze, IMU, and monochrome camera). We formulate an online temporal action segmentation task where models must dynamically select which sensors to activate at each timestep while strictly adhering to hardware-representative energy budgets. Alongside the benchmark, we release unified splits, cleaned annotations, pre-extracted features, and a diverse suite of baseline routing policies. Our evaluations show that optimal routing is highly scenario-dependent, and that existing policy-learning methods, designed primarily for trimmed clips, struggle to adapt to continuous, untrimmed environments. However, even simple dynamic fusion of complementary modalities (e.g., via random routing) proves critical for balancing predictive accuracy against strict energy budgets. Ultimately, Ego-METAS provides a standardized foundation to develop robust, cost-aware policies for autonomous, always-on embodied AI.

AI.tldr: 提出了Ego-METAS基准——首个面向第一人称在线多模态能效时序动作分割的基准，包含100多小时未裁剪视频、5种模态，要求模型在严格能耗预算下动态选择激活传感器，为资源受限的具身智能体提供标准化评估平台。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要在"始终在线"模式下感知环境，但受限于能源预算，必须选择性激活传感器以平衡能耗与任务精度。现有研究大多假设无限计算资源，缺乏针对能耗感知的标准化评估平台。
AI.method: 构建Ego-METAS基准：整合EgoExo4D、CMU-MMAC、CaptainCook4D数据集中的100+小时未裁剪第一人称视频，涵盖RGB、音频、注视、IMU、单色相机5种模态；定义在线时序动作分割任务，要求模型每步动态选择传感器并严格遵守硬件级能耗预算；提供统一数据划分、清理标注、预提取特征及多种基线路由策略。
AI.result: 最优路由策略高度依赖场景；现有主要为修剪片段设计的策略学习方法难以适应连续未裁剪环境；但即使是简单的动态互补模态融合（如随机路由）也对平衡精度与能耗至关重要。
AI.conclusion: Ego-METAS为开发面向始终在线具身AI的鲁棒、成本感知策略提供了标准化基础。

title: From Extrinsic to Intrinsic: Geodesic-Guided Representation Learning for 3D Geometric Data
summary: Geometric analysis fundamentally distinguishes between \textit{extrinsic} and \textit{intrinsic} perspectives. The dominant paradigm in current 3D representation learning relies on either extrinsic spatial structures or high-level semantics, struggling to capture the essence of shape identity and underlying manifold topology. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel 3D representation learning paradigm, namely \textbf{PRISM}, for \textbf{P}re-training, which learns isometric embeddings by \textbf{R}ecovering the \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{S}urface geodesic \textbf{M}etric. PRISM incorporates a topology-enforcing objective that explicitly constrains the structure of latent space, alongside a specialized two-stage training recipe mitigating sample imbalance inherent in the distribution of geodesic distances. Experiments demonstrate that our approach shows satisfactory accuracy, robustness, and high efficiency in geodesic distance prediction and achieves superior performance across diverse downstream tasks, including shape recognition, surface parameterization, and non-rigid correspondence. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/AidenZhao/PRISM.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一种新的3D表示学习范式，通过恢复内蕴表面测地度量来学习等距嵌入，在测地距离预测及多项下游任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有3D表示学习主要依赖外蕴空间结构或高层语义，难以捕捉形状本质和底层流形拓扑，缺乏对内蕴几何特性的建模。
AI.method: 提出PRISM范式，包含拓扑约束目标函数显式限制潜空间结构，以及两阶段训练策略缓解测地距离分布中的样本不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在测地距离预测上达到了令人满意的精度、鲁棒性和高效性，在形状识别、曲面参数化、非刚性对应等下游任务中取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过内蕴测地度量的恢复有效弥补了现有3D表示学习忽视流形拓扑的不足，代码将开源。

title: Vision-language Models for Driver Monitoring Systems: A Driver Activity Description Dataset
summary: Understanding subtle driver actions is essential for building reliable driver monitoring systems. Existing visionlanguage models (VLMs) are trained on general datasets and struggle to recognize fine distinctions in driver behaviors. This paper addresses this limitation by creating a detailed natural language version of the Drive&Act dataset. We evaluate three VLMs on our new benchmark using LLM-based scoring methods. Their performance on the new benchmark shows that they cannot reliably generate accurate fine-grained driver activity descriptions. Based on the labeled Drive&Act dataset we create a new Drive&Act description dataset containing finegrained descriptions to train VLMs on driver activity understanding. Cross dataset evaluation on the Driver Monitoring Dataset (DMD) shows that the VLM fine-tuned on our new Drive&Act description dataset generalizes well to actions in the DMD dataset. The VLM fine-tuned on our Drive&Act description dataset achieves an ACCR score of 76 outperforming the zero-shot VLM baseline with an ACCR score of 66. These findings demonstrate that adapting VLMs with richly described driver actions can significantly improve their ability to interpret driver behavior while also highlighting the need for more diverse datasets to support broader generalization in future applications. Our Drive&Act description dataset and code will be publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）难以识别细微驾驶行为的问题，创建了Drive&Act数据集的精细描述版本，并基于此微调VLM，使其在驾驶行为理解任务上的ACCR分数从66提升到76，验证了丰富描述对提升模型性能的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在通用数据集上训练，难以准确识别驾驶员行为的细微差异，限制了驾驶员监控系统的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 创建Drive&Act数据集的精细自然语言描述版本；2) 基于该数据集微调VLM；3) 使用LLM评分方法评估三个VLM在新基准上的表现；4) 在Driver Monitoring Dataset（DMD）上进行跨数据集评估。
AI.result: 微调后的VLM在ACCR评分上达到76，比零样本VLM基线（66分）提升10分；跨数据集评估显示模型具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 用丰富描述的驾驶行为数据适配VLM可显著提升其驾驶员行为理解能力，同时需要更多样化的数据集以支持更广泛的泛化应用。

title: Neural Acquisition & Representation of Subsurface Scattering
summary: We present a method to acquire and estimate the sub-surface scattering properties of light transport at a highly detailed level by learning the pixel footprint response at each point on the object surface. The reconstruction leverages 3D scanning techniques as input to a U-Net CNN. A stereo projector-camera setup using phase-shifted profilometry (PSP) patterns efficiently captures the data for a variety of scattering objects. Reconstructing dense pixel footprints allows for relighting with arbitrary high-resolution projector patterns. The final output is a relit color image. Qualitative and quantitative comparison against illuminated real-world captured images demonstrate that the predicted footprints are almost identical to the actual responses. The same model is trained for multiple views across multiple objects such that the learned representations can be used to generalize to unseen sub-surface scattering materials as well.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过学习物体表面每个点的像素足迹响应来获取和估计次表面光散射特性的方法，利用3D扫描和U-Net CNN进行重建，实现高分辨率重光照。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以高效获取高细节层次的次表面散射光传输特性，缺乏能够泛化到未知散射材料的学习表征。
AI.method: 使用立体投影-相机系统和相移轮廓测量（PSP）模式采集数据，以3D扫描作为U-Net CNN的输入，学习每个点的像素足迹响应，实现高分辨率重光照。
AI.result: 预测的像素足迹与实际响应几乎一致，定性和定量比较均验证了方法的有效性；模型可跨多视图、多物体训练，泛化到未见过的次表面散射材料。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够从稀疏输入中学习稠密像素足迹，实现高精度次表面散射重建和重光照，并具备良好的泛化能力。

title: Cross-Domain Dead Tree Detection via Knowledge Distillation in Aerial Imagery
summary: Detecting dead trees in aerial imagery is vital for assessing forest health, especially as tree mortality increases globally due to climate change, but domain variability and scarce labeled data often limit model generalization. This study advances the TreeMort-1T-UNet (Tree Mortality 1-Task U-Net) model, initially trained on Finnish aerial imagery (source domain), by applying knowledge distillation (KD) to adapt it to various target domains, including Polish, German, and Estonian datasets representing diverse forest types. We assess four KD variants: Basic, Self, Feature-level, and Ensemble, against a fine-tuning baseline, using Mean Tree IoU, Instance F1-score, Instance Precision, and Mean Centroid Error as key metrics, alongside representational analyses (e.g., cosine similarity, CKA, SSIM, t-SNE, and linear probing) for domain invariance. Feature-level KD outperforms others, yielding a Mean Tree IoU of 0.106, Instance F1-score of 0.63, Instance Precision of 0.55, and Mean Centroid Error of 3.039 on the Polish dataset, with robust precision across other target domains (e.g., 0.15 on Finnish, 0.67 on Polish, 0.60 on German, 0.59 on Estonian). It excels in low-data scenarios with fewer false positives and shows superior representational invariance (e.g., higher deep-layer CKA/SSIM, better domain mixing in t-SNE, and linear probing AUC of 0.95), making it ideal for precision-critical forestry applications. Additional ablation studies confirm that key components like feature alignment enhance its performance balance across metrics. Our findings demonstrate KD's potential to enhance transfer learning in remote sensing, offering a scalable, domain-robust tool for ecological monitoring and sustainable forest management.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过知识蒸馏（KD）技术，将TreeMort-1T-UNet模型从芬兰航拍图像（源域）迁移至波兰、德国、爱沙尼亚等目标域，发现Feature-level KD在跨域树木死亡检测中表现最佳，尤其在低数据场景下具有更强的域不变性和更少的假阳性，为精准林业监测提供了可扩展的鲁棒工具。
AI.motivation: 航拍图像中检测枯死树木对评估森林健康至关重要，但领域差异大、标注数据稀缺限制了模型的泛化能力，亟需高效的迁移学习方法。
AI.method: 基于TreeMort-1T-UNet模型，采用四种知识蒸馏变体（Basic、Self、Feature-level、Ensemble），与微调基线对比，使用Mean Tree IoU、Instance F1-score等指标评估，并通过余弦相似度、CKA、SSIM、t-SNE、线性探针等进行表征分析。
AI.result: Feature-level KD在波兰数据集上取得Mean Tree IoU 0.106、Instance F1-score 0.63、Instance Precision 0.55、Mean Centroid Error 3.039；跨域精度稳健（芬兰0.15、波兰0.67、德国0.60、爱沙尼亚0.59）；低数据场景下假阳性更少，线性探针AUC达0.95。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏能有效增强遥感领域的迁移学习，Feature-level KD在精度关键型林业应用中表现优异，为生态监测和可持续森林管理提供了可扩展、域鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Deep Learning for Remote Sensing to Improve Flood Inundation Mapping
comment: This paper has been selected as the top 10 student finalists in IGRASS 2026 paper competition
summary: Flooding is the most pervasive natural disaster worldwide. Timely and accurate flood inundation mapping are essential for informing disaster risk management. Optical satellite missions provide high-resolution, multispectral observations critical for flood detection and inundation mapping. However, their operational utility is severely constrained by cloud cover during extreme precipitation events. Conventional cloud-removal techniques based on temporal compositing or interpolation often fail to capture inundation dynamics. In this study, we introduce a cloud-removal framework for flood imagery based on Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models, leveraging the Masked Diffusion Transformer architecture. The proposed approach exploits self-attention mechanisms to capture wider spatial context and employs masked token modeling to explicitly learn the reconstruction of cloud-obscured regions. Trained on multispectral Sentinel-2B flood scenes with realistic cloud patterns, the model generates cloud-free image realizations that preserve both visual fidelity and hydrological consistency. Reconstruction performance is evaluated using standard image quality metrics alongside flood-specific hydrological measures, demonstrating improved continuity of water bodies and preservation of spectral signatures critical for water detection indices. The results indicate that diffusion-based generative modeling offers a robust and physically consistent alternative for cloud removal in optical flood monitoring, enabling more reliable, continuous observations to support disaster risk management and flood-related decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于去噪扩散概率模型和掩码扩散Transformer架构的云去除框架，用于光学洪水影像处理。该方法利用自注意力机制捕获空间上下文，通过掩码令牌建模学习重建云遮挡区域，在保持视觉保真度和水文一致性的同时实现洪水监测中的可靠云去除。
AI.motivation: 传统基于时间合成或插值的云去除技术无法有效捕捉洪水淹没动态变化，且光学卫星在极端降水事件期间受到严重云层限制，亟需一种新的云去除方法以支持时效性和准确性要求高的洪水灾害管理。
AI.method: 采用Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM)结合Masked Diffusion Transformer架构，利用自注意力机制捕获广泛空间上下文，通过掩码令牌建模显式学习云遮挡区域的重建。模型在包含真实云模式的多光谱Sentinel-2B洪水场景上进行训练。
AI.result: 在标准图像质量指标和洪水特异性水文指标上均表现优异，展示了更好的水体连续性以及保留了关键的水体检测光谱特征。
AI.conclusion: 基于扩散的生成建模为光学洪水监测中的云去除提供了一种鲁棒且物理一致的新方案，能够支持更可靠、连续的灾害管理观测数据获取。

title: Training-Free Composed Video Retrieval via Visual Representation-Guided Video-LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in large vision-language models have expanded video retrieval from simple text-based search to more flexible scenarios, where users may specify the desired result through both visual examples and textual instructions. In the CVPR 2026 Reason-Aware Composed Video Retrieval Challenge, the system is required to retrieve a target video according to a reference video and a modification instruction. To address this task, we develop Visual Representation-Guided Video-LLM Reasoning for Training-Free Composed Video Retrieval. Our framework first uses frozen DINOv3 models to obtain a compact set of visually relevant candidates, and then applies large vision-language models to evaluate whether each candidate satisfies the modification instruction. A final reasoning-based refinement is further performed on the top candidates to improve the first-ranked prediction. Without training, our system achieves 48.78 Recall@1 and 51.48 Recall@5 on the test set. Future work may further improve retrieval accuracy through stronger video-LLMs and detailed integration between visual representations and language reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的视觉表示引导视频-LLM推理框架，用于组合视频检索，在CVPR 2026挑战赛上取得48.78% Recall@1和51.48% Recall@5的成绩。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型的发展使视频检索从简单的文本搜索扩展到更灵活的场景（用户可通过视觉示例和文本指令指定需求），需要系统根据参考视频和修改指令检索目标视频。
AI.method: 首先使用冻结的DINOv3模型获取紧凑的视觉相关候选集，然后应用大视觉语言模型评估每个候选是否满足修改指令，最后对top候选进行基于推理的精炼以提升首位预测。
AI.result: 在测试集上Recall@1达到48.78%，Recall@5达到51.48%。
AI.conclusion: 未来可通过更强的视频-LLM及视觉表示与语言推理的深度融合进一步提升检索精度。

title: Hallucination-Aware Diffusion Sampling for Inverse Problems via Robust Prior Updates
summary: Diffusion-based inverse problem solvers can produce realistic reconstructions, but realism alone does not ensure that the recovered details are supported by the measurement. We study this failure as measurement-conditioned hallucination: visually meaningful content that is either implausible or inconsistent with the measured instance. Our analysis separates Bayes-rule-based diffusion inverse solvers into a prior update and a measurement-conditioning step, showing that hallucinated content can enter through the prior-side proposal before the measurement correction is applied. Motivated by this view, we propose Robust Prior Update (RPU), a solver-level module that probes the local stability of the diffusion prior update, re-anchors the resulting displacement at the current iterate, and leaves the measurement update unchanged. We instantiate RPU in DPS and evaluate it on FFHQ and ImageNet inverse problems using automatic metrics and human faithfulness studies. On FFHQ, RPU improves PSNR and LPIPS over DPS across box inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, and motion deblurring. In human judgments, RPU receives 91.9% of blind non-tie majority preferences and 91.1% of ground-truth-assisted non-tie preferences on FFHQ box inpainting, while the ImageNet Gaussian reader study is tie-heavy but favors RPU among non-tie cases. These results support a targeted claim: robustifying the prior update can improve instance faithfulness in diffusion inverse solvers, especially when the prior shapes weakly constrained content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Robust Prior Update (RPU)模块，通过稳定扩散模型先验更新来减少逆问题求解中的幻觉现象，在DPS框架上实现并验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散模型的逆问题求解器虽然能生成逼真的重建结果，但逼真度并不保证恢复的细节与测量数据一致，存在测量条件性幻觉问题。
AI.method: 提出RPU模块，探测扩散先验更新的局部稳定性，重新锚定当前迭代的位移，同时保持测量更新不变，并将该模块实例化到DPS求解器中。
AI.result: 在FFHQ上，RPU在框内修复、高斯去模糊和运动去模糊任务中提升了PSNR和LPIPS指标；人类评估中，RPU在FFHQ框内修复任务中获得91.9%的盲选多数偏好和91.1%的带真实参考的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒化先验更新可以提高扩散逆问题求解器的实例忠实度，尤其是在先验塑造弱约束内容时效果显著。

title: Detecting Pen-In-Air States from Video: A Proof-of-Concept Toward Complementary Handwriting Analysis
comment: accepted for 12th International Conference on Computer Technology Applications (ICCTA 2026)
summary: Dynamic aspects of handwriting are critical for assessing developmental disorders such as dysgraphia and are typically captured using digitizing tablets. However, tablet-based sensing restricts analysis of Pen-Up behavior to a short proximity range above the writing surface, potentially missing high-lift in-air movements. As a proof of concept, we investigate whether top-view video can provide a complementary source of information for inferring pen-contact states without relying on tablet proximity sensing. We propose an interpretable hybrid pipeline combining pen-tip tracking using a YOLO-based detector with kinematic feature extraction and machine learning classification. A pilot dataset of diverse handwriting videos was manually annotated at the frame level and evaluation used a Leave-One-Video-Out (LOVO) protocol. The method achieved reliable event-level detection of Pen-Up segments, with an F_2 score up to 0.805, consistent with the emphasis on recall in a screening-oriented setting. These results support the feasibility of video-based Pen-Up detection as a low-cost and non-intrusive complement to digitizing tablets, and provide a foundation for future large-scale studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于顶部视频的笔触状态检测方法，通过YOLO追踪笔尖、提取运动特征并结合机器学习分类，实现了对书写中提笔动作的可靠识别（F₂分数达0.805），可作为数字化平板的低成本、非侵入式补充手段，用于评估书写障碍。
AI.motivation: 传统数字化平板只能检测书写表面附近短距离内的提笔行为，无法捕捉高抬笔的空中运动，限制了对手写动态过程的完整分析，尤其影响对书写障碍（如书写困难症）的评估。
AI.method: 构建了可解释的混合流程：使用基于YOLO的目标检测器追踪笔尖，提取运动学特征，再结合机器学习分类器判断笔触状态。采用逐帧人工标注的多样手写视频数据集，使用留一视频交叉验证（LOVO）进行评估。
AI.result: 在事件级别的提笔片段检测中，方法取得了最高0.805的F₂分数，符合筛查场景对召回率的侧重需求。
AI.conclusion: 基于视频的提笔检测具有可行性，可作为数字化平板的低成本、非侵入式补充方案，为未来大规模研究奠定了基础。

title: VEDAL: Variational Error-Driven Asynchronous Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves remarkable novel view synthesis quality with real-time rendering, yet suffers from excessive memory consumption due to millions of Gaussian primitives. Existing pruning methods rely on heuristic importance scores or synchronous batch updates, leading to suboptimal compression and training instability. We propose VEDAL, a principled framework that formulates Gaussian pruning as variational free energy minimization. Our approach introduces (1) a prediction-error gating mechanism that asynchronously activates pruning based on per-Gaussian reconstruction uncertainty, and (2) a variational uncertainty head that models pruning decisions as latent variables with learnable priors. The free energy objective naturally balances reconstruction fidelity against model complexity through an information-theoretic lens. Extensive experiments on Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks&Temples, and Deep Blending demonstrate that VEDAL achieves 5.2x compression with only 0.31 dB PSNR drop, outperforming PUP 3D-GS by +0.05 dB at a higher compression ratio and LightGaussian by +0.35 dB at comparable quality, while maintaining real-time rendering at 185 FPS.

AI.tldr: VEDAL通过将高斯剪枝形式化为变分自由能最小化，实现了5.2倍压缩且仅损失0.31 dB PSNR，同时保持185 FPS的实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽能实时高质量渲染新视角，但大量高斯原语导致内存消耗过大。现有剪枝方法依赖启发式重要性分数或同步批量更新，导致压缩效果次优且训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出VEDAL框架：(1)基于预测误差的门控机制，根据逐高斯重建不确定性异步激活剪枝；(2)变分不确定性头，将剪枝决策建模为具有可学习先验的潜变量，通过自由能目标在保真度与模型复杂度之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks&Temples和Deep Blending数据集上，VEDAL实现5.2倍压缩，PSNR仅下降0.31 dB，优于PUP 3D-GS（更高压缩比下+0.05 dB）和LightGaussian（相同质量下+0.35 dB），渲染速度达185 FPS。
AI.conclusion: VEDAL通过信息论视角下的变分自由能最小化，有效解决了3DGS的内存压缩问题，在保持高质量实时渲染的同时大幅降低存储开销。

title: TROPHIES: Temporal Reconstruction of Places, Humans, and Cameras from Multi-view Videos
summary: Reconstructing humans and their surrounding environments in a globally consistent 4D space is essential for comprehensive perception. However, prior works typically assume single-view inputs or decouple humans, scenes, and cameras, making them unable to recover coherent geometry, stable motion, and physically aligned trajectories. These limitations motivate us to introduce a new task: unified human-scene-camera reconstruction from multi-view videos, which aims to jointly estimate dynamic humans, static scenes, and camera poses in one global coordinate frame. We propose TROPHIES--Temporal Reconstruction of Places, Humans, and Cameras from Multi-view Videos-a unified framework tailored for this task. TROPHIES features a Human Branch that models humans through temporal and spatial reasoning, and a Scene Branch that reconstructs static geometry with human-aware attention. A global alignment and optimization module couples both branches by enforcing scale consistency, contact priors, and cross-view temporal coherence. Experiments on EgoHuman and EgoExo4D demonstrate that TROPHIES achieves globally aligned, physically plausible 4D reconstructions and consistently outperforms existing paradigms in both global fidelity and human-scene consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出TROPHIES框架，从多视角视频中联合重建动态人体、静态场景和相机位姿，实现全局一致的4D空间感知，在EgoHuman和EgoExo4D数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常假设单视角输入或将人体、场景、相机解耦处理，无法恢复连贯的几何结构、稳定的运动以及物理对齐的轨迹，因此需要一种统一的人-景-相机联合重建方法。
AI.method: 提出TROPHIES统一框架，包含人体分支（通过时空推理建模人体）和场景分支（使用人体感知注意力重建静态几何），并通过全局对齐与优化模块（强制尺度一致性、接触先验和跨视角时间连贯性）耦合两个分支。
AI.result: 在EgoHuman和EgoExo4D数据集上，TROPHIES实现了全局对齐且物理合理的4D重建，在全局保真度和人景一致性方面持续优于现有范式。
AI.conclusion: 多视角视频中统一重建人体、场景和相机是实现全局一致4D感知的有效途径，TROPHIES框架通过时空推理和跨分支优化成功解决了该任务的核心挑战。

title: Multi-modal Video Representation Alignment for Robust Self-supervised Driver Distraction Detection
summary: Robust self-supervised learning of multi-modal video representations is critical for real-world applications such as driver distraction detection, where multiple sensors provide complementary but noisy signals. Conventional contrastive objectives, such as InfoNCE, assume all negatives are equally informative and all positives are reliable. However, this assumption is frequently violated in multi-modal data due to viewpoint changes, occlusions, or semantic overlap across modalities. In this work, we propose a novel framework for multi-modal global alignment that addresses these challenges by jointly modeling faulty negatives and unreliable or faulty positives. We introduce soft targets derived from cycle-consistency scores to relax the hard-negative assumption, and a weighting mechanism based on similarity distributions to mitigate the impact of noisy or faulty positives. Our approach extends traditional pairwise alignment to a principled global multi-modal setting, aggregating alignment information across all modality pairs. We evaluate our method on the Drive&Act dataset, demonstrating that it consistently outperforms both pairwise and existing global alignment baselines across RGB, IR, Depth, and Skeleton modalities. Cross-view ablation studies further show strong generalization to unseen camera perspectives, highlighting the robustness of our representations. Overall, our framework provides a scalable and effective solution for self-supervised global multi-modal representation learning, enabling reliable driver distraction detection and pioneering in real-world multi-modal video understanding. Our code will be published on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种鲁棒的自监督多模态全局对齐框架，通过软目标和加权机制处理错误负样本和不可靠正样本，在Drive&Act数据集上超越现有基线方法，用于驾驶员分心检测等实际应用。
AI.motivation: 传统对比学习假设所有负样本同等信息量、所有正样本可靠，但在多模态数据中这一假设常被违反（如视角变化、遮挡、模态间语义重叠），需要更鲁棒的对齐方法。
AI.method: 1) 引入基于循环一致性分数的软目标，放宽硬负样本假设；2) 基于相似性分布的加权机制，降低噪声正样本的影响；3) 从成对对齐扩展到全局多模态对齐，聚合所有模态对的对齐信息。
AI.result: 在Drive&Act数据集上，RGB、IR、Depth、Skeleton四种模态下一致优于成对对齐和现有全局对齐基线；跨视角消融实验显示对未见过的相机视角具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架提供了一种可扩展且有效的自监督全局多模态表示学习方案，为真实世界多模态视频理解（尤其是驾驶员分心检测）开辟了新路径。

title: Do Multimodal Agents Really Benefit from Tool Use? A Systematic Study of Capability Gains
summary: Tool-augmented multimodal agents show strong benchmark gains, often taken as evidence that agents have learned to use tools. We argue that this interpretation can be premature: a tool-call trace alone does not show whether the tool supplied answer-critical information. We study two representative ``thinking with images'' agents, Thyme and DeepEyesV2, across real-world understanding, OCR, chart understanding, and mathematical reasoning. Each agent is compared with its Tool-Free counterpart and with a Pure-Text Reasoner trained from the same source pool without tool-calling trajectories. Tool access yields little consistent aggregate improvement, does not reliably reduce generated-token cost, and leaves only a small tool-only solved set: 93% of DeepEyesV2's tool-solved problems and 96% of Thyme's are also solved by at least one non-tool setting. Mechanism ablations further show that the full tool-use loop does not consistently outperform either the tool-call format or the returned execution result alone. In the settings we study, the analyzed agents appear to learn tool-calling patterns more reliably than tool-contributed capabilities, suggesting that evaluation should distinguish tool availability from whether tools actually expand what agents can solve.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑工具增强多模态智能体（如Thyme和DeepEyesV2）的基准提升是否真正源于工具使用能力，发现工具带来的改进不一致、成本未降低，且绝大多数工具解决的任务也可被非工具设置解决，表明模型更倾向于学习工具调用模式而非工具带来的实际能力提升。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将工具增强多模态智能体的基准提升归因于其学会了使用工具，但这种解释可能为时过早：仅凭工具调用轨迹无法证明工具是否提供了回答关键信息。本文旨在严格区分工具可用性与工具是否实际扩展了智能体的求解能力。
AI.method: 选取Thyme和DeepEyesV2两种代表性"图像思考"智能体，在现实理解、OCR、图表理解和数学推理任务上，分别与无工具版本及纯文本推理器对比；通过机制消融实验分析完整工具使用循环、工具调用格式、执行结果各自的影响。
AI.result: 工具访问带来的聚合提升微乎其微；未可靠降低生成token成本；仅产生极小的工具独有解集：DeepEyesV2的93%和Thyme的96%的工具解决任务至少能被一种非工具设置解决；完整工具使用循环并不始终优于工具调用格式或执行结果单独使用。
AI.conclusion: 在研究的设置中，分析的自体更可靠地学习了工具调用模式，而非工具带来的实际能力；评估应区分工具可用性与工具是否真正扩展了智能体的求解能力。

title: PRIMA: Boosting Animal Mesh Recovery with Biological Priors and Test-Time Adaptation
summary: We present PRIMA (*PRI*ors for *M*esh *A*daptation), a framework for robust 3D quadruped mesh recovery under severe species and pose imbalance. Existing animal reconstruction methods often regress toward mean shapes and poses due to limited 3D supervision and long-tailed species distributions, resulting in poor generalization to underrepresented animals and rare articulations. PRIMA addresses this challenge through three key contributions. First, we incorporate BioCLIP embeddings as biological priors to inject semantic and morphological knowledge into the reconstruction process, enabling more accurate and generalizable shape prediction across diverse quadrupeds. Second, we introduce a test-time adaptation (TTA) strategy that refines SMAL predictions using 2D reprojection constraints together with auxiliary keypoint guidance, improving pose and shape estimation while enabling the generation of high-quality pseudo-3D annotations from existing 2D datasets. Third, leveraging this TTA framework, we construct Quadruped3D, a large-scale pseudo-3D dataset that covers diverse species and pose variations to systematically improve model performance. Extensive experiments on Animal3D, CtrlAni3D, Quadruped2D, and Animal Kingdom demonstrate that PRIMA achieves state-of-the-art results, with particularly strong improvements on underrepresented species and challenging poses. Our results highlight the importance of biological priors and adaptation-driven data expansion for scalable and generalizable animal mesh recovery. Code is available at https://github.com/AdaptiveMotorControlLab/PRIMA.

AI.tldr: PRIMA是一个利用生物先验知识和测试时自适应策略从单张图像鲁棒重建3D四足动物网格的框架，特别针对物种和姿态分布不平衡问题，在多个基准上达到了最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有动物重建方法因3D监督有限和物种长尾分布，常回归到平均形状和姿态，对稀有物种和罕见动作泛化能力差。
AI.method: 1）融入BioCLIP嵌入作为生物先验注入语义和形态知识；2）提出测试时自适应(TTA)策略，利用2D重投影约束和关键点引导优化SMAL预测；3）利用TTA构建大规模伪3D数据集Quadruped3D，覆盖多样物种和姿态变化。
AI.result: 在Animal3D、CtrlAni3D、Quadruped2D和Animal Kingdom等多个数据集上达到最先进结果，特别在稀有物种和挑战性姿态上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 生物先验和自适应驱动的数据扩展对于可扩展且泛化的动物网格重建至关重要。

title: Explainable Forensics of Manipulated Segments in Untrimmed Long Videos
summary: The rapid advancement of AI-driven video generation has transformed content creation, while simultaneously increasing the risk of misinformation through localized manipulations in long-form videos. Existing video forensic methods predominantly operate on short, independent clips, and thus fail to capture realistic scenarios where AI-generated content is sparsely embedded within otherwise authentic footage. To bridge this gap, we formulate the task of Temporal AI-Generated Segment Localization and Explanation, which targets authenticity detection, temporal localization, and interpretable analysis of manipulated segments in untrimmed long videos. We further introduce TASLE, a large-scale benchmark comprising 12,472 untrimmed videos with diverse manipulation patterns and rich annotation signals, including temporal boundaries, authenticity labels, and segment-level rationales. In addition, we propose MSLoc, a coarse-to-fine forensic baseline that combines a boundary-sensitive proposal generation module for efficient long-video scanning with an MLLM-based refinement module for precise boundary localization and interpretable reasoning. Experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed baseline, highlighting the importance of segment-level explainable forensics for long-form AI-generated video analysis. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://debby-0527.github.io/TASLE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对长视频中AI生成片段的时间定位与解释任务（TASLE），构建了包含12,472个未修剪视频的大型基准数据集，并设计了粗到细的取证基线方法MSLoc，实现了高效定位与可解释分析。
AI.motivation: 现有视频取证方法主要处理短片段，无法应对AI生成内容稀疏嵌入真实长视频的现实场景，缺乏对长视频中局部操控的检测、定位与解释能力。
AI.method: 提出MSLoc粗到细取证基线：1）边界敏感提案生成模块实现高效长视频扫描；2）基于MLLM的精炼模块实现精确定位与可解释推理。同时构建TASLE大规模基准数据集（12,472个未修剪视频），包含多样操控模式和丰富标注信号。
AI.result: 实验验证了所提基线方法的有效性，证明了长视频中片段级可解释取证的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了长视频AI生成内容局部定位与解释的空白，提供了基准数据集与基线方法，推动可解释视频取证领域发展。

title: GC-MoE: Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture of Experts for Histology-Based Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Histology-based single-cell spatial transcriptomics (ST) estimation aims to predict gene expression for individual cells from histopathological images and cell locations, reducing the need for costly single-cell ST measurements. Unlike existing histology-to-ST methods that mainly predict spot-level profiles for local regions containing multiple cells, this task requires modeling cell-to-cell expression variability, which is strongly structured by cell type. We propose Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture-of-Experts (GC-MoE), which estimates cell-type probabilities with a routing network and softly combines cell-type-specific experts for gene expression prediction. To further encode cell-type-dependent gene programs, we introduce the Cell-Type-Specific Co-Expression-Aware Predictor (CAP), together with a lightweight Cell-to-Cell Interaction Attention (C2CA) module for neighboring-cell context. Experiments and ablations on public single-cell ST datasets show consistent improvements over existing single-cell and adapted spot-level baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GC-MoE方法，利用细胞类型特异性专家混合模型和共表达感知预测器，从组织学图像和细胞位置预测单细胞基因表达，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有组织学到空间转录组方法主要预测包含多个细胞的局部区域（斑点级别）的表达谱，无法捕捉细胞类型结构化驱动的细胞间表达变异性。因此需要一种能从组织学图像和细胞位置直接估计单细胞级别基因表达的方法，以减少对昂贵单细胞ST测量的依赖。
AI.method: 提出GC-MoE框架，包含三个核心组件：1）路由网络估计细胞类型概率；2）细胞类型特异性专家混合（MoE）软组合预测基因表达；3）细胞类型特异性共表达感知预测器（CAP）编码细胞类型依赖的基因程序，以及轻量级细胞间交互注意力（C2CA）模块捕捉邻域细胞上下文信息。
AI.result: 在公开的单细胞ST数据集上的实验和消融研究表明，该方法在单细胞级别基因表达预测上一致优于现有的单细胞方法和经过适配的斑点级别基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GC-MoE通过明确建模细胞类型特异性基因表达程序和细胞间交互，有效提升了从组织学图像预测单细胞空间转录组的准确性，为降低成本、推广单细胞ST应用提供了可行方案。

title: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory for Video World Models
summary: Video world models aim to simulate controllable visual environments, but long-horizon rollouts depend on what the model remembers after observations leave its native context window. Explicit memories retain frames or online 3D reconstructions, which can suffer from heuristic retrieval errors, redundant appearance storage, or reconstruction artifacts. Implicit memories compress history into a compact state, but existing designs are not explicitly constrained to encode cross-view scene geometry. We propose GIM-World, a geometry-aware implicit memory framework for video world models. A lightweight transformer encoder compresses variable-length history into fixed-size memory tokens, a camera-queryable geometry head distills 3D scene structure from a frozen foundation model into the memory during training, and an information-guided pruning rule keeps encoding cost bounded as history grows. The geometry teacher is discarded at inference, leaving a lightweight memory module. Experiments on MIND show that GIM-World better preserves long-horizon geometric and visual consistency than both explicit- and implicit-memory baselines.

AI.tldr: GIM-World提出了一种几何感知的隐式记忆框架，通过轻量级Transformer编码器将可变长度历史压缩为固定大小的记忆令牌，并利用相机可查询的几何头从冻结的基石模型中蒸馏3D场景结构，在保持长程几何与视觉一致性方面优于显式和隐式记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型在长程推演中面临记忆瓶颈：显式记忆（如帧缓存或在线3D重建）存在检索错误、冗余存储或重建伪影；隐式记忆虽能压缩历史，但缺乏对跨视角场景几何结构的显式约束。
AI.method: 1) 轻量级Transformer编码器将可变长度历史压缩为固定大小的记忆令牌；2) 相机可查询的几何头在训练时从冻结的基石模型中蒸馏3D场景结构；3) 信息引导的剪枝策略控制计算成本随历史增长而保持有界；推理时丢弃几何教师模块，仅保留轻量级记忆模块。
AI.result: 在MIND数据集上，GIM-World在长程几何一致性和视觉一致性两方面均优于显式记忆基线和隐式记忆基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入几何感知的隐式记忆机制，GIM-World有效提升了视频世界模型在长程推演中的场景理解能力，且推理阶段保持轻量化。

title: Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Reference Conditioning for Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) aims to synthesize high-fidelity videos that follow text prompts while faithfully preserving a reference identity. Despite recent progress, existing IPVG methods still struggle to balance high-level semantic control and low-level identity fidelity. To bridge this gap, we propose ST-DRC, an effective Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Reference Conditioning framework for identity-preserving text-to-video generation. At the framework level, ST-DRC performs latent in-context feature injection by encoding the reference image with the video VAE and concatenating it with noisy video latents, enabling rich low-level identity details to be accessed without additional adapters. To separate identity-aware reference retrieval from appearance copying, we introduce TASS-RoPE, a Temporal-Adjacent Spatial-Shifted RoPE scheme that places reference tokens near the video sequence in time but shifts them in space, allowing reference information to flow through spatio-temporal attention while suppressing pixel-level copy-paste shortcuts. To further prevent shortcut learning and strengthen the otherwise diluted identity supervision in the diffusion objective, we combine appearance-invariant reference augmentation with face-guided identity objectives, encouraging the model to preserve identity under variations in color, pose, and layout. At inference time, we introduce a three-stream reference classifier-free guidance strategy that independently controls text adherence and reference fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that ST-DRC achieves strong identity preservation, prompt alignment, temporal consistency, and video quality with a lightweight design built on LTX-2.3. Our method ranks among the top submissions in the facial identity-preserving video generation track, validating the effectiveness of spatial-temporal decoupled reference conditioning.

AI.tldr: ST-DRC提出了一种时空解耦参考条件框架，用于身份保持的视频生成，通过潜在上下文特征注入、TASS-RoPE机制、不变性参考增强和三流无分类器引导，在保持身份的同时实现高质量视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有身份保持视频生成方法难以平衡高层语义控制和低层身份保真度，亟需一种既能保留丰富身份细节又避免简单像素复制捷径的有效框架。
AI.method: 1) 通过视频VAE编码参考图像并与噪声潜变量拼接实现潜在上下文特征注入；2) 提出TASS-RoPE机制，在时间上靠近视频序列但在空间上偏移参考token；3) 结合外观不变性参考增强和面部引导的身份目标；4) 引入三流参考无分类器引导策略。
AI.result: 在面部身份保持视频生成赛道排名靠前，实现了强身份保持、提示对齐、时间一致性和视频质量。
AI.conclusion: ST-DRC的时空解耦参考条件框架有效验证了身份保持视频生成中分离身份感知参考检索和外观复制的可行性，轻量级设计也能达到优异效果。

title: Reason-Then-Retrieve for CoVR-R with Structured Edit Prompts and Dense-Sparse Fusion
summary: CoVR-R studies reason-aware composed video retrieval: given a reference video and an edit instruction, the system must retrieve the target video that satisfies the edit. The main difficulty is that the target is not described directly; it must be inferred from fine-grained changes in object identity, action order, final state, hand interaction, and scene transition. We build a zero-shot reason-then-retrieve pipeline around Qwen3.5-27B. For each gallery video, the model generates a retrieval-oriented structured description and a dense embedding by pooling generated-token hidden states with token-dependent weights. For each query, the model first performs edit reasoning over the reference video and instruction, then generates a target-video description whose hidden states serve as the query embedding. We complement dense retrieval with a TF-IDF branch over the generated texts and fuse the two rankings with split-specific weights. On validation, the current best submission reaches 80.81 at R@1, 94.86 at R@5, 97.11 at R@10, and 98.59 at R@50. On the blind test split, it reaches 89.73 at R@1, 95.79 at R@5, 96.63 at R@10, and 97.98 at R@50.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种零样本的“先推理后检索”流程（基于Qwen3.5-27B），通过编辑推理、结构化描述生成、密集检索与TF-IDF融合排名，在CoVR-R视频检索任务上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: CoVR-R任务要求根据参考视频和编辑指令检索目标视频，但目标没有直接描述，需从对象身份、动作顺序、最终状态、手部交互和场景转换等细粒度变化中推断，现有方法难以处理这种隐式推理。
AI.method: 1) 构建零样本reason-then-retrieve流程，基于Qwen3.5-27B；2) 对每个图库视频生成面向检索的结构化描述和带token依赖权重的密集嵌入；3) 对每个查询先进行编辑推理，再生成目标视频描述，用其隐藏状态作为查询嵌入；4) 结合密集检索和基于生成文本的TF-IDF分支，用split-specific权重融合排序。
AI.conclusion: 零样本方法在CoVR-R任务上达到了领先性能，验证了先推理后检索和融合排序策略的有效性。

title: Initialization is Half the Battle: Generating Diverse Images from a Guidance Potential Posterior
summary: Despite the remarkable fidelity of generative models, they frequently suffer from mode collapse. Existing strategies for enhancing diversity predominantly focus on intervening during the generation trajectory. We identify a critical oversight that the standard Gaussian initialization often causes trajectories to collapse into dominant modes because it is agnostic to the guidance potential landscape. In this work, we formulate selecting the initial noise from a guidance potential posterior, which effectively re-weights the prior towards diversity-rich regions. To sample from this distribution efficiently, we introduce Diversity-inducing Initialization (DivIn), which leverages Langevin dynamics to actively navigate the initialization landscape, steering initial noise away from collapsing regions while anchoring them to the valid data manifold. Our method serves as an inference-time diversity enhancement compatible with both diffusion and flow matching models. Extensive experiments show that DivIn exhibits a superior performance in both class-to-image and text-to-image scenarios. Furthermore, we highlight that as DivIn is orthogonal to trajectory-based methods, combining them significantly expands the diversity-quality Pareto frontier beyond what either achieves in isolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DivIn方法，通过在推理阶段从指导势能后验中采样初始噪声，利用朗之万动力学将初始噪声引导至多样性丰富的区域，有效提升扩散模型和流匹配模型的生成多样性，且与轨迹干预方法正交互补。
AI.motivation: 标准高斯初始化对引导势能景观无感知，导致生成轨迹容易坍缩到主导模式中，现有方法主要干预生成轨迹而忽略了初始化阶段的关键影响。
AI.method: 从指导势能后验中采样初始噪声，利用朗之万动力学主动导航初始化景观，将初始噪声引导远离坍缩区域并锚定在有效数据流形上。
AI.result: 在类别到图像和文本到图像场景中均展现出优越性能，且与基于轨迹的方法结合时，能显著扩展多样性-质量帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: DivIn是一种推理时多样性增强方法，兼容扩散模型和流匹配模型，与现有轨迹干预方法正交，二者结合可超越各自单独使用的效果。

title: Active Exploring like a Pigeon: Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning via Agentic Vision-Language Models
summary: Enabling Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform spatial reasoning remains challenging. Existing approaches treat VLMs as passive observers, which is difficult for real-world applications. Moreover, reinforcement learning methods rely on sparse rewards, limiting their effectiveness for complex reasoning tasks. Inspired by pigeons' building and exploiting cognitive maps for navigation, we propose a novel agentic pipeline for spatial reasoning. First, we introduce a new \emph{dynamic cognitive map} parameterizing scene layout as object positions and orientations, serving as persistent memory for new observations. Second, we propose a novel \emph{Spatial Assertion Codes (SAC)}, Python expressions programmatically describing spatial relationships. By collaborating with the dynamic cognitive map, SAC enables verification of intermediate reasoning steps, providing dense reward signals. We optimize the model via supervised and reinforcement finetuning. Experiments on the MindCube benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art performance with \emph{80.5\%} overall accuracy, outperforming the best current method by \emph{29.5} accuracy points (a relative improvement of \emph{53.2\%}) on the challenging \textsc{Rotation} subset. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/dw-dengwei/active-spatial-reasoning.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受鸽子认知地图启发的主动空间推理管线，通过动态认知地图和空间断言代码实现了场景布局参数化与中间推理步骤验证，在MindCube基准上达到80.5%的准确率，较现有最佳方法在Rotation子集上提升53.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在空间推理中被当作被动观察者，难以应对真实世界应用；强化学习方法依赖稀疏奖励，对复杂推理任务效果有限。
AI.method: 1) 提出动态认知地图，将场景布局参数化为物体位置和朝向，作为持久记忆；2) 提出空间断言代码(SAC)，用Python表达式程序化描述空间关系，与动态认知地图协作提供密集奖励信号；3) 通过监督学习和强化微调优化模型。
AI.result: 在MindCube基准上总体准确率80.5%，在Rotation子集上比现有最佳方法高出29.5个百分点（相对提升53.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的主动空间推理框架有效提升了VLM的空间推理能力，代码和数据已开源。

title: Retrieve What's Missing: Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval for Consistent Long Video Generation
summary: Maintaining long-term geometric consistency remains challenging for long-horizon autoregressive video generation. Memory-augmented generative models address this by retrieving historical frames, but their effectiveness depends on two key design choices: what 3D-geometric evidence should represent past observations, and how memory frames should be selected from this evidence. Existing methods often rely on camera poses or field-of-view overlap, which are lightweight but too coarse to reason about pixel-wise visibility, or use explicit 3D reconstruction, which provides fine-grained evidence but is costly to maintain over long rollouts. We propose Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (COVRAG), a depth-based memory retrieval framework that uses pretrained 3D priors to construct a target-view coverage map as lightweight 3D memory evidence. For frame selection, COVRAG maximizes residual coverage gain, iteratively retrieving frames that explain target-view regions not covered by the current context or previously selected memories. To improve scalability in long-video generation, we introduce sliding-window depth caching for efficient geometry estimation. Experiments on RealEstate10K and DL3DV10K show that COVRAG improves long-horizon geometric consistency while maintaining low latency compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: COVRAG是一种基于深度的记忆检索框架，通过目标视图覆盖图和迭代残差覆盖增益选择机制，在长时间自回归视频生成中提升几何一致性，同时保持低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强生成模型在长时间视频生成中难以保持几何一致性，现有方法要么依赖相机位姿等粗略信息，要么依赖显式3D重建等高成本方法，缺乏既能提供细粒度可见性证据又轻量高效的方案。
AI.method: COVRAG利用预训练3D先验构建目标视图覆盖图作为轻量级3D记忆证据，通过最大化残差覆盖增益迭代选择能够解释未被当前上下文覆盖区域的记忆帧，并引入滑动窗口深度缓存实现高效几何估计。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和DL3DV10K数据集上，COVRAG在提升长时间几何一致性的同时，相比基线方法保持了低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度的轻量级3D记忆证据结合覆盖最大化帧选择策略，可以有效地在长时间视频生成中平衡几何一致性与计算效率。

title: Places in the Wild: A Large, High-Resolution RAW Photograph Dataset for Ecologically Valid Vision Research
summary: Large image datasets have accelerated progress in cognitive neuroscience and computer vision. However, most datasets are low-resolution, internet-sourced JPEGs with unknown capture conditions and limited spatial context. Places in the Wild is a dataset of 67,574 high-resolution photographs collected in situ across 810 physical locations spanning 260 basic-level scene categories, including indoor, urban, and natural environments. At each location, a 45-megapixel Canon EOS R5 mounted on a panoramic tripod captured 72 images at 5-degree horizontal intervals plus 12 images at varying elevations, yielding dense 360-degree viewpoint sampling. All images were recorded simultaneously as 14-bit RAW (CR3) files and compressed JPEGs, preserving sensor-level detail for analyses of luminance, contrast, color, and other image statistics. The dataset is accompanied by complete EXIF metadata and a suite of image-quality metrics. Places in the Wild supports research on viewpoint-dependent recognition in humans and models, training and evaluation of scene-understanding systems under realistic conditions, characterization of natural scene statistics, and experiments requiring near-full-field visual displays.

AI.tldr: Places in the Wild是一个包含67,574张高分辨率照片的数据集，在810个物理地点、260个场景类别中，使用45-MP相机以360度视角采集，同时提供RAW和JPEG格式及完整元数据，支持场景认知和计算机视觉研究。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模图像数据集多为低分辨率、来自互联网的JPEG图片，拍摄条件未知且缺乏空间上下文信息，无法支持对视点依赖的认知机制和真实场景统计特性的研究。
AI.method: 在810个物理地点使用45-MP Canon EOS R5相机安装在全景三脚架上，以5度水平间隔拍摄72张图像，加上不同仰角的12张图像，实现密集的360度视点采样。所有图像同时记录为14位RAW文件和压缩JPEG，并附带完整EXIF元数据和图像质量指标。
AI.result: 构建了一个包含67,574张高分辨率照片、覆盖260个基本场景类别（室内、城市、自然环境）的数据集，提供了传感器级别的细节信息用于亮度、对比度、颜色等图像统计分析。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持人类和模型视角依赖的识别研究、真实条件下场景理解系统的训练与评估、自然场景统计特征描述以及需要近全视野显示的心理物理实验。

title: MORPHOS: Autoregressive 4D Generation with Temporal Structured Latents
summary: We present MORPHOS, a novel autoregressive framework that generates dynamic 3D assets from videos across diverse representations, including meshes, 3D Gaussians, and radiance fields. Existing methods are typically limited to a single representation, struggle to model topological changes, or fail to maintain temporal consistency over long videos. To address these limitations, we introduce the Temporal Structured Latents (T-SLAT), a unified 4D representation that jointly encodes geometry and appearance along the temporal dimension. Leveraging T-SLAT, MORPHOS autoregressively generates dynamic 3D assets via causal attention, conditioning each frame on its preceding history to ensure temporal consistency while handling evolving topologies. We also propose a temporal-structural augmentation to mitigate error accumulation in autoregressive generation. MORPHOS achieves state-of-the-art performance in appearance and competitive results in geometry across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating superior generalization across various representations and robustness in long-horizon generation.

AI.tldr: MORPHOS是一个自回归框架，能从视频中生成动态3D资产，支持网格、3D高斯和辐射场等多种表示，通过时序结构化潜变量（T-SLAT）实现统一的4D表示，在长时生成中保持时序一致性并处理拓扑变化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常局限于单一表示、难以建模拓扑变化或在长视频中保持时序一致性，亟需一种统一且鲁棒的动态3D生成框架。
AI.method: 提出时序结构化潜变量（T-SLAT）作为统一的4D表示，联合编码几何与外观及时序信息；采用因果注意力机制的自回归生成，逐帧依赖历史信息；提出时序-结构增强方法以减少自回归生成中的误差累积。
AI.result: 在多个基准上外观性能达到SOTA，几何性能具有竞争力；在多种表示上展现强泛化能力，长时生成具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MORPHOS通过T-SLAT和自回归策略有效解决了动态3D生成中的表示单一、拓扑变化和时序一致性问题，展现了优越的泛化性能。

title: Question-Aware Evidence Ledgers for Video Relational Reasoning
comment: Technical report for the VRR Challenge at the VideoLLMs Workshop, CVPR 2026
summary: The VRR-QA challenge evaluates visual relational reasoning in videos, where answers often depend on implicit spatial relations, event boundaries, target identity, and dialogue context rather than a single salient frame. We present a test-time reasoning pipeline built around a strong GPT-5.5 video QA solver and a set of question-aware evidence ledgers. The initial solver answers each question from a uniform video representation, while routed ledgers are prompted to make the required targets, count units, reference frames, and temporal or spatial scope explicit for counting, spatial, endpoint, viewpoint, and dialogue reasoning. External tools such as open-vocabulary detection, depth cues, pair crops, ASR, and scene-graph ledgers are used only as evidence sources. A conservative gate keeps the current answer unless independent evidence uniquely supports a different option. The final evidence-gated pipeline achieves 92.95% overall accuracy and 93.79% macro accuracy on the challenge test split.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于GPT-5.5的测试时推理流水线，通过问题感知证据账本和保守门控机制，在VRR-QA挑战中达到92.95%的整体准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频中的视觉关系推理往往依赖隐式空间关系、事件边界、目标身份和对话上下文，而非单一显著帧，现有方法难以处理这些复杂性。
AI.method: 构建了围绕GPT-5.5的测试时推理流水线：初始求解器从统一视频表示回答问题；路由账本将目标、计数单位、参考帧等显式化；引入外部工具（开放词汇检测、深度线索、成对裁剪、ASR、场景图）作为证据源；保守门控仅在独立证据唯一支持另一选项时修改当前答案。
AI.result: 在挑战测试集上达到92.95%整体准确率和93.79%宏平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 证据门控流水线有效提升了视频关系推理的准确性，证明了多源证据融合与保守决策机制的有效性。

title: Not All Points Are Equal: Uncertainty-Aware 4D LiDAR Scene Synthesis
comment: CVPR 2026 E2E3D Workshop; GitHub at https://github.com/worldbench/U4D
summary: Constructing faithful 4D worlds from LiDAR-acquired sequences is crucial for embodied AI, yet current generative frameworks apply uniform modeling capacity across all spatial regions. This ignores that perceptual difficulty varies dramatically within a single scan: distant surfaces, occluded boundaries, and small-scale objects carry far higher uncertainty than well-observed structures. We present U4D, a new framework that explicitly leverages spatial uncertainty to guide LiDAR scene generation in a "hard-to-easy" schedule. U4D derives per-point uncertainty maps via Shannon Entropy from a pretrained segmentor, then applies an unconditional diffusion stage to synthesize high-entropy areas with precise geometry, followed by a conditional completion stage that fills in the remaining regions using these structures as priors. A MoST (Mixture of Spatio-Temporal) block further maintains cross-frame coherence by dynamically balancing spatial detail and temporal continuity. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI demonstrate state-of-the-art scene fidelity, temporal consistency, and downstream performance.

AI.tldr: U4D利用空间不确定性引导的"由难到易"调度策略，通过逐点熵图、无条件扩散生成高不确定性区域、条件补全剩余区域以及MoST模块保持时空一致性，在LiDAR场景生成中实现SOTA保真度、时间一致性和下游性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成框架对所有空间区域采用统一建模能力，忽略了单次扫描中不同区域（远处表面、遮挡边界、小物体）感知难度差异巨大的问题。
AI.method: 1) 通过预训练分割器的香农熵导出逐点不确定图；2) 无条件扩散阶段合成高熵区域（几何精确）；3) 条件补全阶段利用高熵区域作为先验填充剩余区域；4) MoST模块动态平衡空间细节与时间连续性。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上达到了场景保真度、时间一致性和下游性能的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用空间不确定性引导生成，能显著提升4D LiDAR场景的真实性和实用性。

title: ToolFG: Towards Well-Grounded Fine-Grained Image Classification
summary: Fine-grained image classification (FGIC) has broad applications and has attracted significant research attention. In this paper, we explore a novel paradigm for solving FGIC by proposing \textbf{ToolFG}, the first tool-integrated MLLM-based framework tailored to FGIC. ToolFG enables MLLMs to autonomously and flexibly use external tools during the reasoning process, actively interact with images, and collect verifiable visual cues for distinguishing highly similar categories in a more \textit{reliable} and \textit{well-grounded} manner. To equip the model with such tool-use ability, we design a novel \textbf{MCTS-guided tool-use knowledge distillation mechanism}, which effectively mines tool-use- and FGIC-relevant knowledge from advanced proprietary MLLMs for model training. Furthermore, we propose a \textbf{model-tool co-evolution mechanism} that jointly refines the toolset and the model's tool-use policy, driving them toward a mutually adapted and FGIC-specialized state. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolFG，首个集成外部工具的MLLM细粒度图像分类框架，通过MCTS引导的工具使用知识蒸馏和模型-工具协同进化机制，让模型能自主调用工具获取可靠视觉线索进行分类。
AI.motivation: 细粒度图像分类中，高度相似的类别难以区分，现有MLLM缺乏可靠的外部验证手段，需要一种更可靠、有据可依的分类方式。
AI.method: 1）提出ToolFG框架，让MLLM在推理过程中自主调用外部工具与图像交互；2）设计MCTS引导的工具使用知识蒸馏机制，从高级MLLM中提取工具使用和FGIC相关知识；3）提出模型-工具协同进化机制，联合优化工具集和模型工具使用策略。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了ToolFG框架在细粒度图像分类任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ToolFG通过工具集成和协同进化，为细粒度图像分类提供了更可靠、有据可依的解决范式。

title: Moment-Video: Diagnosing Temporal Fidelity of Video MLLMs on Momentary Visual Events
summary: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on general and long-form video understanding, yet their ability to preserve brief answer-critical visual evidence remains underexplored. Many practical questions are determined by momentary visual events: localized actions or state transitions that may last only a few frames. Such evidence can be skipped by sparse frame sampling, suppressed by visual-token compression, or diluted by coarse temporal aggregation, causing failures that language-side reasoning cannot reliably recover. We introduce Moment-Video, a benchmark for diagnosing the temporal fidelity of video MLLMs through momentary visual event understanding. Each question is grounded in a localized, visually observable, and sampling-sensitive event, requiring models to notice, count, describe, or reason about transient evidence rather than rely on persistent objects, global scene context, or language priors. Moment-Video contains 1,000 human-verified video-QA pairs across 7 domains and 25 fine-grained subcategories, covering four task types: Temporal Occurrence, Temporal Counting, Action Description, and Temporal Reasoning. We evaluate 33 proprietary and open-source MLLMs on Moment-Video. The best-performing model, Seed-2.0-Pro, achieves only 39.6% overall accuracy, while most open-source models remain below 25%, revealing a substantial gap in momentary visual event understanding. Diagnostic analyses show that denser frame sampling improves some models but does not eliminate the bottleneck, and longer videos introduce stronger temporal-localization challenges. These findings suggest that current video MLLMs still lack temporally faithful representations for capturing, preserving, and using brief but decisive visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Moment-Video基准，用于评估视频多模态大模型在理解瞬时视觉事件方面的能力。测试发现，最佳模型Seed-2.0-Pro仅达39.6%准确率，多数开源模型低于25%，表明当前模型在捕获短暂关键视觉证据方面存在严重不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态大模型在通用和长视频理解上进步显著，但忽略了它们对短暂但关键的视觉证据（如几帧内的动作或状态变化）的保留能力。这类信息易被稀疏采样、视觉token压缩或粗粒度时间聚合所丢失，且语言推理难以弥补。
AI.method: 构建Moment-Video基准，包含1,000个人工验证的视频问答对，覆盖7个领域、25个细分类别，分为时间出现、时间计数、动作描述和时间推理四种任务。每个问题均基于局部、可观察且对采样敏感的瞬时事件设计，避免依赖持续物体或全局场景信息。
AI.result: 评估33个模型，最好模型Seed-2.0-Pro准确率仅39.6%，多数开源模型低于25%。更密集的帧采样能改善部分模型但未消除瓶颈，更长视频带来更强的时间定位挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频MLLMs缺乏时间忠实表示，无法有效捕获、保留和利用短暂但决定性的视觉证据，这构成了一个关键的能力瓶颈。

title: Why Not Hyperparameter-Friendly Optimisation? A Monotonic Adaptive Norm Rescaling Approach For Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Long-tailed recognition poses a significant challenge for deep learning. The two-stage decoupling paradigm, which separates representation learning from classifier retraining, offers a promising solution. During the classifier retraining stage, adaptive norm rescaling is a popular technique. It adjusts the per-class weight norms via parameter regularization, which inevitably introduces hyperparameters. However, many studies report that long-tailed recognition is sensitive to these hyperparameters, as their setup significantly impacts performance. In this paper, we first provide a class-conditional distribution perspective to support norm rescaling methods. Furthermore, we propose a simple but effective approach called Self-Adaptive Monotonic Normalization (SAMN). SAMN avoids the need for parameter regularization. It directly enforces monotonicity on per-class weight norms using the Pool Adjacent Violators Algorithm, making the method hyperparameter-friendly. SAMN is a universal strategy that integrates seamlessly with other methods for enhanced performance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method significantly boosts long-tailed recognition performance, often achieving state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需超参数的自适应单调归一化方法(SAMN)，用于长尾识别中的分类器重训练阶段，通过强制执行每类权重范数的单调性来提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自适应范数缩放方法依赖参数正则化来调整每类权重范数，但引入的超参数对长尾识别性能敏感且难以调节。
AI.method: 提出Self-Adaptive Monotonic Normalization (SAMN)，利用Pool Adjacent Violators Algorithm直接对每类权重范数施加单调性约束，无需参数正则化，实现超参数友好。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上显著提升长尾识别性能，常达到最先进水平，并能与其他方法无缝集成以进一步增强效果。
AI.conclusion: SAMN是一种简单、通用且高效的长尾识别方法，通过避免超参数敏感性问题，为两阶段解耦范式提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: Improving Combined Detection and Classification of TEM Defects via Mask-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Augmentation
summary: Analyzing microstructural defects in transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images, particularly in irradiated metal alloys, is often limited by the availability of high-quality, labeled data. To address this, we introduce a generative data augmentation approach using a mask-conditioned latent diffusion model (LDM) for synthesizing realistic TEM images with controllable, automatically labeled multi-class defect masks. Without requiring manual annotations for generation, our method enables the creation of synthetic image-mask pairs by sampling distributions learned from experimental masks. These generated data were used to augment small experimental datasets of varying sizes (10, 50, and 100 labeled experimental images) to train a Mask Regional Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN) model for defect detection and classification. Our results show that generative augmentation yields small overall model performance improvements, with up to a 0.02 gain in the harmonic mean of detection and classification F1 scores. However, we also find that the relative contributions to detection and classification improvement depend on the specific train/test data split. These findings highlight the potential of targeted generative models to enhance deep learning performance in data-scarce microscopy-based image quantification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于掩码条件潜在扩散模型（LDM）的生成式数据增强方法，用于合成透射电子显微镜（TEM）图像中的微观结构缺陷。该方法无需人工标注即可生成带有自动标注多类缺陷掩膜的逼真TEM图像，并通过扩充少量真实标注数据（10、50、100张）训练Mask R-CNN模型进行缺陷检测与分类。实验表明，生成式增强带来了小幅性能提升（F1调和平均值提升最多0.02），但效果依赖于训练/测试数据划分。
AI.motivation: 透射电子显微镜图像中微观结构缺陷的分析（特别是在辐照金属合金中）常受限于高质量标注数据的稀缺性。
AI.method: 提出一种掩码条件潜在扩散模型（LDM），无需人工标注即可生成带有自动标注多类缺陷掩膜的逼真TEM图像；利用生成的合成数据扩充小规模实验数据集，训练Mask R-CNN进行缺陷检测与分类。
AI.result: 生成式增强使模型性能小幅提升，F1调和平均值最多提升0.02；检测和分类的改进相对贡献取决于具体的训练/测试数据划分。
AI.conclusion: 靶向生成模型在数据稀缺的显微镜图像量化任务中具有提升深度学习性能的潜力。

title: LL-Bench: Rethinking Low-Level Vision Evaluation in the Era of Large-Scale Generative Models
summary: Large-scale generative models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across image generation and editing tasks.
